title: FP&A- Working Student
description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment.

Shiftmove exists to make this simple. We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets.

Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the Role

Joining our FP&A team as a Working Student, you won't just be doing basic data entry, you’ll have real ownership from day one.

You’ll play a key role in strengthening our monthly financial reporting and budgeting processes across our PE-backed, multi-entity SaaS group. By consolidating costs and building clear, vendor-level insights, you will directly enable our budget owners to make smarter, faster decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Spend Transparency: Consolidate accounting cost data across multiple systems monthly, categorizing and tagging line items by vendor and cost type.
  • Optimize Financial Models: Maintain and refine Excel models tracking actual spend against budget and forecast.
  • Empower Budget Owners: Deliver clearer, more timely spend visibility to department heads to help optimize operational budgets.

title: AI Platform Working Student
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You will work as a full member of the AI Core team, supporting the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. The team's core product is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): we keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations, and ensure every company in the group has a stable, well-configured environment.

Keleya ist ein frauengeführtes FemTech-Startup aus Berlin. Unsere Mission: Werdenen und frischgebackenen Eltern die digitale Unterstützung zu geben, die sie in Schwangerschaft, Geburt und Elternzeit wirklich brauchen.

Mit unserer App bündeln wir evidenzbasiertes Expertenwissen, persönliche Sprechstunden mit examinierten Hebammen sowie Video- und Live-Kurse an einem Ort. Das Ergebnis: Als einzige Plattform ihrer Art in Deutschland kooperieren wir bereits mit über 80 Krankenkassen, die die Kosten für unsere Nutzerinnen übernehmen. Seit 2017 haben wir so schon mehr als 1.000.000 Mütter durch die ersten zwei Lebensjahre ihres Babys begleitet.

Dabei verbindest du Relationship Management mit analytischem und wachstumsorientiertem Denken. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Partnern, Product Growth, Marketing und unserer Chief Revenue Officer zusammen und übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Projekte.

Unser Ziel ist nicht einfach, Partnerschaften zu verwalten: Wir möchten sie gemeinsam mit unseren Krankenkassen weiterentwickeln, die Nutzung unserer Angebote erhöhen und keleya nachhaltig in deren Versorgungsangebot integrieren.

Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
description:
Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events

Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein.

Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet.

Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt.


Das Team

Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen.

Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt.

  • Du baust den Auftritt.

description:
About the role

Luminovo builds software that powers the electronics supply chain — and we're growing our OEM segment across the DACH market. As a BDR based in Munich or Berlin, you'll own the top of the funnel: turning cold outreach into qualified pipeline for our Account Executives.

This is a high-impact role for someone who believes cold calling isn't dead, thrives on outbound, and wants to grow into a closing role in B2B SaaS.

What you'll do

  • Run multichannel outbound sequences — email, phone, LinkedIn, and events — targeting technical buyers at OEMs across the DACH region

  • Use tools like Apollo, Clay, Lusha, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to build and work targeted lead lists

  • Qualify prospects through cold call sequences to identify ICP fit

  • Hand off warm opportunities to Account Executives with clean notes and context

  • Track your own metrics and bring frontline market insights back to sales and marketing leadership

Who you are

  • Required BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS (or strong hunger to break in)

  • Fluent in German and English — you'll be reaching buyers across the DACH region

  • Comfortable with rejection and energized by outbound

  • Driven to grow into an Account Executive role and willing to earn it

  • Bonus: experience or genuine curiosity in electronics, manufacturing, or hardware

title: Solutions Architect, Lead
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. title: Kundenservice & Community Manager:in (m/w/d) - Teilzeit, Werkstudent:in oder Minijob · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Und auffällig oft geht es in diesen Bewertungen gar nicht ums Produkt, sondern um den Service. Dazu kommen die Nachrichten — seitenlang, mit Fragen zur Umstellung, mit Erfolgsgeschichten, manchmal mit Ärger über ein Paket, das zu spät kam.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Jede dieser Nachrichten ist ein Moment, in dem wir jemanden für gesunden Genuss begeistern können — auch die, die mit Ärger anfängt. Wir wollen, dass am Ende jedes Gesprächs ein erledigtes Anliegen steht und ein Mensch, der gern wiederkommt — nicht eine höfliche Antwort ohne Lösung. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme von NaschNatur gegenüber unseren Kundinnen und unserer Community. Du beantwortest Anfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media, betreust unsere Brand-Kanäle und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen erledigt wird — zugunsten der Kundin, nicht nur beantwortet. Deine Nordstern-Metriken: Lösungszeit und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Ausgangslage

Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein Kundenservice-Team. Der Service hängt aktuell an einer Person, die ihn neben Auftragsbearbeitung und Verwaltung mitmacht.

Das heißt für dich: Du wirst eingearbeitet, aber du bist nach wenigen Wochen die Person, die den Posteingang verantwortet. Und du verantwortest mehr als das Beantworten - du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, unser internes Wiki und das Help Center. Wer eine Frage zum fünften Mal beantwortet, ohne sich zu fragen warum, ist in dieser Rolle falsch.

description: Enerzyz  is an AI-powered asset orchestration platform that helps industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and data centers run more efficiently. title: Senior CRO Specialist
description:
About Entyre

Caregiving is broken. We’re fixing it with technology. Entyre is the holding behind Pflegewegweiser (Switzerland), Entyre Care (United States), and the Pflegewegweiser Shop. We operate as one system across our offices in Berlin, Boston, and Zurich: 450+ people developing the technology, products, and growth strategies that power all three brands. Our platform connects family caregivers with compensation programs through selfonboarding funnels, automated eligibility engines, and digital care management. In the US, families discover Entyre Care through paid and organic channels, land on our landing pages, and move through a multi-step journey in the Hub, our self-service platform, until they are fully enrolled. Hub processes differ by state, and every screen along the journey is a potential drop-off point. Your job is to find those points and fix them.

The Role

You will join the Marketing team in our Berlin office and own testing and optimization across the entire funnel, from the first landing page impression to a won customer. Your initial focus is the US market and the Entyre Care funnels, with the technology and learnings you build serving the whole group. This is a senior, high-ownership role with direct impact on how many families we can help and how fast. The Hub is our proprietary self-onboarding app that guides a family caregiver from the first eligibility check through document collection and third-party sign-offs to a completed Medicaid enrollment. Requirements differ by state, so the Hub runs a different flow in every market and there is no single funnel to optimize. You will work across multiple state-specific flows, prioritize the biggest leaks, and choose the right method for each situation. Where traffic supports it, you run clean A/B tests. title: Customer Experience Manager

We are looking for a   Customer Experience Manager,   a leader who breathes premium service and understands that "good enough" is the enemy of "extraordinary."   You will lead our CX team to move beyond "support" and toward "Customer Relations." You are the guardian of our brand love, turning every interaction into a reason for a customer to stay for life.      Key Responsibilities     Define the "Bloomthis Way" (The Playbook):   Create and own the Service Culture Playbook. You will design the scripts, the tone of voice, and the "unboxing" of our service experience to ensure it feels premium, empathetic, and effortless.    Coach & Elevate (Training):   You are a teacher at heart. You will personally train the team on soft skills, high-level communication, and the "art of the save," ensuring every team member sounds like a brand ambassador, not a call center agent.    Luxury Service Recovery:   Manage high-stakes escalations with the poise of a 5-star hotel manager. You’ll have the autonomy to make "make-it-right" decisions that protect our brand reputation.    Operational Common Sense & CX Intelligence:   While you are a "people person," you are also a "data person." You will track and optimize key CX metrics (NPS, CSAT, First Response Time, and Retention) to identify friction points in the customer journey.    Cross-Functional Advocacy:   Be the voice of the customer in meetings with Operations, Tech, and Logistics. If a delivery route is hurting the customer experience, you are the one to highlight it and help solve it.    Proactive Brand Love:   Design "surprise and delight" moments that exceed expectations, transforming a standard purchase into an Anantara-level memory. The Architect:   You’ve built training programs or service frameworks before. You know how to take a vision and turn it into a repeatable process for a team.    The Logic:   You possess "Operational Common Sense." You can look at a spreadsheet of delivery delays and immediately pinpoint the reputational risk and the solution.    The Heart:   High EQ is non-negotiable. You genuinely care about the "why" behind a gift, whether it’s a wedding, a funeral, or a "just because."

TLDR: Plinth builds software for charities, foundations and funders. 2,000+ UK organisations use us, we add 7+ clients a month, and we ship constantly. HR, security, legal and finance currently sit with one person. That stops working at our next size. We're hiring someone to own a chunk of it: recruitment operations, contracts and invoicing, and the paperwork behind our ISO 27001 certification. You'll answer them with support from the team and our internal tooling, and build a reusable answer bank so the tenth takes an hour instead of a day. You don't need to be a security expert. title: Ecommerce Brand Manager
description:
Entropy sells survival, power and preparedness gear in the US. Around $525k a year, currently at contribution margin neutral. Almost all of it is other people's product resold at 9-12% margin, which caps what the business can earn.

Own-brand product and better acquisition economics are the fix. That's the job.

You'd own the P&L and report to Jack and Lasse weekly. Nobody else is doing this.

Tasks

  • Own blended gross margin, moving it from 12% to 25%, and take the business through breakeven.
  • Source and launch own-brand SKUs. Suppliers, MOQ negotiation, samples, freight, duty, 3PL, listings, launch.
  • Run paid acquisition yourself. Google Shopping, PMax and Search. There's no agency and there won't be one.
  • Site and conversion work. Product pages, imagery, copy, checkout, cart abandonment.
  • Build attach and post-purchase revenue. Checkout upsells, replenishment, email flows.
  • Restart the content engine. Video cadence, TikTok, YouTube, UGC and reviews.
  • Manage the existing dropship catalogue on margin, cutting what doesn't pay.
  • First 90 days: paid spend cut on every SKU below 15% margin, even where that drops revenue. Google Ads moved in-house. First own-brand order placed. Attach offers live at checkout. Blended gross margin at 16%.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Launched a physical product end to end. Sourced it, negotiated MOQ, approved samples, managed freight, priced it, listed it, sold it
  • Run Google Ads yourself on a Shopping-led store. In the account, not briefing an agency
  • Owned a gross margin or P&L number, not a revenue or ROAS number
  • Operated at $500k-5m, where you wrote the product page and answered the customer emails
  • Comfortable cutting revenue to fix margin
  • Work independently. No team, no budget approver, nobody checking your work between weekly calls

title: Founding GTM @ Embedded AI Efficiency Layer, Berlin

About the Venture

AI is being integrated into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage scales, costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next is efficiency: inference costs increasingly determine what companies can afford to build and ship.

We’re building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without compromising the quality standards that matter. Over time, we push both cost and quality forward, so companies can do more with AI rather than choose between better performance and a healthier bottom line. We work with enterprise software companies, with the ambition to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.


About the Role

You’ll work directly with our founder and CEO to build go-to-market from scratch. Your mission

As a full-time member of our Orbital Systems team in Munich/Germany, you will work on defining the architecture of fluidic systems for spacecraft propulsion and other functions, working closely with a multi-disciplinary team. We work on projects ranging from launcher propulsion systems to orbital refuelling systems.

Your role will include:

  • Defining fluidic systems' architectures, working closely with other domain architects
  • Performing fluidic systems' simulations (performance calculations, steady and transient CFD, thermal and others)
  • Systems Engineering, incl. Requirements Engineering and MBSE
  • Technical leadership
  • Driving MAIT, incl. hands-on support
  • Co-ordinating design and mechanical engineers
  • Direct interfacing with customers and suppliers
  • Supporting proposal preparation


Your profile

We are seeking engineers with demonstrated expertise in fluidic systems. Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. We are also interested in more experienced professionals with 10+ years of experience in fluidic system architecture and leadership. The position level, scope, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.

Ideally, your experience includes:

  • Knowledge of space systems and subsystems
  • Propulsion systems architecture, including HTP and/or hydrazine/MMH
  • Propellants ground handling experience including safety requirements
  • Fluidic system simulations, with knowledge of ECOSIM / ESPSS, Simulink, Matlab
  • Familiarity with MBSE concepts and requirements engineering principles; ECSS
  • Strong analytical and communication skills
  • Hands-on mindset for hardware related activities
  • Proactive, structured, and able to work independently and in a team

Your profile

  • Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

title: Teamleder Onboarding
description: Vi søker en fremoverlent og handlekraftig Teamleder for Onboarding som vil få en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle hvordan vi tar imot og får nye kunder godt i gang med Duetts løsninger.  Som Teamleder får du det overordnede ansvaret for onboarding av kunder på tvers av våre produkter – Duett Økonomi, Duett Prosjekt, Duett Eiendom og Taskline. I løpet av høsten lanserer vi også Duett Lager og Duett Landbruk, og en viktig del av rollen blir å etablere gode, effektive og skalerbare onboardingsprogrammer for disse produktene.  Dette er en operativ teamlederrolle. Du skal lede og utvikle teamet, men samtidig være tett på kundene og selv delta aktivt i onboardinger og andre leveranser. Vi ser derfor etter deg som trives like godt med å få ting gjort som med å skape struktur, retning og utvikling for teamet.   Ditt ansvar     Ha det overordnede ansvaret for kundeonboarding på tvers av Duetts produktportefølje.  Videreutvikle og standardisere onboardingsløp for Duett Økonomi, Duett Prosjekt, Duett Eiendom og Taskline.  Etablere gode og skalerbare onboardingsprogrammer for nye produkter, herunder Duett Lager og Duett Landbruk.  Delta aktivt og operativt i kundeonboardinger og konsulentleveranser.  Lede og utvikle teamet, inkludert personalansvar, oppfølging og kompetanseutvikling.  Ha ansvar for et team som bistår kunder med konvertering og import av data fra andre systemer, samt integrasjoner og offboardinger.  Jobbe systematisk med å forbedre, forenkle og effektivisere arbeidsprosesser sammen med teamet.  Følge opp teamets mål, nøkkeltall og leveranser, samt identifisere og gjennomføre forbedringstiltak.  Samarbeide tett med Produkt, Utvikling og øvrige team for å løfte innspill fra kunder og support inn i videre produktutvikling.  Bidra aktivt i ledergruppen i Customer Operations og støtte opp under selskapets mål, strategi og verdier.     Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av å skape forbedringer og som ikke nødvendigvis tenker at «slik har vi alltid gjort det» er den beste måten å løse en oppgave på.  Du er fremoverlent, strukturert og løsningsorientert, og du liker å gå fra idé til handling. Du evner å se både helheten og detaljene og trives med å skape struktur i områder hvor det finnes muligheter for forbedring.   Vi Tror Du     Har erfaring innen regnskap og god forståelse for regnskapsprosesser.  Har erfaring med ledelse, eller et sterkt ønske om å utvikle deg som leder.  Trives med å kombinere operativt arbeid og personalledelse.  Er strukturert, løsningsorientert og god til å prioritere.  Motiveres av å utvikle mennesker, bygge team og skape gode resultater sammen med andre.  Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner.     Hvorfor denne rollen?   Onboarding er en viktig del av kundens første møte med Duett etter at de har valgt løsningene våre. Ambisjonen vår er å gjøre denne reisen stadig enklere, raskere og mer forutsigbar – både for kunden og for oss.  Som Teamleder for Onboarding får du muligheten til å påvirke

Revenue Operations Manager

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000


Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everyone by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.


Your job is to own the numbers for the entire commercial engine. Not hit them, own them. You'll build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, and put a reliable set of numbers in front of our leadership team and board.


You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. We use Claude, and you'll need to show evidence of AI already embedded in how you work.


There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective

title: Associate Relationship Manager - London
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

This is not a traditional accounting role focused on maintaining legacy systems.

At Volta, you will help build the finance function from first principles, contributing to the design of processes, controls, and reporting in a business deploying capital at global scale.

Working closely with the Senior Financial Accountant and the wider Financial Accounting and Transactional Function, you will play a key role in delivering accurate financial reporting while supporting the build-out of a scalable, best-in-class accounting environment across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the execution of the monthly financial close

  • Prepare and post accrual, prepayment, payroll, capex, revenue, and FX entries, among others

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations for review

    • Cash, AR, AP, fixed assets, other payables and receivables, equity

title: Data Scientist - Audiobooks Analytics
description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. You will work with the Audiobooks Analytics Lead to help shape our global audiobooks strategy and improve the experience for listeners, creators, publishers, and authors.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to evaluate some of the most important opportunities facing our audiobooks business. Your work will span content and catalog strategy, discovery and recommendations, subscriber growth, and new product and commercial initiatives. You will turn complex questions into clear recommendations and help senior leaders make confident decisions.

You will collaborate with a distributed team of analysts, data scientists, business leaders, product managers, editorial partners, and engineers. At Spotify, you will have access to rich datasets and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will help shape how the world listens to and discovers audiobooks.


What You'll Do
  • Develop data-driven strategies for audiobook catalog, content discovery, listener engagement, and subscriber growth.
  • Evaluate new product, content, licensing, and commercial opportunities through forecasting, scenario modeling, and impact measurement.
  • Partner with Editorial, Personalization, Product, Finance, and Business teams to improve title selection, recommendation quality, and the listener experience.
  • Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments, to measure the impact of product and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Monitor the health of the audiobooks business, identify emerging opportunities or risks, and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Develop reliable analytical datasets, tools, and reporting that make important insights accessible and repeatable.<

title: Technical Marketing Analyst - PPC (Contract)
description:
We’re looking for a technically skilled PPC Specialist who treats performance marketing as both a science and a craft. This is not a “launch campaigns from templates” role – we need someone who can get under the hood of tracking infrastructure, diagnose data integrity issues, and build campaigns on a foundation of reliable measurement.

We need someone who can both identify and fix technical issues (unreliable conversion data, pixel misconfiguration, broken audience pipelines). It’s someone who understands how pixels, CAPI, GTM, and conversion APIs actually work at a technical level.

Your job is to build engine-room excellence in PPC performance. This means:

  • Understanding the business (not just the keywords) – tying campaign performance to real pipeline and revenue metrics.

  • Taking manual control when needed – switching off AI/auto-optimize features to maintain brand consistency and funnel integrity.

  • Running tests with intention, checking negative keywords daily, and refining messaging strategically.

  • Diagnose and resolve data discrepancies between ad platform reporting, Google Analytics (GA4), and CRM/pipeline data.

  • Implement or repair server-side tracking (Conversions API) to ensure reliable, privacy-compliant event data – not dependent solely on browser-side pixels.

  • Configure and validate Google Tag Manager (GTM) containers: triggers, tags, variables, data layers – ensuring clean event taxonomy.

  • Set up proper conversion events, custom conversions, and offline conversion imports where applicable.

  • Verify landing page tracking integrity: ensure page view, form submit, and downstream events fire correctly and consistently.

  • Document all tracking architecture: what fires where, what data flows where, and known limitations.

Campaign Strategy & Setup

  • Build, structure, and refine PPC campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and Twitter/X.

title: Engineering Manager - UK
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-dat

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

The Role

This is not your typical Customer Success role.

RevenueCat prices based on how much money a customer makes. That creates an unusually clear alignment of incentives: when our customers grow, we grow.

That means Customer Success at RevenueCat should be more than relationship management, implementation check-ins, and polite QBRs.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes that means helping them adopt the right RevenueCat feature.

Sometimes it means spotting that their paywall, pricing, lifecycle, onboarding, or retention motion deserves a closer look.

Sometimes it means bringing in a technical partner to make sure an implementation question gets answered correctly.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

And often, it means doing the unglamorous but critical work of keeping everyone aligned on context, priorities, next steps, owners, and follow-through.

That’s this role.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a portfolio of managed RevenueCat customers and help them get more value from RevenueCat. You’ll become the person who understands where each customer is trying to go, what is getting in their way, how RevenueCat can plausibly help, and what needs to happen next.

You are not expected to be the best technical expert, paywall expert, lifecycle expert, paid acquisition expert, or pricing expert in the company.

You are expected to be a strong growth generalist: curious, commercially aware, product-fluent, organized, and credible enough to diagnose the right problem, bring in the right person, and own the follow-through.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat has grown quickly, and our customer base now spans everything from tiny indie apps to some of the largest mobile businesses in the world.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

title: Teammanager klantenservice
description: Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen.  Samen met een betrokken team lever je dagelijks een zichtbare bijdrage aan de excellente dienstverlening voor miljoenen klanten van de RDW. Je coacht, motiveert en stimuleert jouw medewerkers om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Dat is het uitdagende speelveld waarin jij je als teammanager binnen de frontoffice bij de divisie Registratie en Informatie (R&I) in Veendam bevindt.   Interessant aan deze baan volgens teammanager klantenservice Paulien   Als teammanager binnen het KCC ben je de spin in het web. Je houdt je enerzijds bezig met de ontwikkeling van je medewerkers en anderzijds ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor alle ontwikkelingen op de unit. Dat kunnen heel uiteenlopende vragen zijn op het werkterrein van de RDW. Je zorgt ervoor dat de doelstellingen van het KCC worden gerealiseerd binnen de afgesproken kaders van tijd, kwaliteit en budget.  Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het coachen, begeleiden en motiveren van je teamleden, zodat zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen en optimaal kunnen presteren. De resultaten van jouw team maak je inzichtelijk via managementrapportages. Door deze informatie te combineren met een continue monitoring en analyse van prestaties, krijg je scherp inzicht in kansen om productiviteit, efficiëntie, kwaliteit en effectiviteit verder te verbeteren. title: Team Lead til Fastholdelse i OK
description: Kan du lede et team med ét klart mål: at fastholde flere kunder? Som Team Lead for Fastholdelse får du ansvaret for at udvikle medarbejderne, løfte performance og skabe stærke kundeoplevelser.    Om rollen og afdelingen   I OK er vi i gang med at etablere et nyt Fastholdelsesteam, som skal rådgive privatkunder, der overvejer deres muligheder, og hjælpe dem med at finde den rette løsning.  Som Team Lead får du det operationelle ansvar for teamet og bliver en synlig og nærværende leder, der er tæt på både medarbejdere og den daglige drift. Du udvikler teamet, følger performance og bruger data, KPI’er og kundeindsigter til at skabe stærke resultater.  Teamets indsigter skal samtidig bidrage til at styrke kundeoplevelsen og OK’s samlede fastholdelsesindsats. Du bliver en del af ledergruppen i Salg og Kundeservice Privat og refererer til afdelingens Manager. Samtidig bliver du en del af et tæt og engageret samarbejde med de øvrige Team Leads, hvor I sammen sikrer retning, sparring og fælles fokus på tværs af området.   Dine opgaver      Lede, coache og udvikle medarbejderne gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.  Skabe en stærk performancekultur med tydelige mål og løbende feedback.  Følge op på KPI’er, kvalitet og fastholdelsesresultater.  Sikre gode og værdiskabende kundedialoger.  Bruge data og kundeindsigter til at identificere forbedringsmuligheder.  Planlægge bemandingen i samarbejde med Workforce Management.  Bidrage til udviklingen af OK’s churn- og fastholdelsesindsats.  Rekruttere og onboarde nye medarbejdere efter behov.      Om dig   Du har minimum to års erfaring med at lede et Fastholdelsesteam og kan dokumentere stærke resultater inden for fastholdelse og performance.  Som leder er du tydelig, nærværende og god til at skabe følgeskab. Du sætter retning, følger op og udvikler dine medarbejdere med blik for både resultater og trivsel.  Du arbejder struktureret og datadrevet og bruger KPI’er og kundeindsigter aktivt til at prioritere og forbedre teamets performance.   Det praktiske   Kundecentret har åbent alle ugens dage. Din primære arbejdstid vil typisk være fem hverdage kl. 08.00-16.00, men du skal regne med at være på kontoret kl. 12.00-20.00 én til to gange om måneden. Weekendarbejde kan forekomme i takt med, at funktionen udvikles.  Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt og senest den 30. august 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.  Tiltrædelse er snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat frem for at fremskynde opstarten.  Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutterende leder Marianne Jensen på tlf. 40 14 22 86-  Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö Gigantti Tammistoon
description: Gigantti syntyi halusta tarjota asiakkaille huippuluokan teknologiaa järkevään hintaan. Menestyksemme salaisuus on aina ollut osaava asiakaspalvelu, laadukkaat tuotteet ja kunnianhimo. Meillä on aidosti hauskaa töissä, ja se näkyy! Olemme uteliaita ja kiinnostuneita sekä tuotteistamme että asiakkaidemme tarpeista. Arvomme ohjaavat kaikkea mitä teemme: voitamme yhdessä, pelaamme yhdessä, kasvamme yhdessä ja olemme erilaisia yhdessä. Tervetuloa hakemaan Giganttiin! Haluatko johtaa asiakaskokemusta Suomen suurimmassa Gigantissa? Etsimme nyt kehityshaluista asiakaskokemuspäällikköä (Customer Experience Manager) Vantaan Tammiston myymälään johtamaan asiakaskokemusta, kehittämään palvelukulttuuria ja valmentamaan tiimiä kohti yhteistä tavoitetta: tarjota asiakkaillemme alan paras asiakaskokemus joka päivä. 💙💚   Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä asiakkaan matka Gigantissa tuntuu aina ensimmäisestä kohtaamisesta viimeiseen palvelutilanteeseen. Johdat laajaa ja monipuolista tiimiä ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tavaratalopäällikön ja muiden osastopäälliköiden kanssa. Johdat toimintaa tavoitteellisesti, kehität tiimisi osaamista ja viet käytäntöön Gigantin asiakas ensin -strategiaa. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen johtoryhmän sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittää uraasi Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti osana Elkjøp-konsernia.    Mitä Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö tekee?    Vastaat myymälän asiakaskokemuksen kannalta keskeisten toimintojen johtamisesta ja vastuualueesi tuloksesta sekä henkilöstöstä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, kassatoiminnot, maksuliikenne, palvelupisteen toiminta, tekninen tuki sekä asiakkaan sujuvan asioinnin varmistaminen kaikissa kohtaamispisteissä.   Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:    Asiakaskokemuksen johtaminen      Johdat ja kehität asiakaskokemusta Gigantin strategian mukaan.   Kehität palvelua ja toimintatapoja yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.   Varmistat, että asiakkaamme saavat sujuvaa, asiantuntevaa ja ystävällistä palvelua.      Liiketoiminnan johtaminen      Vastaat oman vastuualueesi tuloksista ja tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta.   Huolehdit myymälän sujuvasta arjesta ja toimivista prosesseista.   Kehität toimintaa aktiivisesti osana myymälän johtoryhmää.      Ihmisten johtaminen      Valmennat, koulutat ja kehität tiimiäsi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita.   Luot ympäristön, jossa ihmiset viihtyvät, kehittyvät ja uskaltavat onnistua.   Johdat esimerkilläsi, olet aktiivisesti läsnä arjessa ja saat ympärilläsi olevat loistamaan.      Odotamme sinulta      Vähintään kolmen vuoden kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä ja soveltuvaa koulutusta.   Näyttöjä tavoitteellisesta ihmisten johtamisesta, luottamuksen luomisesta ja vastuun jakamisesta.   Kokemusta vähittäiskaupasta, palveluliiketoiminnasta tai muusta asiakaslähtöisestä ympäristöstä.   Sujuvia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja suomeksi ja käytännön englannin kielen taitoa.   Sosiaalista tilannetajua sekä kykyä keskittyä ja kuunnella myös kiireisissä

title: Teamleitung Customer Service B2B (m/w/d)
description: Unsere Mission lautet protecting people. Mit innovativen Produkten schützt die uvex group seit 100 Jahren Menschen in Beruf, Sport und Freizeit. Weltweit. Bei uns in der  uvex   safety group  dreht sich alles um den Arbeitsschutz: Wir produzieren persönliche Schutzausrüstung von Kopf bis Fuß – vom Schutzhelm bis zum Sicherheitsschuh. Dabei hat sich uvex safety als Markensystemanbieter mit internationaler Herstellerkompetenz in zahlreichen Branchen einen Namen gemacht.  Um zu den Besten zu gehören, gibt unser Team alles! Wir entwickeln brandneue Technologien rund um Persönliche Schutzausrüstung. Wir vermarkten unsere preisgekrönten Produkte mit Kreativität und Begeisterung. Wir setzen auf die Fertigung unserer Innovationen in eigenen Produktionsstätten. Wir versehen unsere Produkte mit digitalen Features – für noch mehr Sicherheit im Alltag. Und in Zukunft wollen wir sie auch ein bisschen „grüner“ machen.  Für unsere Gesellschaft  UVEX SAFETY AUSTRIA GMBH  suchen wir genau SIE!    Die operative Betreuung definierter Kunden und Kundengruppen gehört zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team sorgen Sie für eine verlässliche Betreuung rund um unser Arbeitsschutzportfolio und tragen dazu bei, Menschen von Kopf bis Fuß bestmöglich zu schützen.   Mit Ihrem hohen Anspruch an Kundenorientierung gewährleisten Sie eine erstklassige Servicequalität über alle Kommunikationskanäle hinweg und schaffen langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen.   Sie steuern das Kundenservice-Team unter Einhaltung der definierten Prozesse und Regelwerke und stellen eine effiziente Bearbeitung aller kundenrelevanten Themen sicher.   Sie übernehmen die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Kundenservice-Teams der uvex Safety Austria und arbeiten eng mit dem Außendienst sowie weiteren internen Schnittstellen zusammen, um pragmatische und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.  Sie verfügen über mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb und in der Kundenbetreuung und haben dabei ein gutes Verständnis für Kundenbedürfnisse und serviceorientierte Lösungen entwickelt.   Darüber hinaus bringen Sie mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung mit und verstehen es, Ihr Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft erfolgreich zu begleiten.   Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Kenntnisse in SAP und CRM auf Key User-Niveau sind wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung.   Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, eine professionelle und pragmatische Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an operativen Themen zeichnen Sie aus. Kundenorientierung ist für Sie gelebter Bestandteil Ihres Arbeitsalltags.

title: Technical Customer Support Manager L1

The role combines people leadership, operational control & metrics continuous monitoring, and continuous improvement to deliver excellent customer experience while meeting SLOs, SLAs and productivity targets.  Key responsibilities     Team leadership & people management-Lead, motivate and organize a team of support agents, Support recruitment & onboarding  Coach & develop team members (objective definitions, feedback, development, training needs & plans   Operational supervision  Monitor real-time activity across all channels (phone, email, chat, portal) and adjust resources accordingly. description: Company Description   Ibis Wellington is one of Wellington's largest economy hotels, conveniently located within walking distance of the city's major venues, including Tākina, Te Papa, TSB Arena and Sky Stadium.  Our hotel offers consistency and efficiency for business and leisure travellers, as well as large groups and events, with our vibrant Vivant! Restaurant & Bar offering a generous buffet breakfast, lunch, dinner and a selection of beverages.  We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Team Leader for our Front Office/Food & Beverage Department, to join our team. Assist team members with product knowledge and service delivery.   Support training and onboarding of new team members.   Promote food and beverage offerings through confident upselling.   Ensure compliance with food safety, licensing and health and safety requirements.   Assist in responding to guest feedback and service recovery opportunities.     Duty

Für unseren Standort in Valencia suchen wir derzeit Team Leader (m/w/d).   Was wird Ihre Aufgabe sein?   Sie sind verantwortlich für die Führung, Koordinierung und Motivation eines Teams von Agenten. Dabei stellen Sie das Erreichen der betrieblichen und qualitativen Ziele sicher und fördern gleichzeitig ein positives, leistungsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld.   Hauptaufgaben     Operatives Management: Überwachung der täglichen Teamleistung, Sicherstellung einer angemessenen Serviceabdeckung, Erfüllung der zugewiesenen KPIs (Qualität, Produktivität usw.) sowie Lösung von Vorfällen in Echtzeit. description: At Aon, we help organisations make better decisions. As a Client Leader within our Corporate segment, you will play a central role in developing relationships with established corporate clients and creating new business opportunities across the Swedish market.  This is an opportunity for someone who combines commercial drive, curiosity and a genuine interest in building long-term client relationships. You enjoy taking initiative, bringing people together and turning an understanding of a client’s business into relevant advice and practical solutions.   The Role   As a Client Leader, you will own and develop a portfolio of corporate clients and prospects. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers, building a strong understanding of their business, priorities and risk landscape.  The role combines client leadership, business development and team coordination. You will drive client retention and growth, identify new business opportunities, and bring together the right expertise from across Aon to deliver value to clients.   Key Responsibilities   You will build and strengthen long-term relationships with clients and prospects while identifying opportunities for growth and value creation. You will be responsible for developing your portfolio through a combination of account development, prospecting and new business generation.  Working closely with colleagues across Aon, you will coordinate client teams, ensure effective execution of client plans and deliver a seamless client experience. You will also maintain an active pipeline, drive structured follow-up and contribute to the profitability and continued growth of the Corporate segment.   Who We Are Looking For   We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, relationship-oriented and comfortable taking responsibility. Your mindset, initiative and ability to create progress are as important as the number of years you have worked.   Experience     Proven experience, preferably from insurance and risk management, alternatively from consulting, sales, finance, or another client-facing corporate environment.  Experience of developing professional client relationships and driving initiatives forward.  An understanding of corporate clients and an interest in their business challenges, risks and opportunities.  Experience of coordinating stakeholders, projects or client teams is an advantage.  Experience of new business development, account development or complex B2B sales is beneficial.     Profile     Proactive and commercially minded, with a genuine interest in clients and business development.  Skilled at building trust and maintaining relationships over time.  Curious and quick to understand different businesses and industries.  Structured and comfortable managing several parallel priorities.  Able to take ownership, create momentum and follow activities through to completion.  Collaborative and confident in involving colleagues with different areas of expertise.

title: Technical Account Manager (IT)
description: It usually starts like this.  You're grabbing a coffee at your favourite cafe, pretending you're just "checking emails," when in reality you're solving three client problems, calming down a fourth, and wondering if there's a role out there where you could actually  shape  things instead of just reacting to them.  Good news, there is.   About First Focus   First Focus has spent the last  nine years  being recognised by Cloudtango as  Australia's #1 mid-market Managed Service Provider . While the award might have been earned across the Tasman, the standards, culture, and customer experience that got us there are exactly what we're bringing to New Zealand. (And after nine years of winning, we're starting to think we might actually need a bigger trophy cabinet.)  We're now pushing close to  500 people globally , and just when things were getting interesting, we've announced our  merger with Integris . Which means we're about to become one of the largest and broadest SMB MSPs on the planet.  No pressure.  What that actually means for you is simple: bigger clients, broader capability, more opportunity, and a front-row seat to something genuinely exciting, without losing the culture that got us here in the first place.  We're still a business where people know your name, where leadership is accessible, and where being  informed, aligned, supported, and rewarded  isn't just a slide in a deck, it's how things actually run day to day. You can read more about how we think about that here: https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/. And yep, we know everyone has these, but here we hire by them, reward by them, and make business decisions using them.   The Role   This role is for someone who's a bit tired of being "the account manager" or "the consultant" and would quite like to be both, properly.  You'll operate as a  trusted advisor and Technical Account Manager , working with a range of SMB and mid-market clients, some approaching 500 seats, partnering directly with senior stakeholders and the C-suite. You won't just manage relationships, you'll shape them.  The way this role plays out is not fixed. There's no dusty playbook to follow. You get to build this role in a way that actually makes sense, for you and for your clients.  You'll help organisations navigate complexity, make smarter decisions, and turn business priorities into practical technology roadmaps that actually get delivered. You'll lead strategic conversations, help clients plan what's next, and occasionally stop them from buying something they absolutely do not need (they'll thank you later).  If you've ever wanted to have a bigger impact, this is where you stop saying it and start doing it.   Why You'll Love It Here     You'll have real autonomy, not the "empowered within strict boundaries" kind  You'll work with established SMB and mid-market clients who expect, and value, proper thinking  You'll help shape your clients' technology strategy and roadmap, not just report on it  You'

title: Senior Account Manager

Our platform serves fast growing SMB, mid market and enterprise customers across the Kingdom and wider GCC, giving HR and finance teams the tools they need to hire, manage and pay people with confidence. Nice-to-have:    Bilingual Arabic / English.  Experience with CRM / account-planning tools (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, or similar).       What Success Looks Like    Net revenue retention and expansion revenue across the account portfolio.  Account health scores and usage/adoption trends. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.  We’re looking for an  Account Manager  to join our Genova team. In this role, you’ll act as a strategic consultant for our restaurant partners, using data-driven insights and industry knowledge to lead their growth and manage brand relationships across the Italian market.  Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.  What You’ll Be Doing  You’ll be joining the Italian Account Management team. We are a passionate, dynamic group of team players focused on offering premium consultancy to our top brands by collaborating across marketing, operations, and product departments.   Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like     Strategic Relationship Management: Oversee a portfolio of restaurant brands, building lasting partnerships and acting as a primary point of contact for the network in your region.  Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyse portfolio performance metrics, sharing data-led insights with partners to identify growth opportunities and improve satisfaction.  Commercial Negotiation: Negotiate contract terms and conditions to align with company goals, improving financial performance and our Consumer Value Proposition (CVP).  Strategic Planning: Develop and execute portfolio strategies to increase market share and loyalty, impacting both absolute performance and relative financial metrics.  P&L Oversight: Manage and control the perimeter P&L, identifying potential financial risks and unlocking new revenue opportunities.    What You’ll Need to Thrive  Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:    Commercial expertise: Significant experience in account management or sales, ideally within the Horeca, restaurant, or food market sectors.  Financial acumen: Strong understanding of P&L management and a proven ability to handle complex commercial negotiations.  Relationship building: Proven ability to create and maintain long-term strategic relationships with external stakeholders. Buscamos una persona con una visión muy orientada a  procesos, tecnología y eficiencia , capaz de combinar la gestión de equipos y operaciones de Customer Service con la identificación e implementación de nuevas soluciones basadas en  Inteligencia Artificial y automatización .     El objetivo del puesto será transformar Customer Service en un área cada vez más  eficiente, escalable y tecnológica , manteniendo al mismo tiempo un elevado nivel de calidad y satisfacción del cliente.     ¿Qué harás?   Liderar y desarrollar la operativa de Customer Service, asegurando una atención ágil, eficiente y orientada al cliente.  Analizar los principales motivos de contacto y detectar oportunidades de mejora en procesos y procedimientos.  Diseñar, documentar y optimizar  SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)  y flujos de atención.  Identificar oportunidades para aplicar  IA y automatización  en Customer Service.  Participar en la definición e implementación de  respuestas automáticas, asistentes virtuales, chatbots y herramientas de IA .  Optimizar y automatizar procesos repetitivos para mejorar tiempos de respuesta y productividad.  Trabajar con herramientas de IA para mejorar la calidad, consistencia y personalización de las respuestas al cliente.  Definir criterios para determinar qué interacciones deben ser automatizadas y cuáles requieren intervención humana.  Analizar KPIs de Customer Service y proponer acciones para mejorar eficiencia, calidad y satisfacción.  Liderar la mejora continua del área y acompañar su evolución a medida que crece el negocio.      ¿Qué buscamos?   Experiencia previa en  Customer Service / Customer Experience / Customer Operations , idealmente en retail, e-commerce o compañías de rápido crecimiento.  Experiencia gestionando equipos y/o proveedores de Customer Service.  Mentalidad muy orientada a  procesos, eficiencia y mejora continua .  Experiencia trabajando con herramientas de  IA, automatización o sistemas de atención al cliente .  Capacidad para identificar procesos susceptibles de automatización y convertirlos en soluciones concretas.  Experiencia creando y optimizando procedimientos, workflows y bases de conocimiento.  Capacidad analítica y orientación a KPIs.  Perfil hands-on, autónomo y con capacidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos y poco estructurados.  Excelente capacidad de comunicación y orientación al cliente.  Inglés profesional.   Será especialmente valorable   Haber participado en proyectos de  implementación de IA aplicada a Customer Service .  Experiencia con herramientas de automatización, CRM, ticketing, chatbots o knowledge bases.  Conocimiento de soluciones de  GenAI / LLMs  y de sus aplicaciones prácticas en atención al cliente.  Experiencia en startups, scale-ups o entornos de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia diseñando estrategias de  automatizac

title: Customer Service Manager Italy
description: Job Description   At the Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.  Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.  Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!   About the role:   You will lead the Customer Service team in Italy, composed of multiple professionals, with a cross-functional scope covering all customers and sales channels.  In this role, you will be accountable for delivering the Customer Service strategy, ensuring strong business impact and value creation. You will combine operational excellence, commercial mindset, and innovation, with full ownership of day-to-day business performance, balancing trade-offs across service, cost, customer priorities, and supply constraints.  You will work in a constantly evolving and increasingly automated environment, focused on enhancing the quality of service through qualitative analysis, process optimization, and system automation.  Your contributions to continuous improvement will be highly valued, and you will also have the opportunity to collaborate with the wider Commercial Area (Italy, France, and Iberia).  You will report to the Sales Operations Director Commercial Area South.   Location    The role is based in Assago. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
 
We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.

  • Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys.

title: Key Account Manager
description: Paroc Panel System  is part of the  Kingspan Group , a global leader in advanced insulation and building envelope solutions, helping to create energy-efficient and low-carbon buildings around the world.      Paroc Panel System  specializes in the design and manufacture of premium stone wool insulated sandwich panels for external walls, internal walls, and ceilings. Our solutions are trusted worldwide for their exceptional fire performance, structural strength, thermal efficiency, and sustainability, serving sectors such as data centers, industrial facilities, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings.  Founded in Ireland in 1965, Kingspan has grown into a global organization operating in more than 80 countries, with over 27,000 employees and 270+ manufacturing facilities worldwide. Innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do, enabling us to deliver high-performance building solutions for both new construction and renovation projects.     We are looking for an experienced  Key Account Manager  to drive sales growth in Finland, develop key customer relationships and identify new business opportunities. The role combines commercial responsibility with technical customer support and close cooperation with internal teams.      Key Responsibilities:       Achieve agreed sales targets and commercial objectives.  Manage and develop relationships with key customers.  Identify and acquire new customers and business opportunities.  Provide commercial and technical support to customers.  Prepare, negotiate and finalize commercial offers and agreements.  Monitor sales performance, market trends and competitor activity.  Support customer projects and complaint resolution.  Cooperate closely with Customer Service, Technical and other internal teams.       Requirements:       Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B sales, key account management or business development.  Experience in construction, building materials or a technical industry is an advantage.  Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills.  Commercial and customer-focused mindset.  Good organizational and problem-solving skills.  Experience with MS Office 365  SAP/CRM knowledge is an advantage.  Fluent Swedish and English.  Willingness to travel regularly within Finland.       What We Offer:       An independent role with responsibility for key customers in Finland.  Hybrid working and regular cooperation across the Nordic region.  Competitive salary, bonus and benefits package.  Training and professional development opportunities.  Career growth within Paroc Panel System and Kingspan Group.

title: Account Manager H/F
description: Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?   Chez Behype, nous démocratisons l'influence pour les acteurs du quotidien : restaurateurs, commerçants et indépendants, en leur apportant un flux constant de nouveaux clients.      Le rôle   Tu es le garant ou la garante de la satisfaction et de la croissance des clients Behype. Construire avec eux une stratégie d'influence sur-mesure dès le départ.  S'assurer que leur première collaboration influenceur se déroule dans les 7 premiers jours — c'est le moment qui détermine tout.  Former les équipes des grands comptes à l'utilisation de l'application.      Support clients in-app   Prendre le relais de l'IA sur les situations complexes que le support automatisé ne peut pas résoudre.  Traiter les litiges, les incompréhensions et les situations bloquantes avec réactivité.  Documenter les cas récurrents pour améliorer les réponses automatiques.      Suivi et fidélisation   Piloter un large portefeuille de clients actifs (contacts proactifs réguliers, points de satisfaction, détection des signaux faibles avant résiliation).  Identifier les clients inactifs ou sous-utilisateurs avant qu'ils ne churnent.  Mettre en place des actions de réactivation ciblées (appels, conseils personnalisés, mise en avant de nouvelles fonctionnalités).  Suivre les KPIs de satisfaction de ton portefeuille (NPS, taux d'activité, fréquence des collaborations).      Upsell et développement du compte   Identifier les opportunités d'upsell pour chaque client (passage au plan supérieur, ajout de nouveaux établissements, accès aux offres premium).  Développer les comptes multi-établissements (un client franchise qui commence avec 2 restaurants doit finir avec 10).  Travailler en coordination avec les commerciaux sur les deals de renouvellement et d'extension.      Gestion des grands comptes et agences   Être l'interlocuteur(rice) privilégié(e) des comptes stratégiques (franchises nationales, groupes hôteliers, agences gérant plusieurs établissements).  Organiser des points de suivi réguliers avec leurs équipes.  Construire des rapports de performance personnalisés pour justifier la valeur Behype.      Ce que nous cherchons :   Tu as une vraie aisance relationnelle — tu rappelles quand tu dis que tu rappelles, tu es fiable et chaleureux(se).  Tu es à l'aise pour gérer de nombreux clients simultanément sans perdre en qualité

title: Sales Manager, talotekniikka ja LVI-ratkaisut
description: Haemme aktiivista ja yhteistyökykyistä myynnin ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisen ammattilaista taloteknisten ja LVI -ratkaisujen pariin!    Mitä toimenkuvaasi kuuluu?    Vastuullasi on rakennushankkeiden toimijoiden – erityisesti rakennusliikkeiden sekä muiden sidosryhmien – laaja-alainen kontaktointi ja yhteistyön kehittäminen. Johdat asiakkuuksiin liittyviä toimenpiteitä liiketoimintayksikkötasolla ja edistät ratkaisujemme tunnettuutta markkinoilla.  Työhösi kuuluu myös tarjottavien palveluiden ja asiakasratkaisujen jatkuva kehittäminen sekä aktiivinen yhteistyö myynnin, markkinoinnin, suunnittelun ja tuotehallinnan kanssa. Roolissasi pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten asiakkaamme näkevät ja kokevat tarjoamamme ratkaisut – olet siis keskeinen linkki asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja yrityksemme tarjonnan välillä.      Mitä odotamme sinulta?      Ymmärrät LVI-järjestelmien toimintaperiaatteita sekä osaat huomioida rakentamisen vaatimukset – esimerkiksi energiatehokkuuden, hiilijalanjäljen ja älykkäät talotekniset ratkaisut – ja reagoida niihin asiakastyössä.  Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva insinöörikoulutus ja näyttöä myynnin, liiketoiminnan kehittämisen tai asiakkuuksien hallinnan parista – erityisesti B2B-ympäristössä.  Ymmärrät rakennusalan toimintaympäristöä ja liiketoimintaprosessien eri vaiheita.  Hallitset nykyaikaiset myynnin ja asiakkuudenhallinnan järjestelmät ja näet digitalisaation mahdollisuutena työn tehostamisessa.     Lisäksi     Olet oma-aloitteinen ja pitkäjänteinen tekijä, joka viihtyy asiakkaiden parissa ja osaa edistää yhteistyötä tavoitteellisesti.  Olet tulostavoitteellinen, tartut rohkeasti toimeen ja viet asiat käytännössä maaliin.  Kykenet itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, mutta arvostat myös tiimityötä ja yhteisiä tavoitteita.  Sinulla on matkustusvalmiutta ja hyvä suomen sekä englannin kielen taito.    Eduksi katsotaan kokemus rakennuttaja- ja LVI-suunnittelijayhteistyöstä sekä kyky esiintyä vakuuttavasti erilaisissa asiakastilanteissa.   Mitä tarjoamme sinulle   Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän osana asiantuntevaa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä. Pääset työskentelemään markkinoiden johtavien ratkaisujen parissa ja vaikuttamaan aidosti siihen, miten rakennusalan tulevaisuutta kehitetään. Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työvälineet, hyvät kehittymismahdollisuudet ja organisaation tuen tehtävässäsi menestymiseen.   Tehtävän toimipaikka on Helsingissä.   Lisätietoja  tehtävästä antaa myyntijohtaja Mika Tarvainen p. 050 540 9841 tai mika.tarvainen@georgfischer.com.   Hakuaika on 30.09.2026 asti, mutta paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.  Huomioithan että käsittelemme vain järjestelmäämme tulleet hakemukset.   Contact Person   Enna Cano Bernal Senior Specialist, HR enna.canobernal@georgfischer.com  Please submit your application via the ‘Apply’ button. The recruiter’s email is for enquiries only.

title: High End VIP Manager
description: MAIN OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE   （ジョブサマリー）   ハイエンドビジネスチームの一員としてVIP顧客との関係性強化、ブランドロイヤリティ向上によりハイエンドビジネスの持続的成長に貢献する。チーム戦略に連動したVIPリレーション施策の実行、ハイエンドビジネスを担っていく人材育成・開発を推進する。またカルティエアンバサダーとしてビジネスパートナー、各界著名人とCartierを繋ぎ、Cartier Japanのネットワーク拡大に寄与する。   Scope Of Responsibilities （役割責務）   ビジネスへの貢献範囲    VIPリレーションズシニアマネージャーと連携し、日本のVIP顧客戦略の立案・実行に貢献する。  海外VIPツアーまたは国内開催ディナーはリーダーとしてEvent Sales Promotionチーム(略称ESP)と連携し、ブランドの世界観、高品質で特別な体験の継続的な提供によりエンゲージメントを深める。
