既存VIP顧客のリテンション、アップグレード、リクルーティング強化のためにプロセス策定や最適化、エクスペリエンスの機会提供により顧客体験の向上・顧客との関係性強化をVIPリレーションズシニアマネージャー、ハイエンドコマーシャルシニアマネージャーと共にリーディングする。  VIP顧客情報の見える化とポテンシャルを加味したセールス実績に応じた適正な投資プランの計画・実行・効果検証まで一貫してブティックをサポートする。  中長期的な視点に立ち顧客関係構築力を高めることでハイエンドビジネスの持続的成長につなげる。    【アカウンタビリティと成果物】    ハイエンドセールス目標達成に貢献する。VIPツアーは顧客選定からプランニング、現地サポートまで一貫して実行する。  VIPプロジェクトデータベース、セグメントアップ策の実施により、VVIP・VIP顧客数を拡大させる。  インターメディアリーなど、社外のネットワークとのパイプを構築し、新規顧客の発掘、開拓を行う。    【意思決定】    VIP顧客関連における様々な施策の立案実行及び優先順位付けにおいてROIの観点を持ち意思決定をする。  VIP顧客用予算の費用対効果の最大化を目指す。  プロジェクトや業務の上で課題・障害が発生したときは問題を最小限に抑えタイムリーに解決する。複雑な問題に対処し、上長の指示を仰ぎながら意思決定を行う。    ORGANIZATION & PEOPLE  【組織開発】    ブティックとハイエンドチームの関係強化を促進し、VIP顧客のライフスタイルやマインドセットに対する理解をより深める。  コーチングを通じてインターナショナル及びローカルのハイエンドコミュニティメンバーを中心としたハイエンド人材の発掘・育成プロセスに深く関わる  インターナショナルプログラムにおける香港リージョナルオフィス、HQとのコミュニケーションを担い、橋渡しの役目を担う。    【チェンジマネジメント】    ラグジュアリーブランドやホスピタリティ業界、他ゾーンにおける顧客トリートメント施策、VIPリテンション施策の情報を収集分析し、戦略策定に活かす。  目標達成のための新たなアイデア・プロセスを考案・提案し実行する。    LEADERSHIP  【リーダーシップ責任】    ブティックメンバーの一人一人が個々のお客様に合ったクライアントジャーニーをデザインしていくというマインドセットを根付かせ、VIP顧客との関係性強化をリードする。  強化ブティックのVIP顧客対象にパーソナライズされた1to1トリートメントのプランニング、サポートをリードする。  VIPツアー及びHJイベントを軸としたVIP誘致イベントにおいて、BTQスタッフと協働で顧客満足度を高めることを目指し、ターゲティングから個々のトリートメント実施までサポートしターゲット達成する。  HQのハイエンドチームとの顧客関連のパイプ役の責任を担う。     【コラボレーション＆ステークホルダーマネジメント】    Strategic Planningチーム／ブティックマネジメントと連携してVIP顧客リストの可視化を行う（TOP150プロジェクト運用）。  各部門とのコラボレーション（セールス、マーケティング、クライアントチーム）と連携し、ハイエンドビジネスの開発・拡大、売上目標の達成に貢献する。  Event Sales Promotion(ESP)と顧客イベント、ディナーなどの年間計画プランニングを作成、実施のみならず、実施後のブティックフォローアップまで行う。  ガラディナーやカンパニディナーのプランニング・コンテンツのサポート、ご招待顧客のコーディネーション、シーティングプランをリードする。     Minimum Working Experience (実務経験)     実務経験10年以上、ラグジュアリーブランドでの経験が望ましい     Required Knowledge & Background（知識・経験）   【Must Haves】    クライアント・リレーションシップ・マネジメントの実務経験 （ラグジュアリーまたはハイエンドブランドでの経験があれば尚良し）  VIP顧客の対応経験、および売上目標の達成実績（プラス評価）  お客様一人ひとりに寄り添った、記憶に残る特別な体験を創造できる能力（重要）  顧客情報の管理、アプローチ履歴の把握、正確かつタイムリーなフォローアップを徹底するための、細部への細やかな配慮と高い管理・整理能力  ブランド独自の強み（ユニーク・セリング・ポイント）を言語化し、その提供価値をお客様へ効果的に伝えることができる能力    【Desirable if possible】    新規VIP顧客を能動的に開拓し、潜在的なハイポテンシャル顧客との関係性を構築・育成できること  CRM（顧客関係管理）システムまたは類似ツールの活用・操作スキル（あれば尚可）     Required Skills（スキル）   【Must Haves】    VIP顧客と効果的に信頼関係を築き、ニーズを深く理解し、長期的な関係性を確立するための、極めて優れた対人・関係構築能力 title: Junior Player Support Representative
description: Job Description   We're looking for a player-first, analytically curious  Junior Support Representative  who sees customer interactions as signals to understand, not just tickets to close. Essential     1+ years of customer-facing experience, ideally in a tech or digital environment  Hands-on experience with automations, triggers, macros, or workflow rules in a support, CRM, or no-code tool. Analytical curiosity — you ask why players are contacting us, not just how to close the ticket  Comfort using data and observation to back up suggestions and ideas  Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and critical judgment, and the confidence to challenge a process or a team when the evidence calls for it  Strong written and spoken English, with excellent communication across cultures  Familiarity with ticketing systems     Desirable     Experience in the gaming industry or passion for mobile games  Experience prompting, fine-tuning workflows around, or self-hosting AI customer-service tool

title: Customer Success Specialist – FreightOpt Oy
description: Customer Success Specialist – FreightOpt Oy     Haluatko työskennellä asiakkaiden kanssa ja olla mukana rakentamassa nopeasti kasvavaa suomalaista teknologiayritystä?      FreightOpt on B2B-yrityksille suunnattu digitaalinen kuljetuspalvelu, jonka avulla yritykset voivat vertailla, tilata ja seurata kuljetuksia helposti yhdestä paikasta. Kasvumme jatkuessa etsimme nyt tiimiimme  Customer Success Specialistia , joka auttaa uusia ja nykyisiä asiakkaitamme saamaan FreightOptista mahdollisimman paljon hyötyä.    Mitä työ pitää sisällään?    Customer Success Specialistina vastaat erityisesti uusien asiakkaiden onnistuneesta käyttöönotosta sekä nykyisten asiakkaiden aktivoinnista ja käytön kehittämisestä.     Työskentelet asiakkaidemme kanssa aktiivisesti  puhelimitse, etätapaamisissa ja sähköpostitse . Tavoitteesi on varmistaa, että asiakkaat pääsevät nopeasti alkuun, löytävät FreightOptista heille sopivat palvelut ja ottavat palvelun osaksi päivittäistä toimintaansa.     Tyypillisiä tehtäviäsi ovat esimerkiksi:      uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja käyttöönoton tukeminen  FreightOptin esittely ja asiakkaiden opastaminen etätapaamisissa  nykyisten asiakkaiden aktiivinen yhteydenpito ja käytön kasvattaminen  asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen ja ratkaisujen löytäminen yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa  tiivis yhteistyö myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja muun FreightOpt-tiimin kanssa  asiakaspalautteen välittäminen eteenpäin palvelumme kehittämiseksi     Mitä odotamme sinulta?    Etsimme ennen kaikkea aktiivista, oma-aloitteista ja asiakaslähtöistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy ihmisten kanssa ja uskaltaa tarttua puhelimeen.     Aikaisempi kokemus  asiakastyöstä, Customer Success -tehtävistä tai myynnistä  on eduksi, mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Arvostamme erityisesti hyvää asennetta, kommunikointitaitoja ja halua oppia.     Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Ruotsin, englannin ja viron kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.    Mitä tarjoamme?    Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin vahvasti kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja toimintatapojemme kehittämiseen. Kiinnostuitko?    Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus ja CV sekä kerro, miksi juuri tämä tehtävä voisi sopia sinulle.   Tule mukaan rakentamaan FreightOptin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta!

title: Host Manager

Genau deshalb können wir dir etwas anbieten, das sonst kaum jemand hat — du musst dich nicht vorher entscheiden.

Vogel unterstützt dich anschließend beim passenden Qualifikationsschritt — Master, Führungskarriere oder Berufsexamen, je nach Richtung. description:

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor — Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder ein vergleichbares Fach, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen, Controlling oder Prüfungswesen.   • Unser Ziel ist es, den IT-Nachwuchs auszubilden, den Deutschland für die Digitalisierung benötigt. Dafür brauchen wir dich als Verstärkung um unsere ambitionierten Wachstumsziele zu erreichen.

Wir suchen dich als Verstärkung unseres Teams als Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d). Du gewinnst über gezielte digitale Kampagnen qualifizierte Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer für unsere Weiterbildungen und entwickelst unser Marketing operativ wie strategisch weiter.

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung ein 7-stelliges Marketingbudget und behältst Performance und Effizienz im Blick
  • Du lieferst kreativen Input für Kampagnen, testest neue Formate, Kanäle und KI-Tools und treibst neue Ansätze voran

title: Client Growth Manager
description: BAZZAAL 소개  BAZZAAL은 브랜드의 미국 시장 진입과 성장을 돕는 🇰🇷 최고의 인플루언서 마케팅 전문 에이전시입니다.  서울 성수와 Los Angeles 오피스를 기반으로 K-beauty 브랜드의 크리에이터 시딩, Paid Influencer Campaign, TikTok Shop 등을 운영하고 있으며, 앞으로는 Beauty를 넘어 Lifestyle, Wellness 등 다양한 소비재 카테고리로 사업 영역을 확장하고 있습니다. 미국 현지 실행력과 한국 브랜드에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 캠페인 실행뿐 아니라 브랜드의 미국 시장 성장을 함께 고민합니다.     포지션 소개  Client Growth Manager는 담당 클라이언트의 첫 문의부터 제안, 계약, 캠페인 실행, 재계약 및 추가 성장까지 전 과정을 책임지는 역할입니다. CBO에게 직접 리포트하며, 단순히 클라이언트 요청을 전달하고 프로젝트를 관리하는 일반적인 Account Manager 역할과는 다릅니다.     클라이언트의 비즈니스를 이해하고 성장 기회를 찾으며, 시장과 데이터를 기반으로 필요한 전략을 먼저 제안할 수 있어야 합니다. 필요하다면 클라이언트의 기존 가정에도 다른 관점을 제시할 수 있는 분을 찾습니다. 전략과 디테일을 동시에 볼 수 있는 사람을 중요하게 생각합니다.     큰 방향을 설계하면서도 견적, 계약 조건, 일정, 클라이언트 요청사항, 캠페인 진행 상황과 후속 액션까지 놓치지 않아야 합니다. 여러 프로젝트가 동시에 진행되더라도 작은 오류가 쌓이지 않도록 끝까지 확인하고 결과에 책임지는 분을 선호합니다.     주요 업무  Account Growth  담당 클라이언트의 유지, 재계약 및 추가 매출을 책임집니다. 기존 Account 안에서 새로운 협업 기회를 발굴하고 매출 Pipeline과 Forecast를 관리합니다.     Client Strategy  브랜드의 비즈니스, 카테고리와 미국 시장 진출 단계를 이해하고 목적에 맞는 Influencer Marketing 및 Social Commerce 전략을 설계합니다. 시장, Creator, 경쟁사에 대한 인사이트를 실제 실행 가능한 제안으로 연결합니다.     Commercial Ownership  클라이언트의 목표를 구체적인 Campaign Scope와 Budget으로 설계하고, 제안서 작성, 견적, 가격 협상, 계약 체결까지 전 과정을 주도합니다. 프로젝트의 성장성과 함께 적정 수익성도 관리합니다.     Campaign Delivery  프로젝트 시작부터 종료까지 클라이언트의 주요 담당자로 커뮤니케이션합니다. 내부 팀과 협업하며 일정, Deliverables, Creator Target과 주요 조건을 관리하고 문제가 발생하기 전에 Risk를 발견하고 해결합니다.     AI 활용 및 업무 개선  리서치, 제안서, 미팅 준비, Client Communication, Reporting 등 일상적인 업무에 AI를 적극적으로 활용합니다. 단순히 AI Tool을 사용하는 것을 넘어, AI를 활용해 기존 업무 방식을 더 빠르고 정확하게 개선할 수 있는 분을 기대합니다.     이 역할에서 중요하게 보는 결과  • 담당 Account의 매출 유지 및 성장  • 높은 재계약 및 반복 협업 비율  • 일정, 범위와 수익성을 지키는 안정적인 Campaign Delivery  • 클라이언트에게 단순한 실무 담당자가 아닌 Strategic Partner로 신뢰받는 것  • 큰 그림을 보면서도 중요한 디테일을 놓치지 않는 것     이런 분을 찾습니다  • Account Management, Client Servicing, Business Development, Consulting 또는 관련 업무 3년 이상의 경험  • 담당 클라이언트를 직접 맡아 제안, 견적, 가격 협상, 계약 및 프로젝트 실행까지 경험해본 분  • Influencer Marketing 및 Social Commerce에 대한 실무적인 이해가 있는 분  • 클라이언트의 목표를 현실적인 프로젝트 범위와 예산으로 구체화할 수 있는 비즈니스 감각을 갖춘 분  • 여러 Account와 Deadline을 동시에 관리하면서도 숫자, 일정, 조건과 후속 업무의 작은 디테일까지 놓치지 않는 분  • 누가 지속적으로 확인하지 않아도 스스로 우선순위를 정하고 업무를 끝까지 가져갈 수 있는 분  • AI를 일상적인 업무에 적극적으로 활용하고 새로운 업무 방식을 빠르게 학습할 수 있는 분  • 한국어로 클라이언트 미팅을 주도하고 제안서 및 비즈니스 문서를 작성할 수 있는 수준의 커뮤니케이션 능력  • 미국 오피스 및 파트너와 업무상 원활하게 소통할 수 있는 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력     우대 사항  • 글로벌 시장에 진출하는 한국 브랜드와 직접 일해본 경험  • Beauty, Lifestyle, Wellness 등 소비재 카테고리 관련 경험  • HubSpot, Notion, Monday.com, Airtable 등 CRM 및 업무 관리 Tool 사용 경험  • AI와 Automation을 활용해 실제 업무 프로세스를 개선해본 경험     근무 조건  • 고용 형태: 정규직  • 수습 기간: 3개월  • 근무지: 서울 성수 오피스  • 출근 형태: 오피스 근무 + 하이브리드  • 근무 시간: 오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시     보상  경력과 역량에 따라 업계에서 경쟁력 있는 수준의 보상을 제공합니다.  높은 수준의 Ownership을 가지고 Leadership과 직접 협업하며, BAZZAAL이 K-beauty를 넘어 더 다양한 소비재 카테고리로 확장하는 과정에 함께하게 됩니다.     채용 절차  서류 심사 → 1차 화상 면접 → 2차 대면 면접 → 처우 협의 및 레퍼런스 체크  • 1차 면접은 화상으로 진행합니다.  • 2차 면접은 서울 성수 오피스에서 대면으로 진행합니다.  • 최종 단계에서 처우 협의 및 후보자 동의 하에 레퍼런스 체크를 진행합니다.     지원 방법  LinkedIn을 통해 지원하거나 아래 이메일로 Resume 또는 경력사항을 보내주세요.  yong@bazzaal.com     메일

title: CUSTOMER OPERATIONS MANAGER
description: À propos  Santé Académie, c’est la plateforme qui repense les codes de la formation continue des professionnels de santé pour leur proposer une expérience d’apprentissage collaborative avec un format multi-modal : e-learning, classes virtuelles et présentiel.  La connaissance médicale évolue de plus en plus vite (nouvelles pathologies, nouveaux traitements, nouvelles technologies, etc.) : on estime que 50% de la connaissance médicale devient obsolète après 7 ans. A cela s’ajoute un manque structurel de médecins sur tout le territoire, nécessitant la montée en compétence de chaque strate des métiers de la santé : le médecin généraliste doit mener des consultations de pédiatrie ou de gynéco pour combler le manque de spécialistes, l’infirmier.ère suit des patients diabétiques pour désengorger le cabinet du médecin, etc.  Alors comment former en continu 2 millions de soignant.e.s pour répondre à ces défis, en tenant compte de leurs contraintes ? Comment favoriser le transfert de compétences à grande échelle : de l’hôpital vers la ville, du spécialiste vers le généraliste, du médecin vers d’autres professionnels de santé (infirmier.ère, pharmacien.ne, sage-femme…) ?  Santé Académie a imaginé la solution d’apprentissage de demain, en digital learning : des formations vidéo de qualité cinématographique – avec une équipe de prod’ directement intégrée en interne - accessible via web ou application mobile. Chacune des formations est réalisée avec les meilleurs expert.e.s de la thématique, venant d’institutions de référence en recherche clinique.  La mission de Santé Académie ? Offrir aux soignant.e.s une formation continue à la hauteur de leur engagement, à la pointe de la connaissance et directement accessible via leur smartphone ! Pour améliorer la prévention, le diagnostic, la prise en charge et l’orientation des patients et ainsi construire la santé de demain !  Santé Académie a déjà formé plus de 20 000 professionnels de santé et noué des partenariats avec des établissements de santé de renom tels que le GHU Paris ou l'Hôpital des Armées.  Descriptif du poste  Tu rejoins l'équipe Opérations de Santé Académie, qui assure l'intégralité de l'après-vente formation : du suivi des apprenants jusqu'à la facturation des financeurs, en passant par le customer success B2B et la coordination des sessions synchrones.  Tu encadres directement 4 personnes, organisées en 3 pôles complémentaires :    Care apprenant : accompagnement et suivi individuel des apprenants ; sessions et dossiers financeurs (ANDPC, OPCO, FIFPL)  Customer success B2B : relation post-vente avec les clients établissements  Coordination des formations synchrones : planification des sessions, relation formateurs, organisation logistique, suivi des apprenants    Tu arrives à un moment clé : la croissance s'accélère, les règles financeurs changent souvent, et il faut transformer en profondeur la façon dont l'équipe travaille pour absorber le volume sans sacrifier le bien-être. title: Eats Account Manager (Food) 팀매니저 채용
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.  쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.  분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.      팀/직무 소개   AM(Account Management)팀은 Coupang Eats내 파트너사의 GMV 스케일업을 최우선으로 이끄는 성장 전담 조직입니다.  상품 라인업 확장과 스토어 활성화, 우수 스토어 획득(Store Tiering), Order 수량 증대, CX (고객 경험) 품질 개선에 이르기까지 종합적인 비즈니스 컨설팅을 제공하여 파트너사의 쿠팡 내 성공을 가속화합니다.      업무 내용    파트너사 세그먼트별 차등화된 액션 플랜 실행을 통한 Account GMV 성장 및 이탈 방지  입점 후 온보딩, 운영, 해지에 이르는 셀러 라이프사이클 전반의 포트폴리오 관리  출고 및 CS 지표 개선을 통한 스토어 CX(고객 경험) 품질 및 거래 건전성 제고  GMV 가속화를 위한 프로젝트성 이니셔티브 기획 및 밀도 높은 커뮤니케이션 실행       자격   요건    5년 이상 이커머스 또는 리테일 환경에서 Account Management 및 매출(GMV) 성장을 주도한 분  전화 및 비대면 채널을 활용한 밀도 높은 커뮤니케이션으로 상대방 (대표, 고객 등)의 실질적인 실행을 이끌어낼 수 있는 분  고객 경험 (CX), 출고/CS 등 스토어 운영 품질 지표를 진단하고 개선해 본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반으로 파트너사 세그먼트를 분류하고 우선순위에 따른 비즈니스 리텐션 전략을 실행해 본 분  입점부터 운영, 해지 방지까지 셀러 라이프사이클 전반에 대한 이해도를 갖춘 분       우대   사항    쿠팡 셀러 생태계, 주요 스토어 운영 지표 및 CX 관리 프로세스에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유한 분  대면 미팅 및 Call 기반의 세일즈 및 포트폴리오 케어 경험이 있는 분  세그먼트별 차등화된 프로모션, Pricing, 마케팅 연계 프로젝트를 주도해 본 경험이 있는 분  Excel, SQL, Tableau 등 데이터 분석 도구를 활용해 성장 기회를 도출할 수 있는 분  주요 파트너사/C-Level 대상의 비즈니스 서밋, 프랜차이즈 얼라이언스 행사 등 파트너십 강화를 위한 얼라이언스 이벤트 기획 및 호스팅 경험이 있는 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차    서류전형(리크루터 사전 인터뷰) - 1차면접 - 2차면접 - 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.     참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.       개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/       서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.  단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Leder PMCW (Ports, Marine, Coastal & Waterways)
description: Jobbeskrivelse   Vil du være med å forme fremtidens havner og kystinfrastruktur i Norge?  Ønsker du å lede prosjekter som gjør en reell forskjell for klima, miljø og samfunn?  Vil du bygge opp et ledende fagmiljø der dine ideer får direkte påvirkning på store og viktige prosjekter?   Bli drivkraften bak Rambølls satsing i Norge   Rambøll styrker nå satsingen innen Ports, Marine, Coastal & Waterways, og vi søker en avdelingsleder som vil utvikle markedet, drive faglig ledelse og forme fremtidens løsninger i skjæringspunktet mellom infrastruktur, klima og bærekraft. Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å kombinere faglig tyngde, strategisk innflytelse og reell samfunnseffekt.   Din nye rolle   Som leder får du et strategisk mandat: Du skal bygge Rambølls posisjon i et marked i vekst, identifisere nye muligheter og etablere sterke relasjoner til kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Samtidig vil du trekke på global kompetanse og internasjonale prosjekter for å løfte norske løsninger til neste nivå. Rollen har i første fase hovedfokus på faglig utvikling, markedsbygging og koordinering av teamet, og vil over tid kunne utvikles til en mer tradisjonell lederrolle dersom det er naturlig og ønskelig.  Du blir en sentral pådriver for et engasjert og tverrfaglig fagmiljø som jobber med alt fra havner og marine konstruksjoner til kystsoneløsninger og vannveier. Her vil du se resultatene av arbeidet ditt i prosjekter som påvirker byutvikling, transport og miljø.   Dine viktigste ansvarsområder      Drive utviklingen av nye forretningsmuligheter og styrke Rambølls posisjon innen havner, marine konstruksjoner og kystinfrastruktur  Bygge og opprettholde sterke relasjoner med kunder, offentlige aktører og samarbeidspartnere  Lede prosjekter og bidra i store tilbud med høye krav til kvalitet og innovasjon  Utvikle og implementere strategi for PMCW-satsningen i Norge  Sikre en solid pipeline av spennende prosjekter og muligheter  Bidra til faglig ledelse og koordinering av fagmiljøet      Om deg      Erfaring fra maritim sektor, havneutvikling, kystteknikk eller beslektede fagområder  Dokumentert erfaring med prosjektledelse eller linjeledelse  Sterke relasjonsbyggende ferdigheter og god forståelse for kundebehov  Strategisk tankegang og motivasjon for å utvikle både marked og fagmiljø      Hva vi tilbyr      Fleksible arbeidsforhold med mulighet for hjemmekontor  Et selskap som investerer i din utvikling og tilbyr tydelige lederprinsipper  Inspirerende kollegaer og prosjekter som gjør en forskjell for samfunnet  Globalt fagmiljø med tilgang til eksperter og internasjonale erfaringer  Et selskap med bærekraft som kjerne og langsiktig perspektiv  Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger  Mulighet for internasjonale oppdrag og samarbeid  Treningsavtale for ansatte      Har du lyst til å bli en del av Rambøll? title: Head of Segment, Industrial OEM Sales
description: Rakennamme teollisuuden ja kriittisen infrastruktuurin kestävää tulevaisuutta tehokkaasti ja turvallisesti. Sähköistyksen, instrumentoinnin, automaation ja digitalisaation elinkaarikumppanina parannamme asiakkaidemme tuottavuutta, toimintavarmuutta ja vastuullisuutta. Luotettavat ja laadukkaat ratkaisumme koostuvat laaja-alaisesta teknologiaosaamisesta, joustavasta toteutuksesta, muutosta vauhdittavista ohjelmistoista sekä ennakoivista ylläpito- ja elinkaaripalveluista.   Haemme  segmentinjohtajaa myyntiorganisaatioomme  vahvistamaan kasvavaa Insta Industrya.   Tässä roolissa vastaat oman koneenrakennuksen (OEM) asiakassegmenttisi kaupallisesta menestyksestä, kasvusta ja kehittämisestä.  Vastaat segmentin myyntitavoitteiden laatimisesta yhdessä myynti- ja markkinointijohtajan kanssa sekä varmistat myyntiputken hallinnan, ennusteiden laadun ja tavoitteiden toteutumisen. Kehität segmentin tarjoamaa markkina- ja kilpailijaymmärrykseen perustuen tiiviissä yhteistyössä liiketoimintayksiköidemme kanssa.   Johdat segmentin 2-3 myyntipäällikköä kohti kunnianhimoisia, mutta realistisesti saavutettavia myyntitavoitteita kohden . Toimit merkittävimpien asiakkuuksien omistajana sekä ohjaat strategista asiakkuudenhallintaa ja uusasiakashankintaa. Tavoitteesi on rakentaa pitkäjänteistä kasvua, vahvistaa asiakastyytyväisyyttä ja varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat liiketoimintaansa kestävää lisäarvoa koko elinkaaren ajan.  Tulet osaksi osaavaa ja aikaansaavaa myynti- ja markkinointitiimiämme ja työskentelet tiiviisti liiketoimintayksiköiden, talouden, hankinnan, laadun sekä muiden keskeisten sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa. Tunnistat aktiivisesti uusia kaupallisia kasvumahdollisuuksia ja kehität myyntimalleja sekä toimintatapoja yhteistyössä myyntijohtajan kanssa.  Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Toimipisteesi voi sijaita jollakin Insta Industryn paikkakunnista kuten Tampereella, Vantaalla, Raisiossa, Muuramessa, Oulussa, Kokkolassa tai Kuopiossa. Tarjoamme luonnollisesti mahdollisuuden hybridityöhön. Työ sisältää matkustamista erityisesti Suomessa sekä toisinaan kansainvälisesti. Tehtävän kuukausipalkasta ja vuosittaisesta bonus-osasta koostuva palkkaus määräytyy kyvykkyytesi, kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi pohjalta.   MIKSI INSTA INDUSTRYLLE?   Installa sinua odottavat automaation, instrumentoinnin, sähköistyksen, digitalisaation ja kyberturvallisuuden osaavat asiantuntijat. Yhdessä tekeminen, halu kehittyä ja hyvä työporukka ovat suurin vahvuutemme. Kasvamme tavoitteellisesti useilla markkinasektoreilla Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti. Olemme:   Yhteiskunnan turvallistaja  - turvaamme Installa kriittisen infrastruktuurin kuten energiatuotannon, sähköverkkojen ja puhtaan veden jatkuvuutta. Yli 3 miljoonaa suomalaista on vesihuollon järjestelmiemme piirissä.   Kokonaistoimitusten vahva osaaja  - hallitsemme ja toteutamme automaation, sähköistyksen ja digitalisaation kokonaisprosessin suunnittelusta asennuksiin, käyttöön ja kunnossapitoon asiakkaidemme luotettun

title: Technical Account Manager (IT)
description: It usually starts like this.  You're grabbing a coffee at your favourite cafe, pretending you're just "checking emails," when in reality you're solving three client problems, calming down a fourth, and wondering if there's a role out there where you could actually  shape  things instead of just reacting to them.  Good news, there is.   About First Focus   First Focus has spent the last  nine years  being recognised by Cloudtango as  Australia's #1 mid-market Managed Service Provider . While the award might have been earned across the Tasman, the standards, culture, and customer experience that got us there are exactly what we're bringing to New Zealand. (And after nine years of winning, we're starting to think we might actually need a bigger trophy cabinet.)  We're now pushing close to  500 people globally , and just when things were getting interesting, we've announced our  merger with Integris . Which means we're about to become one of the largest and broadest SMB MSPs on the planet.  No pressure.  What that actually means for you is simple: bigger clients, broader capability, more opportunity, and a front-row seat to something genuinely exciting, without losing the culture that got us here in the first place.  We're still a business where people know your name, where leadership is accessible, and where being  informed, aligned, supported, and rewarded  isn't just a slide in a deck, it's how things actually run day to day. You can read more about how we think about that here: https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/. And yep, we know everyone has these, but here we hire by them, reward by them, and make business decisions using them.   The Role   This role is for someone who's a bit tired of being "the account manager" or "the consultant" and would quite like to be both, properly.  You'll operate as a  trusted advisor and Technical Account Manager , working with a range of SMB and mid-market clients, some approaching 500 seats, partnering directly with senior stakeholders and the C-suite. You won't just manage relationships, you'll shape them.  The way this role plays out is not fixed. There's no dusty playbook to follow. You get to build this role in a way that actually makes sense, for you and for your clients.  You'll help organisations navigate complexity, make smarter decisions, and turn business priorities into practical technology roadmaps that actually get delivered. You'll lead strategic conversations, help clients plan what's next, and occasionally stop them from buying something they absolutely do not need (they'll thank you later).  If you've ever wanted to have a bigger impact, this is where you stop saying it and start doing it.   Why You'll Love It Here     You'll have real autonomy, not the "empowered within strict boundaries" kind  You'll work with established SMB and mid-market clients who expect, and value, proper thinking  You'll help shape your clients' technology strategy and roadmap, not just report on it  You'

title: Partner Enablement Manager
description: Retire the ERP   Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.  We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.  We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.  Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.   About The Role   Light doesn't implement Light alone anymore. Accounting and consulting firms, from regional champions to global names, are building Light implementation practices, and someone has to make their people as good at implementing Light as we are. That's you.  You'll be the product expert at the centre of Light's partner programme. You train partner teams, certify them, sit beside them on their first client deliveries, and stay their expert lifeline as they scale. Your audience is partner implementation teams and the leaders who run them, plus their clients' Financial Controllers, Finance Directors, and CFOs on joint deliveries. Senior, technical, time-poor. They expect you to keep up on multi-entity accounting, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency, and statutory reporting, and to tell them straight when an approach won't work.  No two partners look the same. Every activation brings questions without a textbook answer: a consolidation edge case on a partner's client, a migration shape the playbook doesn't cover, a delivery habit that needs rebuilding before it can be certified. You'll work the problem, teach the answer, capture it in the curriculum, and move on to the next one. The difference from pure delivery work: you don't ship one implementation, you make many happen through others.   Key Responsibilities     Be the product expert: know every corner of Light, demo any workflow credibly, and answer the hard configuration and accounting questions partners bring you. title: Implementation Lead
description: About Kernel   Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?     Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.     Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.     Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout  already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.     We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.      Your Role   As an  Implementation Lead , you're the bridge between customer needs and technical execution in enterprise deals. You translate complex requirements into practical, high-impact solutions, ensuring every proof of concept is accurate, scalable and positioned for success.     Working closely with Account Executives, Product and Engineering, you'll navigate technical questions, troubleshoot complex challenges and shape solutions that drive value for our clients. With new features shipping constantly at Kernel, you'll stay ahead of client requirements and the latest market innovation. title: Product Manager - Quest Platform
description:

We are looking for a Product Manager to own and develop the Quest Platform — a major company initiative that consolidates all quest-related functionality in one place and integrates it across all Xsolla products. This includes quests within products such as Web Shop, Xsolla Player, and Cloud Gaming. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, and cross-product teams to create engaging quest experiences, drive user engagement, and ensure seamless integration across all Xsolla products.

From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
 
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

  • Create and manage new quests within the platform, acting as its primary advocate
  • Oversee quest UI implementation 
  • Define and track key product metrics (engagement, completion rates, retention impact)
  • Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Company Description  Kreality specializes in helping established B2B service businesses recover opportunities hidden in their existing lead databases. Many organizations have dormant inquiries, stalled proposals, and unfinished conversations sitting in their CRM, representing sunk acquisition costs and missed revenue. Kreality’s Lead Revival system reactivates this pipeline by identifying the right lead cohorts, rebuilding sales context, running personalized outreach, handling responses, and booking qualified calls directly into internal sales calendars. The commercial model is closely aligned with client results, combining a fee per qualified call with a success-based percentage on attributable collected revenue. Kreality primarily serves agencies, consultancies, managed IT providers, recruitment firms, and similar B2B service organizations with proven offers and robust sales capabilities.  Role Description  The Customer Success Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Melbourne, VIC. This role is responsible for onboarding new clients, guiding them through the Lead Revival process, and ensuring they achieve measurable outcomes from pipeline recovery efforts. Day-to-day activities include managing client relationships, understanding their CRM data and sales processes, coordinating campaign timelines, and communicating results and insights clearly. The Customer Success Manager will monitor key performance indicators, address issues proactively, facilitate feedback loops with internal teams, and support continuous improvement in service delivery. This role works closely with sales, operations, and technical teams to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term retention.  Qualifications     Strong customer service and customer satisfaction skills, with a focus on delivering consistent value and positive client experiences.  Customer retention and relationship building capabilities to foster long-term partnerships and drive renewals and expansions.  Analytical skills to interpret CRM data, campaign performance metrics, and revenue outcomes, and to translate insights into actionable recommendations.  Experience managing B2B client accounts, ideally within agencies, consultancies, or other service-based environments.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex processes in clear, practical terms.  Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and coordinate multiple client projects simultaneously.  Comfort working with CRM systems and sales tools; experience with data reporting or dashboards is advantageous.  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

ROI（AIをROIに変える）」をミッションとして掲げています。現在はアジア太平洋地域、ヨーロッパ、アメリカを含む17拠点を展開し、東京証券取引所（証券コード：4180）に上場しています。  Appierは、AI Agentを活用し、企業のマーケティングDX・データ活用・顧客体験（CX）の変革を支援する次世代AIプラットフォームを提供しています。   提供ソリューション    Appier AI Marketing Agent Platform   Appierは、AI Agentを中心としたオールインワンのマーケティングプラットフォームを提供しています。  企業が保有する顧客データをAIが理解・分析し、マーケティング施策の企画から実行、最適化までをAI Agentが支援します。  データ基盤、予測AI、マーケティングオートメーション、マルチチャネルコミュニケーション、生成AIによるクリエイティブ制作までを一つのプラットフォームで提供し、お客様のマーケティングROI最大化を実現します。   AIQUA（アイコア）   AI Agentを活用し、Web・アプリ・メール・LINE・Push通知など複数チャネルにおいて、一人ひとりに最適化された顧客体験を自動で実現するマーケティングオートメーションプラットフォームです。   BotBonnie（ボットボニー）   LINEをはじめとするSNSやWebチャットを活用し、AI Agentによる顧客コミュニケーションを実現するマルチチャネルマーケティングソリューションです。   AIRIS（アイリス）   AI Agentの意思決定を支えるPredictive Customer Data Platform（CDP）です。  顧客データを統合するだけでなく、AIによる予測分析を通じて顧客の将来行動やニーズを予測し、最適なマーケティング施策や顧客体験の実現を支援します。   AdCreative.ai（アドクリエイティブ・エーアイ）   生成AIを活用し、高品質な広告クリエイティブを自動生成・最適化するAIクリエイティブプラットフォームです。   ポジション概要   Customer Success Managerとして、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを導入いただいた日本国内の企業を担当し、お客様がプラットフォームから最大の成果を引き出せるよう、導入から定着、そして事業成果の創出までを伴走していただきます。  本ポジションは、問い合わせに対応するサポート業務ではありません。  お客様のマーケティング課題とKPIを深く理解した上で、AI また、プロダクト・エンジニアリングチームは台北を中心としたグローバル体制です。日本のお客様の声を製品開発に届け、機能改善の優先度を動かしていくことも、CSMの重要な役割です。   主な業務内容     担当アカウントのオンボーディングをリードし、初期の成果創出（Time to Value の最短化）を実現する  お客様のマーケティング課題・KPIを理解し、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを活用した施策を設計・実行・改善する  セグメント設計、シナリオ構築、配信設定、効果検証まで、プラットフォーム上で手を動かしながらお客様と伴走する  利用状況・成果データをモニタリングし、活用が進んでいない領域を能動的に特定して改善提案を行う  経営層・マーケティング部門・IT部門など多様なステークホルダーと信頼関係を構築し、QBRを主導する  担当アカウントの契約継続に責任を持ち、アップセル・クロスセルの機会を創出してアカウントを成長させる  タグ・SDK実装やデータ連携に関する技術的な論点を切り分け、お客様の技術担当者や社内テックチームと連携して解決に導く About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it.
This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

title: Operations Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Steuerberatung ist ein operatives Geschäft. Jede Buchung, jede Lohnabrechnung, jeder Abschluss folgt einem Ablauf – und die meisten dieser Abläufe wurden nie systematisch hinterfragt. Sie funktionieren, weil erfahrene Menschen ihre Workarounds kennen, nicht weil sie durchdacht sind. Genau das ist der Hebel, der in dieser Branche noch niemandem gehört.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und entwickelt sie weiter, statt sie einzuschmelzen. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Das funktioniert nur, wenn darunter etwas steht, das trägt: Prozesse, die an jedem Standort gleich laufen, Technologie, die im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt wird, und eine Integration, die bei der fünften Übernahme schneller geht als bei der ersten. Diese Schicht baust du. Sie existiert heute nicht.

Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem Aufbau operativer Systeme mit – aus einem B2B-Scaleup, einem Company Builder, einer Beratung mit eigener Umsetzungsverantwortung oder aus deiner eigenen Gründung. Du wechselst, weil dein Mandat kleiner geworden ist als deine Verarbeitungskraft: zu viel Abstimmung, zu wenig Hebel, zu viele Konzepte, die andere umsetzen. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil von beidem – Strukturen, die tragen, mit etablierten Mandanten und einer starken Wachstumsbasis, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest Operations bei Vogel in ganzer Breite: die Automatisierung der Abläufe im Kerngeschäft, die internen Werkzeuge und die Datenarchitektur, die IT- und Identitäts-Infrastruktur samt Endgeräten und Sicherheit, die technische Integration jeder übernommenen Einheit und die Abläufe rund um Eintritt, Vertrag, Systeme und Austritt unserer eigenen Leute. Du baust das Team, das diese Themen trägt, und verteilst die Schwerpunkte dari

title: Wirtschaftsprüfer / Accounting Lead Buy & Build (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Wer Beratungsunternehmen zukauft, kauft sich Konsolidierungskreise ein – und in den meisten mittelständischen Strukturen ist das Rechnungswesen dafür nie gebaut worden, sondern über Jahre gewachsen.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland – mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen organisch und durch Zukäufe und bauen daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand. Jeder Zukauf bringt eine neue Gesellschaft, eine Eröffnungsbilanz, eine Kaufpreisallokation und einen erweiterten Konsolidierungskreis mit. Damit das trägt, braucht es jemanden, bei dem niemand mehr nachrechnet, ob der Konzernabschluss steht.

Du bist bestellter Wirtschaftsprüfer oder stehst unmittelbar vor dem Examen, mit vier oder mehr Jahren Audit bei einer der großen oder der nächstgrößeren Prüfungsgesellschaften und echter Konzernabschluss-Tiefe. Du wechselst, weil die nächste Stufe in der Prüfungshierarchie mehr Review und weniger eigene Arbeit bedeutet – und weil du die Zahlen lieber verantwortest, als sie zu testieren. Bei Vogel findest du Strukturen, die tragen, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest das Rechnungswesen von Vogel – Konsolidierung und Konzernabschluss, das laufende Rechnungswesen über alle Gesellschaften, dessen Automatisierung und das externe Reporting an Banken und Stakeholder. Du berichtest direkt an Joachim und Moritz Vogel; am Standort München entsteht die Finance-Funktion gerade erst, und du bist ihr fachlicher Anker. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn – oder, wenn du das willst, in den Aufbau eines eigenen Teams.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Agents, Evals & Reliability
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics,

title: Senior Client Success Partner- Care Gap & Coding Automation
description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. Care Gap & Coding Automation (CGCA) is Qventus’ newest product line — a generative AI solution that helps health systems close documentation and coding gaps that drive material quality and financial outcomes. Our first condition in the market is malnutrition, with additional conditions on the near-term roadmap.

CGCA is in an early and pivotal stage of its product lifecycle. We have a beta product live at a number of partner sites and are iterating quickly toward a confirmed, sellable scope. Each implementation directly shapes the product, the playbook, and the commercial model — including a free 2-month pilot structure that converts to a paid contract on the strength of demonstrated outcomes.

As a Client Success Partner on the CGCA team, you will sit inside Product and act as the face of CGCA to our earliest clients. You will own the end-to-end client experience during the pilot and early production phases — managing the implementation, building deep relationships with clinical leaders and frontline dietitians, ensuring pilots convert, and feeding learnings directly back into product strategy. You will also play a defining role in productizing what we learn: building the implementation playbook and standing up our Delivery team to eventually own this work as CGCA reaches general availability.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, wants to help build a product line from the ground up, and is energized by working hand-in-hand with clinicians.

  • Own the implementation end-to-end. Lead CGCA pilots and early production deployments in partnership with a Technical Implementation Manager who owns the technical implementation. You establish credibility with client leaders so they trust you to guide the launch - diagnose current-state workflows, build the launch strategy based on each site’s realities, and partner with Product on any adjustments needed for that client to succeed.

title: Engineering Manager, Ads
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

The Ads Engineering organization at Mozilla builds privacy-respecting advertising systems that support Mozilla’s products and business while aligning with our mission and values. Our teams focus on reliable, scalable systems that enable advertising experiences across Mozilla products.

As an Engineering Manager on Ads Engineering, you will lead a team of software engineers working on Firefox Suggest Ads, the sponsored suggestion experiences within Firefox Suggest. This team builds and operates backend services, partner integrations, experimentation capabilities, and product-facing systems that help deliver relevant sponsored suggestions in Firefox while respecting user privacy and product quality expectations.

You’ll be responsible for building a healthy, effective team; partnering closely with Product, Data, Privacy, Policy, Revenue, and Firefox engineering stakeholders; and ensuring your team delivers high-quality software in support of Ads Engineering goals.

This role balances people leadership, execution, and collaboration, with a strong emphasis on mentoring engineers, navigating ambiguity, delivering results, and fostering a positive, inclusive team culture.

What you’ll do:

  • Mentor, support, and develop a team of software engineers, helping them grow in impact and craft
  • Lead your team through the delivery of Firefox Suggest Ads initiatives, including backend services, partner integrations, experimentation, measurement, reliability improvements, and product-facing integrations where requirements may evolve as privacy, policy, user experience, and business constraints become clearer
  • Partner with product managers and cross-functional stakeholders to navigate ambiguity, particularly where user data, privacy expectations, or policy considerations shape technical and product decisions

title: Asiakkuusjohtaja, OP Yrityspankki, Suuret yritysasiakkaat
description: Tule meille kollegaksi   Haemme OP Yrityspankkiin Helsinkiin toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Asiakkuusjohtajaa.   Tehtävästä   Vastaat OP Yrityspankin suurimpien yritysasiakkuuksien johtamisesta, asiakaskokemuksesta ja kannattavuudesta yhdessä työparisi kanssa. Johdat matriisissa ammattitaitoista asiakkuustiimiä vastaten OP Pohjolan tarjoamien pankkipalveluiden myynnistä sekä tuloksesta ja tavoitteiden toteutumisesta.  Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden sekä eri liiketoimintojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa varmistaen asiakkaiden tarpeisiin vastaavat kokonaisvaltaiset ratkaisut.  Tärkein päämäärämme on ratkaista asiakkaidemme tarpeet laadukkaasti ja kattavasti. Teemme töitä hybridimallissa joustavasti, asiakastyö ja työtilanteet huomioiden.   Millaista osaamista etsimme?   Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on monipuolinen ja vahva osaaminen rahoitusalalta sekä näyttöä työskentelystä suurten tai keskisuurten yritysasiakkaiden parissa. Osaaminen kauppa- ja energiasektoreilta katsotaan eduksesi. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto ja työskentelet sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi, ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.  Olet aktiivinen ja nautit työskentelystä lähellä asiakasta. Sinulla on vahvat analyyttiset taidot ja pystyt tuottamaan lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme – tunnistat ratkaisumahdollisuuksia sekä riskejä tarkastelemalla liiketoimintaa. Sinulla on kokemusta yritysrahoituksesta tai muusta suuryritysasiakkuuksiin liittyvästä liiketoiminnasta. Lisäksi sinulla on kokemusta laajojen asiakkuuskokonaisuuksien johtamisesta matriisimaisessa toimintaympäristössä.  Osaat rakentaa ja ylläpitää menestyviä verkostoja sekä toimia haastavissa neuvottelutilanteissa. Intohimosi on menestyä työssäsi ja saada tuloksia aikaiseksi yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.   Me tarjoamme   Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä OP Yrityspankin merkittävimpien yritysasiakkuuksien parissa sekä hyödyntää työssäsi koko OP Pohjolan laajaa asiantuntija- ja palveluverkostoa. Saat tueksesi kokeneet kollegat ja monipuoliset mahdollisuudet syventää osaamistasi suuryritysasiakkuuksien johtamisessa.  Vastuullisen työn vastapainoksi pidämme huolen työhyvinvoinnistasi ja tulevaisuuteen katsovista työjärjestelyistä. Tarjoamme sinulle vakaan ympäristön, jossa vastuullisuus, ihmisläheisyys ja yhdessä menestyminen ovat keskeisiä arvoja.  Saat käyttöösi monipuoliset henkilöstöetumme, johon kuuluvat mm. henkilökuntaehtoiset pankki-, vakuutus- ja lainapalvelut. Tarjoamme myös kattavan työterveyshuollon, laajan hoitokuluvakuutuksen sekä täysajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Työssäjaksamiseen panostamme arjen tasapainolla ja joustavuudella sekä tarjoamalla käyttöösi lounas-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä mahdollisuuden edulliseen lomailuun OP Pohjolan lomaosakkeissa.   Lisätiedot ja hakuohjeet   Haluaisitko vaihtaa ajatuksia tehtävästä tai meillä työskentelystä? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa johtaja Sami Hussi, p. 050 344 5892 to 6.8. klo 11.30-13.00, pe 14.8. klo 08.00-09

title: Senior Account Manager, Partner Success
description: Who we are   We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.     Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. Collaborate with partners to define and refine a clear strategic roadmap, establishing measurable milestones and key objectives.  Take ownership of critical meetings, driving discussions, decision-making, and follow-through to ensure successful outcomes. Act as the main point of escalation for partner issues, proactively addressing challenges and ensuring swift resolutions to maintain strong, productive relationships.      Who you are    Ideally native or C2 level in German & English. Excellent written and oral communication skills with all levels of the organisation.  Highly organised with great attention to detail,

title: Partnership & Activation Manager (f, m, d)
description: Your playground   We are looking for a hands-on Partnership & Activation Manager to turn our signed B2B(2C) partnerships into real, engaged end users. Hello Inside works with strong partners – private & public health insurance, pharma and pharmacy, employers and platforms – who give us access to their members and customers. Your job starts where the contract is signed: you take each partnership live and then keep it working. You bring partners from signing into launch, design and run recurring activation campaigns through their channels, and make sure their members actually discover, sign up for, and stay with Hello Inside. You will monitor user engagement and health outcomes for our partners. For you, a signed deal is the starting line, not the finish. If you're excited to be part of a purpose-driven and winning team, Hello Inside is a great place to grow your career. title: Customer Onboarding Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 다른 플랫폼에서 비즈니스를 만들어온 고객사들이 아임웹을 사용하고 있습니다. Customer Onboarding Manager는 이전해오는 고객사의 오픈과 온보딩을 직접 책임지고, 고객사가 아임웹을 사업의 핵심 성장 도구로 사용하도록 돕는 역할입니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    신규 이전 고객사의 온보딩을 담당해, 오픈까지 걸리는 시간을 단축합니다.  킥오프에서 요구사항과 오픈 일정을 파악하고, 오픈까지 필요한 과제를 관리합니다.  데이터 이전, 도메인 연결, 결제 연동, 초기 세팅을 고객사와 함께 진행합니다.  도입 단계에서 반복되는 문의를 구조화해 유관 부서 및 AI 자동화를 통해 개선합니다.  도입 가이드와 온보딩 자료를 정비해 도입 방식을 표준화합니다.       [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 도입 지원, 온보딩, 영업 지원 등 2년 이상의 경력이 있으신 분  여러 고객사의 도입 건을 동시에 진행하며 일정과 과제를 관리해보신 분  제품의 기능을 고객의 업무 언어로 풀어 설명해보신 분  도메인, 결제, 데이터 이전 등 기술적인 설정을 고객과 함께 진행하는 데 거리감이 없으신 분  고객사 실무진, 사내 유관 부서와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  반복되는 문제를 가이드나 프로세스로 만들어 해결하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험  쇼핑몰 구축이나 플랫폼 이전을 직접 지원해본 경험  고객사 도입 프로젝트를 리딩해본 경험  도입 가이드나 교육 프로그램을 만들어 문의량이나 도입 속도를 개선해본 경험  반복되는 문제나 비효율을 AI 자동화를 통해 개선해본 경험       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: Customer Care Manager
description: About us:   The Bread Factory is the UK's leading artisan bakery. Founded by Gail Meija in 1993, The Bread Factory, originally known as Gail Force, began by supplying some of London's most prestigious restaurants, including many with Michelin stars. More than three decades later, we continue to work closely with the best chefs, alongside grocers, foodservice partners and our own neighbourhood bakery, GAIL's.  The Bread Factory is synonymous with quality. We have been awarded more than 100 Great Taste Awards and have held a Royal Warrant since 2016, when it was first granted by Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. In 2024, the warrant was renewed by His Majesty The King.  We source our ingredients thoughtfully, partnering with farmers and millers who align with our values. The result: delicious, carefully made baked goods that support a more sustainable and nutritious food system; bringing great bread to more tables every day.  As Customer Care Manager, you’ll lead and develop a high-performing team that delivers a consistently brilliant service to our chefs, bakeries, grocers and buyers every day. You’ll be responsible for achieving service, quality and customer KPIs, while driving customer retention, reducing customer effort and building an empathetic but honest culture of continuous improvement. Using customer feedback, operational data and team insight, you’ll identify opportunities to make it easier for customers to do business with The Bread Factory and help strengthen the relationships that keep them coming back.   Every day is different at The Bread Factory, but here are some of the things you’ll be doing:    Leading a high-performing team that provides outstanding Customer Care   - Lead, coach and developing the team to deliver excellent service and customer experiences.  - Grow Team Leaders and Trading Systems Manager to achieve their goals, manage performance and develop a highly engaged team.  - Act as the go-to escalation point for complex customer escalations, making decisions that are right for both the customer and the business.   Delivering an excellent service our customers can consistently rely on   - Ensure we consistently achieve and exceed our service, quality and customer KPI’s.  - Plan resources effectively to ensure the team is set up to meet customer demand.  - Own the onboarding journey so that customers have the best experience with us from day one.   Turning customer insight into better experiences   - Analyse customer feedback, complaints, CSAT, and operational data to identify continuous improvement, performance management and deflection opportunities.  - Turn customer feedback into meaningful actions that improve satisfaction, loyalty and retention.   Helping the team grow and succeed   - Ensure training, coaching and quality frameworks offer the tools the team needs to thrive and deliver exceptional experiences.  - Spot capability gaps and create robust development plans.  - Encourage a culture of learning, feedback

We’re looking for people who are passionate about providing the best possible levels of customer service and thrive on creating positive experiences for customers, whilst well as motivating people and driving performance improvements across the team and business. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!      About The Role    It's a fast-paced environment where no 2 days are the same. Open Mon – Fri 8am –7pm and Sat 8am – 1pm, you’d be expected to work shifts to cover this on a rota basis. There’s flexibility to work half of your time at home and half in the office, after an initial training period.  Your day will be spent managing a team of advisors, everything from coaching, motivation, performance management, quality checking and HR admin. You’ll be accountable for the overall performance of your team, ensuring colleagues deliver outstanding service with a key focus on first contact resolution across all channels.  To get the best out of your team, you’ll ensure that appropriate training, coaching and feedback is in place, so they’re in the best place possible to deliver unrivalled customer experience. You’ll be used to working in a fast-paced environment, and confident to step-up and be a strong and visible leader.  You’ll need effective communication skills and empathy as well as the ability to build and cultivate strong and long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders. You’ll be able to manage customer expectations, handling escalated complaints sometimes.  Reviewing performance and insight data to drive the performance of your team and the department is something you’ll do as part of your day to day. So, it would be great if you have skills and experience or a passion for all things data.   Our Process   As part of the interview process successful applicants may be asked to complete an individual exercise. You’ll be given sufficient preparation time and will receive further details with your interview invitation should you be successful in your application. Our colleague network groups include our Rainbow Support Network (LGBTQIA+), REACH (Race, Ethnicity, and Cultural Heritage), WiSTEM (Women in STEM) and Thisability (disability and neurodiversity)

title: Tiiminvetäjä, Tampere Veska
description: Kiinnostaako työskentely modernissa vähittäiskauppaketjussa, innostavassa ja lämminhenkisessä työyhteisössä, jossa pyritään yhdessä löytämään käteviä ja käytännöllisiä ratkaisuja asiakkaillemme?   Haemme nyt Tiiminvetäjää uuteen myymäläämme Tampereen Veskaan!   Tärkein tehtäväsi on ohjata ja kannustaa tiimiäsi tekemään tehokasta myyntityötä ja palvelemaan asiakkaita tavallista paremmin. Johdat ja delegoit myymälän päivittäisten tehtävien suorittamista sekä osallistut niiden kehittämiseen. Koulutat tiimiäsi, jotta saavutatte yhdessä erinomaisen asiakaspalvelun ja loistavat myyntitulokset. Varmistat myymälän kaupallisuuden yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa. Teet aktiivista myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyötä näyttäen esimerkkiä tiimillesi omalla tarmokkaalla toiminnallasi.  Olet kannustava esihenkilö, jolla on hyvät yhteistyötaidot. Olet tottunut suunnittelemaan, toteuttamaan ja seuraamaan päivittäisiä myymälärutiineja sekä myynnin avainlukuja. Omaat palavan innostuksen myyntiin ja johdat myyntiä kannustavalla otteella. Toivomme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta esihenkilötehtävästä tai vastuullisen myyjän tehtävästä vähittäiskaupassa tai palvelualalla. Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea ja englantia. Myynnin ammattitutkinto tai muu kaupallinen koulutus on plussaa.   Mitä tarjoamme?   Tulet osaksi lämminhenkistä ja avointa työyhteisöä, jossa vaalimme yrityskulttuurimme perustaa, Clas Ohlson henkeä. Me Clas Ohlsonilla arvostamme työtekijöitämme juuri sellaisina kuin he ovat. Tarjoamme jokaiselle mahdollisuuden kehittyä omassa roolissaan osallistuttamalla koko henkilökuntaa myymälän päivittäiseen toimintaan ja työskentelemällä aina yhdessä tiiminä. Henkilöstön hyvinvointi on meille tärkeää ja tarjoamme laajan työterveyshuollon, sekä ePassi sportti-, kulttuuri-, ja hyvinvointiedun kaikille työntekijöillemme.  Toivomme, että juuri sinä, omalla persoonallisuudellasi ja kokemuksellasi, haluat olla osa matkaamme, joka vie meitä eteenpäin vielä seuraavat 100 vuotta. Tähän matkaan on jokaisella mahdollisuus olla mukana vaikuttamassa.   Työsuhteen laatu, työaika ja palkkaus    Työsuhteen laatu:  toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, kokoaikainen 37,5 t/viikko   Työsuhteen palkkaus : Kaupan alan TES B-taulukkopalkka + 11 % vastuulisä. Esimerkki* kuukausipalkasta kolmen vuoden kokemuksella, 4:nnen vuoden palkalla n. 2700€/kk. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksetaan Bonus, kulloinkin voimassa olevan yhtiön ohjeen ja järjestelmän mukaan   Työsuhteen aloitus : syyskuu 2026 / sopimuksen mukaan   Joko kiinnostuit?   Hae mukaan jättämällä meille hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi 30.8.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja pyrimme lähettämään haastattelukutsuja jo hakuajan aikana, joten laitathan hakemuksesi hyvissä ajoin!    Ensimmäinen rekrytointivaihe on lyhyt videohaastattelu. Lähetämme kutsun sähköpostitse niille hakijoille, jotka etenevät rekrytointiprosessissa tähän vaiheeseen, joten pidäthän silmällä sähköpostiasi, jotta kutsu ei jää huomaamatta. You will lead the Customer Support team and work closely with the Head of Payments to develop and strengthen the Support function. Proven people-management experience, including performance management, team development, workload management, onboarding, and quality control.  Experience building, redesigning, or significantly improving Support processes rather than only maintaining existing operations. title: Customer Support Manager
description: The client   Buddy Advisory is proud to be partnering with PaySauce to find their next Customer Support Manager. PaySauce makes payroll simple for small businesses across New Zealand, Australia and the Pacific. Their customers run cafes, build houses, milk cows and run retail stores; they're not payroll experts, they're experts in their own business. Payroll is time-critical and people rely on it, so being there when things go wrong matters deeply to the PaySauce team.  PaySauce is investing deeply in its Customer Experience function, both the operational side (the tools, data and overall management of how it delivers its service) and the people side, growing team capacity and capability as it heads into a period of significant product change.      The role   PaySauce is looking for a support leader who builds great customer care through a strong team and the systems and operations behind them. This is a leadership role owning PaySauce's Customer Support function, the inbound, reactive care customers come to them for, which sits alongside Customer Success, their proactive, outbound function. Together they shape the experience customers feel every day.  You'll lead the Customer Support team, report to PaySauce's Head of Customer Operations, and work across the wider Customer Experience group including Customer Operations, Customer Success, Onboarding and their dedicated Australian team. It's a team in a period of real growth and change, heading into a multi-year transition as customers move onto PaySauce's new products, and leading it well through that transition is a critical part of landing it. description: Some Career Choices Have More Impact Than Others.   At HSBC our purpose is to Open up a World of Opportunity. We use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to provide opportunities for our customers and colleagues through global connectivity. We bring together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share. HSBC Global Trade Solutions (GTS) is one of the largest trade services organisations in the world, offering a comprehensive range of forward-thinking supply chain and traditional trade solutions. The Transaction Services Manager plays a key role in proactively ensuring an industry-leading customer experience across high-value GTS relationships. title: Night Manager - Sherwood
description: Night Manager – Sherwood Queenstown  Boutique Alpine Hotel   About EVT   Sherwood Queenstown is part of EVT, one of Australasia's market-leading experience creators offering careers that can take you wherever you want to go across entertainment, ventures, and travel. In a world of cookie cutter experiences, here at EVT we believe in changing the game. It's why we all call ourselves Daymakers, because each day is a chance to add the wow factor for our customers and continually grow in our own careers.  The Independent Collection is a curated selection of hotels, each of which lives up to an exacting standard to offer travellers the best of luxury, elevated, urban, comfort and social experiences. While every hotel celebrates its own unique brand and experience, together the Independent Collection shares a passion for one-of-a-kind experiences, service and quality.  EVT has an endless range of roles and career paths to explore across over 140 entertainment experiences like Event Cinemas and Moonlight Cinemas, 150 award winning restaurants and bars, and 80+ hotels, including QT, Rydges, Atura, LyLo, Independent Collection and Australia's most loved year round alpine resort, Thredbo. Our ventures include a ~$2.3B property portfolio and hotel management, just to name a few. Once you're in, there's no limits on where your career could take you.   Role Overview   Sherwood Queenstown is a sustainability-led, boutique hotel set on the hillside overlooking Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables, awarded a Michelin Star in the inaugural MICHELIN Guide New Zealand. Blending rustic charm with modern comfort, Sherwood offers a unique retreat focused on wellness, creativity, and community.  Reporting to the Front Office Manager, the Night Manager acts as the manager of the hotel overnight in the absence of the General Manager, Front Office Manager and Hotel Manager, anticipating and meeting guest needs, overseeing the night audit process, and maintaining hotel security and established service standards through the night shift. You'll supervise the Night Team, resolve guest requests with warmth and urgency, and help protect the seamless experience Sherwood is known for around the clock. This is a rare opportunity to be part of something special, taking genuine ownership of the hotel during the night shift.  This is a full-time, permanent role with a minimum guaranteed hours of 40 per week. It also liaises with cross-functional internal teams to improve the entire client experience. title: Junior Account Manager Elisa Oyj (Oulu)
description: Rakennatko sinä seuraavan kasvutarinan asiakkaidesi kanssa?     Elisa on Suomen johtava tietoliikenne- ja digitaalisten palveluiden tarjoaja. Sen ratkaisut auttavat tuhansia yrityksiä kehittämään liiketoimintaansa, parantamaan tuottavuuttaan ja rakentamaan kilpailuetua nopeasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.    Bookers on ollut osa tätä menestystarinaa jo yli kahden vuosikymmenen ajan. Yhteistyömme Elisan kanssa alkoi 2000-luvun alussa, ja tänä päivänä vastaamme noin 4 500 suomalaisen yrityksen asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä ratkaisumyynnistä osana Elisan yritysmyyntiä.    Nyt etsimme Junior Account Manageria Ouluun liittymään noin 20 hengen asiantuntevaan myyntitiimiimme.    Tässä roolissa et myy yksittäisiä tuotteita. Toimit asiakkaidesi pitkäaikaisena kumppanina, tunnistat heidän liiketoimintansa tarpeita ja rakennat ratkaisuja, jotka auttavat heitä kasvamaan ja menestymään.    Mitä työ sisältää?   Vastaat nimettyjen pienten ja keskisuurten yritysasiakkaiden asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä pääkaupunkiseudulla. Tehtäväsi on kasvattaa asiakkuuksien arvoa, löytää uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia sekä saavuttaa kunnianhimoiset myyntitavoitteet.  Käytössäsi on koko Elisan yritysliiketoiminnan palveluvalikoima, jonka avulla voit rakentaa asiakkaillesi aidosti liiketoimintaa kehittäviä ratkaisuja. Työssä yhdistyvät nykyasiakkuuksien kehittäminen, ratkaisumyynti sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien aktiivinen tunnistaminen.  Työtä tehdään joustavasti hybridimallilla sekä kotoa että Elisan moderneissa toimitiloissa Oulussa. Asiakastyö edellyttää myös liikkumista asiakkaiden luona, ja oman auton käytöstä maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset.   Kenelle tehtävä sopii?   Menestyt tehtävässä, jos nautit tavoitteellisesta tekemisestä, haluat oppia myynnistä ja motivoidut mahdollisuudesta vaikuttaa omaan onnistumiseesi. Et tarvitse vuosien kokemusta asiakkuuksien johtamisesta tai ratkaisumyynnistä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on halu kehittyä, rohkeutta kohdata asiakkaita ja motivaatio tehdä tulosta.  Aiempi kokemus tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä auttaa sinua pääsemään vauhtiin, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme henkilöä, jolla on oikea asenne oppia uutta ja rakentaa pitkäjänteisesti omaa osaamistaan.  Sanomattakin lienee selvää, että tavoitteet saavutetaan yhdessä. Työ edellyttää oma-aloitteisuutta ja aktiivista otetta, mutta et missään vaiheessa jää yksin. Saat tueksesi kokeneen tiimin, kattavan perehdytyksen, vahvan valmennuskulttuurin sekä mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiakkuuksien kehittämisen ja ICT-ratkaisumyynnin ammattilaiseksi.   Jotta saat lentävän lähdön tehtävässä, odotamme sinulta:     Kokemusta myyntityöstä  Kokemusta asiakastapaamisten sopimisesta  Aktiivista, itsenäistä ja tavoitteellista otetta myyntityöhön  Uusien asioiden nopeaa omaksumista  Erinomaiset viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot     Mitä saat meiltä:     Vauhtia ja haasteita alalla, jolla on suuri vaikutus monen suomalaisen arkeen  Hyvät, nykyaikaiset työskentelytavat ja -välineet, etätyömahdol

title: Renewal & Winback Manager (m/w/d)
description: Kundenbindung ist kein Support-Thema - es ist eine Wachstumsstrategie. Bei kununu bauen wir diese Funktion gerade neu auf und du gestaltest sie von Anfang an mit.  Als Renewal & Winback Manager (m/w/d) schützt du den Kern unseres Geschäfts. Du arbeitest eng mit Account Management und Customer Experience zusammen, trägst aber dein Ergebnis selbst. Dein Erfolg ist direkt in gesicherten Verträgen und zurückgewonnenen Kund:innen messbar.  Was dich erwartet: keine eingefahrenen Prozesse, kein fertiges Playbook, dafür echte Verantwortung, direkter Einfluss auf unsere Umsatzbasis und die Möglichkeit, etwas aufzubauen, das Bestand hat.      Deine Aufgaben    Umsatz sichern: Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, verstehst warum Kund:innen gehen und handelst, bevor der Vertrag verloren ist.  Kundenbeziehungen retten: Du führst schwierige Gespräche mit Entscheidungsträger:innen, findest individuelle Lösungen und bringst Verhandlungen zu einem Ergebnis.  Verlorene Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du baust das erste strukturierte Winback-Programm bei kununu auf und sorgst dafür, dass ehemalige Kund:innen den Weg zurück finden.  Das AM-Team stärken: Bei strategisch wichtigen Accounts, bei denen Churn droht, wirst du als Spezialist:in dazugeholt - du bringst die kommerzielle Expertise, die Retention braucht.  Marktanteile verteidigen: Du positionierst kununu überzeugend gegen Wettbewerber und Budget-Druck - mit Argumenten, die auf dem konkreten Wert für die Kund:innen basieren.  Retention messbar machen: Du etablierst die Grundlagen für eine datengetriebene Retention-Steuerung bei kununu und legst damit den Grundstein für ein wachsendes Team.       Das bringst du mit    Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im B2B-SaaS- oder Subscription-Geschäft - idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Renewals, Account Management oder Customer Success.  Du führst schwierige Gespräche konstruktiv und bleibst sachlich, auch wenn die Gegenseite Druck macht.  Die Zufriedenheit deiner Kund:innen hat für dich höchste Priorität. Bei einer Kündigung analysierst du die Gründe und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungspotenziale ab.  Du verstehst dich als Stimme der Kund:innen nach innen: Du nutzt das, was du im Kundenkontakt hörst, um intern Prozesse, Produkt und Zusammenarbeit weiterzuentwickeln.  Idealerweise bist du bereits mit Tools wie Gong, Salesloft oder Salesforce vertraut und setzt sie routiniert in deinem Arbeitsalltag ein.  Digitale Sales Rooms sind für dich ein selbstverständliches Arbeitsmittel, kein Pilotprojekt.  KI und Automatisierung setzt du pragmatisch ein.  Für die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen im DACH-Raum verfügst du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Da wir international zusammenarbeiten, kommunizierst du auch sicher auf Englisch.       Deine Benefits    Bürohunde  Bis zu12 Wochen Workation  6 Wochen Urlaub  Mobile devices auch zum privaten Gebrauch  Sommer- und Weihnachtsparty  Drinks, Food & Goodies  Flexibles Home-Office  Restauranttickets und Mitarbeiterrabatte  Marktkonfo

title: Account Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 아임웹을 핵심 도구로 사용하고 있는 고객사들이 우리의 파트너입니다. Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다.    [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 Account Manager, Customer Success, 고객 컨설팅 등 고객 접점 직무에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  다수의 중, 대형 고객 포트폴리오를 운영하며 매출 성장과 리텐션, 업셀링에서 의미 있는 성과를 만들어내신 분  고객사의 비즈니스를 깊이 이해하고, 데이터를 기반으로 컨설팅에 가까운 제안을 해보신 분  Spreadsheet, BI 툴 등으로 직접 데이터를 분석하고, 협상과 제안의 근거로 활용하시는 분  고객사 의사결정자와 신뢰감 있게 소통하고, 다양한 이해관계자와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에 유연하게 적응하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM, 광고 솔루션 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험이 있으신 분  신규 영업의 협상과 계약부터 온보딩, 확장까지 풀 사이클을 경험해보신 분  CRM 또는 BI 툴을 적극적으로 활용해본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반의 업셀링, 크로스셀링 시나리오를 직접 설계해 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분  중형과 대형 고객사를 대상으로 한 정기 비즈니스 리뷰와 컨설팅 운영 경험  활용 데이터를 기반으로 이탈을 예측하거나 확장 기회를 발견해본 경험  D2C 브랜드, 쇼핑몰, 마켓플레이스 등 이커머스 생태계에 대한 깊은 이해       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: Senior Specialist - Customer Experience
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du være med til at forme oplevelsen for millioner af passagerer hvert år? Med ’Passenger First, Always’ som ledestjerne arbejder vi for at skabe en rejseoplevelse i verdensklasse. Vores ambition er at levere de oplevelser, der får passagererne til at vælge og huske CPH – vi vil ’delighte’. Det gør vi ved at kombinere effektive processer, god service og inspirerende oplevelser, så lufthavnen opleves som mere end blot et stop på rejsen.   Din nye rolle   I rollen som Senior Specialist i Customer Experience (CX) får du ansvaret for at udvikle og sikre en sammenhængende passageroplevelse på tværs af hele rejsen, både den fysiske og digitale. Rollen giver stor indflydelse, et bredt netværk på tværs af lufthavnen og mulighed for at omsætte strategi til synlige resultater i passagerrejsen.  Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:    Eje og videreudvikle CPH’s Master Passenger Journey på tværs af organisationen  Identificere, prioritere og konkretisere forbedringsmuligheder baseret på kundeindsigter, data og trends  Drive og prioritere en tværgående udviklings-roadmap på passagerrejsen på tværs af CPH  Definere og forankre CX-krav, standarder og designprincipper for fysiske og digitale touch points  Sikre at passagerernes behov tænkes ind gennem kravsætning og design/ambience i byggeprojekter. Vi har ansvaret for alt fra udvikling af ruter til udlejning af butikker og spisesteder, parkering, kommunikation og den samlede passagerrejse.  Du bliver en del af Passenger Journey Development. Vi er et team på 11 personer med forskellige faglige kompetencer inden for forretningsudvikling, service excellence, monitorering og kvalitetsopfølgning og CX, som deler en fælles passion for at udvikle og forbedre passagerrejsen. Du anvender også din forståelse for sammenhængen af det fysiske og digitale rum.
