Grand nom français du transport sous température dirigée, nous intervenons sur l'ensemble du territoire en nous appuyant sur la performance de notre réseau. L'esprit d'innovation et l'engagement de nos collaborateurs nous ont permis, depuis la création de l'entreprise, de connaître une croissance soutenue et de nous adapter aux évolutions de notre marché. En interne comme en externe, nous plaçons l'humain au coeur du projet de l'entreprise. La proximité et la satisfaction client rythment notre quotidien.   	Rattaché(e) au Directeur d'Exploitation, le Responsable Relations Clients (H/F) pilote avec l'aide de son équipe, le bon traitement et la résolution des réclamations clients avec objectif constant de minimiser les coûts, d'assurer la satisfaction du client et la rapidité de traitement des dossiers.  Vos missions : - Traiter les dossiers clients conflictuels et sensibles - Rechercher la solution la plus adaptée pour satisfaire le client en tenant compte des contraintes d'organisation de l'exploitation et de l'optimisation des coûts pour l'entreprise - Veiller au bon traitement des réclamations clients et dossiers litiges par son équipe en assurant un support sur des dossiers complexes - Traiter et transfèrer les dossiers litiges au service contentieux selon l'importance des dossiers - Consolide les reporting suivant les indicateurs qualité, analyse les écarts de traitement des dossiers et met en place les plans d'actions correctifs - Propose et met en oeuvre des solutions SAV répondant aux besoins clients et respectant les engagements de délais et de qualité de service - Assure une fluidité des échanges et des actions avec l'exploitation - Assiste aux rendez-vous clients (à la demande du client), point qualité Communique les objectifs, responsabilise son équipe - Fait contribuer son équipe à l'amélioration du service client fourni - Garantit la cohésion de groupe - Coordonne et supervise le travail de son équipe - Participe à l'accompagnement et à la montée en compétences de son équipe    	Issu(e) d'une formation Bac+2/+3 Logistique et Transport, vous avez une expérience significative de 5 à 7 ans en management d'une équipe service clients.   Vous êtes dynamique, tenace et manager fait partie de votre ADN. Rigoureux, votre capacité à prendre du recul et à prioriser les actions vous permet de faire face à l'imprévu et d'élaborer spontanément des solutions concrètes et efficaces pour répondre aux besoins et aux contraintes des clients.  Vous connaissez les fondamentaux de la gestion et maîtrisez les outils informatiques indispensables à l'exercice de votre mission. 	Ref : 30633727

title: Advocacy & Communications Manager
description: About The Role   In this role, you will lead the PR, Advocacy & Events for our Consumer Products Division in New Zealand. You will be responsible for translating ANZ and international brand visions into local success stories through high-impact communication and advocacy.    Localise and execute PR & Advocacy communication strategies in consistency with international communication and ANZ business strategy.  Lead divisional PR relations, managing image and press requests while identifying proactive media opportunities.  Execute integrated communication campaigns and brand events in close collaboration with marketing and Category Activation teams.  Initiate and manage influencer relationships, driving both organic advocacy and supporting paid campaigns where required.  Oversee the end-to-end logistics of the PR division, including press sample management and mass send-outs.  Track media coverage and drive PR results, providing monthly reports to wider brand teams and internal stakeholders.  Manage event and campaign costs within allocated budgets, including PO management and vendor set-up.  Work closely with external agencies and ANZ marketing teams to ensure consistency and excellence in all local PR initiatives.     About You     Proven experience in PR, Advocacy, or Communications, ideally within the beauty or lifestyle industry.  An established network and a deep understanding of the New Zealand media and influencer landscape.  A strategic mindset with the ability to execute creative 360° campaigns from concept to completion.  Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage budgets, logistics, and vendor relationships.  A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively across local New Zealand teams and broader ANZ regional structures.  Resilience and agility, with the capacity to manage the fast-paced nature of a fixed-term contract.  Excellent communication skills, both for external storytelling and internal reporting of PR results.

title: Chef för kundrelationer och nya affärer – Fjärrvärme Stockholm
description: Om oss   Fjärrvärme spelar en viktig roll i energiomställningen och i utvecklingen av våra städer. Inom E.ONs fjärrvärmeverksamhet arbetar vi nära våra kunder för att tillsammans hitta långsiktiga och hållbara energilösningar. Våra kunder i Stockholmsregionen är framför allt fastighetsbolag, kommunala bolag och bostadsrättsföreningar, där långsiktiga relationer och förståelse för kundernas behov är centralt för vår affär. Nu söker vi en chef som vill leda vårt säljteam i Stockholm med ansvarar för kundrelationer och nyförsäljning och fortsätta utveckla vår affär i regionen.   Din roll   Du ansvarar för våra kundrelationer och fjärrvärmeförsäljning i Stockholmsregionen och leder ett team av key account managers, affärsingenjörer och en affärskoordinator. Tillsammans utvecklar ni våra kundrelationer, identifierar nya affärsmöjligheter och skapar långsiktigt värde för både våra kunder och E.ON.  I rollen kommer du bland annat att:    Leda, coacha och utveckla ditt team och skapa goda förutsättningar för engagemang och resultat.  Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer samt ha eget ansvar för några av våra större strategiska kunder.  Driva och utveckla affären i regionen med fokus på lönsamma och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar för både våra kunder och E.ON.  Representera E.ON i dialogen med kunder, kommuner och andra aktörer och aktivt bevaka stadsutvecklingen i regionen genom dialog, nätverk och att du förstår våra kunders behov.  Följa upp försäljning och resultat samt skapa struktur och framdrift i teamets arbete.  Arbeta för strategisk utveckling av verksamheten och vår affär.     Du ingår i både Commercials ledningsgrupp och ledningsgruppen för fjärrvärmeverksamheten i Stockholmsregionen, där du tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar till att utveckla vår verksamhet och driva affären framåt.   Vem är det vi hoppas vill bli vår nya ledare?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet från energi, fastighet, infrastruktur, stadsutveckling eller annan närliggande verksamhet och en god förståelse för komplexa affärer och kunders behov. Vi ser gärna att du har en god förståelse för samhällsbyggnadssektorn, dess aktörer, beslutsvägar och processer som påverkar energival och affärer vid ny- och ombyggnation. Vi ser också att du har erfarenhet av att leda andra, som chef eller i en annan ledande roll.  Som ledare är du trygg, lyhörd och har förmågan att möta, utmana och utveckla medarbetare med olika erfarenheter och behov. Du skapar struktur och framdrift och har förmågan att lyfta blicken och se affären ur ett större perspektiv. Vi ser också att du har ett starkt affärsmannaskap och förmågan att bygga förtroendefulla relationer. Med ett prestigelöst och samarbetsorienterat förhållningssätt söker du nya perspektiv och ser värdet av att lyckas tillsammans, både inom teamet och med andra delar av E.ON.   Hur är det hos oss?   Din närmsta chef, Jenny Rosander, värdesätter öppenhet, handlingskraft och ett nära samarbete. Hon ger dig stort förtroende och utrymm

title: Serviceleder - Greve
description: Bucher Municipal A/S er en del af schweiziske Bucher Industries, en global industrikoncern med ca. 14.000 medarbejdere. Til vores serviceværksted i Greve søger vi en erfaren serviceleder, som vil tage det overordnede ansvar for drift og udvikling af vores største serviceværksted i Danmark.  Som vores nye Serviceleder skal du kunne skabe motivation, trivsel og udvikling blandt medarbejderne. Du bliver ansvarlig for den daglige ledelse og skal som spillende træner være tæt på både medarbejderne og den daglige drift på værkstedet. Samtidig bliver du ansvarlig for, at afdelingen kontinuerligt udvikler måden at servicere og give gode kundeoplevelser på.  Afdelingerne varetager service og reparation af slamsugere, fejemaskiner og på sigt eventuelt flere lignende produkttyper. Ofte er anlæggene unikke, hvilket betyder, at kompetencerne hos personalet skal være høje ligesom det kræver stor forståelse for kundernes behov at levere den helt rigtige kundeoplevelse.  I værkstedet er der et højt aktivitetsniveau, men der er kolleger, som støtter i forhold til de administrative opgaver ligesom den tidligere Serviceleder vil hjælpe dig godt i gang med opgaven.  Dine opgaver    Være meget synlig på værkstedet, støtte medarbejderne og skabe retning i hverdagen  Planlægning og koordinering af værkstedets opgaver  Kundekontakt: modtagelse, tilbud, rådgivning og opfølgning - og sikre, at opgaver følges helt til dørs  Prioritering og sparring med mekanikerne for at sikre kvalitet og effektivitet  Have fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og ordentligt håndværk  Økonomisk opfølgning på tilbud, fakturaer og nøgletal  Bidrage til en stærk holdånd og et godt samarbejde på værkstedet    Dine kvalifikationer  Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund og erfaring med ledelse af et serviceværksted. Du trives i rollen som en spillende træner, der går forrest, er synlig på værkstedet og motiverer medarbejderne gennem nærvær og faglig sparring. Du kan læse og forstå tekniske diagrammer og tegninger og har forståelse for komplekse tekniske løsninger.  Du er imødekommende, god til at lytte til både kunder og medarbejdere og evner at skabe tillid. Samtidig er du struktureret, følger opgaver helt til dørs, har økonomisk forståelse og bevarer overblikket - også når der er travlt. Du tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem en stærk holdånd og et godt samarbejde. IT indgår naturligt i dit daglige arbejde.  Vi tilbyder    En lederrolle, hvor du kombinerer faglighed og ansvar for mennesker og processer  Et værksted i rigtig god udvikling, hvor du kan sætte dit præg på retningen  En arbejdsdag tæt på både kunder og kolleger – du står ikke alene, men bliver en del af et engageret team  En arbejdsplads, hvor dine idéer og dit engagement gør en forskel  Et job, hvor vi fokuserer på, at der er tid til både arbejde og fritid    Interesseret?  Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Director Service & QHSE, Maibritt Kringel, på 27 77 40 56.  Send gerne din ansøg

title: Senior manager for GT IT Data Services Team, K Group
description: Do you want to work as a critical link between business and technology in one of the leading company in its field? K Group is looking for an experienced and technically strong data professional to join K IT and strengthen our Grocery Trade IT Data Services team as  Senior Manager working in IT Application Owner role.   We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K group!   About The Role   This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of developing, maintaining, and continuously improving business-critical data and analytics solutions as well as our strongly evolving AI capabilities. The role combines daily hands-on problem solving, application ownership, service management, and participation in development initiatives both as a subject matter expert and, when needed, as a project manager for smaller projects.   What does an IT Application Owner do?   The IT Application Owner is responsible for the end-to-end management, maintenance and development of their assigned service and application portfolio. The role includes both business functionality and technical lifecycle management, ensuring the continuity, stability, and evolution of the solutions under their ownership. In addition, IT Application Owner guides and collaborates with offshore partners and other service providers, while ensuring the continuous quality, availability, continuity and development of the services.  Our IT Application owners work closely with business stakeholders, architects, development and core IT teams, and external service partners. Success in this role requires the ability to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and drive solutions into practical implementation together with various stakeholders.  The role also requires a high-level understanding of the technical environment surrounding the applications, including capacity management, networking and connectivity solutions, as well as any service-related hardware and its operational principles.   What are we looking for?   Your responsibilities will focus on new and emerging data platforms and applications that we refer to as data kiosks. These solutions are primarily built on Snowflake technology utilizing dbt (data build tool), making strong practical experience with Snowflake and a solid understanding of modern data platform architectures and operating models essential for success in this role.  The position also requires strong SQL skills, including the ability to design, develop, and utilize SQL queries for data analysis, reporting, data model interpretation, and problem solving. Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Qlik Sense, Sigma, or similar technologies is also highly valued.   Your Skills And Background     Strong experience with Snowflake and modern data platform

You will play a key role in driving continuous improvement of O2D processes and strategic customer collaboration. You will identify opportunities to improve service, efficiency and process harmonization, and collaborate closely with our service hub teams and the business and implement best practices across the Nordic O2D organization. Represent Customer Operations towards customers and the business, leveraging expertise across the wider team when needed.   Leverage data and analytics to identify insights, assess the O2D performance, and drive improvement initiatives. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.  At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.  We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this? title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own     The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point.   • Enable stakeholder self-service access to trusted insights.

  • Drive data literacy: evangelize best practices in querying, dashboarding, and interpreting metrics; coach stakeholders toward self-serve.

title: Client Retention Specialist
description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the Beyond Finance program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Educate Clients: Provide comprehensive information about the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.
  • Empathize and Deescalate: Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.
  • Navigate CRM System: Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.
  • Analyze Financial Situation: Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.
  • Retain Clients: Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.

Welcher Kanal bringt Matches statt Downloads.

Du arbeitest dabei AI-First: AI übernimmt die Ausführung, dir gehören Intention, logisches Denken und Korrektheit.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Vollzeit 🚀

Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh

title: Junior QA Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
We are Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. the leading fertility and family-building benefits provider in the US.

Our shared mission? To make fertility and family-forming care accessible everywhere, breaking down barriers so that anyone can start a family, no matter where they are. With Progyny’s support, we're set to amplify our impact globally, reaching more individuals and families than ever before.

Come and join us for a diverse and inclusive workplace and use “Tech for Good”!

As a Junior QA Engineer, you’ll support software quality through both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend Engineers, Designers, and other QA colleagues to test new implementations and improve our testing processes.

Our product includes different systems and integrations working together, so curiosity, communication, and a willingness to learn are important. You won’t be expected to know everything from day one, but we’re looking for someone who can gradually take more ownership as they learn the product and our processes.

Tasks

  • Manually test new features, bug fixes, and existing product flows.
  • Create and execute clear test cases.
  • Write and maintain automated tests using Playwright.
  • Report, track, and retest bugs using Jira.
  • Review user stories and raise questions when requirements are unclear.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Product Managers throughout the testing process.
  • Support test automation within our GitHub Actions workflows.
  • Learn how different product areas and third-party integrations work together.
  • Explore how AI tools can support testing, documentation, and automation.

Requirements

  • Some practical experience with manual software testing, through work, an internship, training, or personal projects

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
About Frontier Health

Frontier Health is building the system of action for healthcare: end-to-end AI co-workers that perform administrative jobs.

Healthcare has an administrative crisis breaking patient care — the WHO predicts a 10 million person workforce shortfall by 2030. Administrative staff are the invisible machinery powering healthcare systems, yet they're over capacity, under-resourced, and underfunded. Care coordination runs on shadow IT: spreadsheets, paper notes, phone calls, and outdated technology.

Frontier's AI co-workers fast-track the admin behind care decisions, designed to slot into the teams, processes, and tools already in place. Founded 18 months ago, we've experience deploying to over 40 hospitals. The team comes from Palantir, Google DeepMind, and Apple. We've raised $16M and were recently valued at $60M, backed by Tier One UK and international investors.

We’re an in person Company, valuing being in the office (Farringdon/Chancery Lane) 5 days a week, or onsite with the customer (as required). We’re also flat, valuing ownership and impact of hierarchy, process and structure. You’ll be collaborating with people across engineering and business functions, with functional leadership, where required, and close and regular touchpoints with the CEO.

Values

  • Outcome Orientation — we focus on results and delivering value to customers

  • Grit — we stick with hard problems and see them through

  • Kindness — we presume best intentions and treat each other with respect

  • Bias to Act

title: Backend Developer
description:
Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry; we are committed to turning the world from combustion to electric. We design, build, and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus, and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background, and approaches, and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!

 To reach our goal, we are looking for a Backend Developer to join our Backend Team. At Qwello, you will help to design and implement new backend services (typically in Python or Rust) to support our growing fleet of self-designed/built charging stations being deployed across Europe. title: iOS Engineer - Design System
description:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

 

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming brand refresh
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

 

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each

title: Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO) - Healthtech (m/w/d)
description:
In Deutschland geben Patienten jährlich 30 Milliarden EUR beim Zahnarzt aus. Trotz dieser Marktgröße arbeiten viele Praxen noch immer mit veralteter Offline-Software aus den 80er Jahren. Roger ist hier, um das zu ändern.

title: QA Engineer
description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving:   Voor een groeiende technologieorganisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een Medior QA Engineer die een belangrijke bijdrage wil leveren aan de kwaliteit van een eigen softwareplatform.  De organisatie ontwikkelt digitale oplossingen waarmee klanten verschillende operationele en administratieve processen kunnen beheren en automatiseren. De software wordt volledig in eigen beheer ontwikkeld en bestaat uit een uitgebreid webbased platform met verschillende functionaliteiten, gebruikersstromen en koppelingen met externe systemen.     Door de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform worden nieuwe functionaliteiten toegevoegd en bestaande onderdelen continu verbeterd. Hierdoor neemt ook het belang van kwaliteit, stabiliteit en gebruiksvriendelijkheid verder toe.     Je komt terecht in een compact technisch team met software developers en QA. Binnen het team wordt nauw samengewerkt en krijg je veel mee van het volledige ontwikkelproces: van nieuwe requirements en development tot testen, oplevering en verdere optimalisatie.     De organisatie kenmerkt zich door een informele en nuchtere werksfeer. De lijnen zijn kort en er is veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Tegelijkertijd wordt er veel samengewerkt en vinden collega's het belangrijk om elkaar te helpen. Er wordt hybride gewerkt, waardoor je werkzaamheden zowel vanuit huis als op locatie kunt uitvoeren.      Functie-informatie:   Als Medior QA Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken en verbeteren van de kwaliteit van het softwareplatform. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan alleen controleren of een functionaliteit technisch werkt. Je denkt vanuit de gebruiker, onderzoekt verschillende scenario's en probeert juist de situaties te vinden waarin software niet doet wat ervan wordt verwacht.     Je wordt vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Samen met developers bespreek je requirements en bepaal je welke scenario's getest moeten worden. Vervolgens stel je testcases op, voer je functionele en regressietesten uit en leg je bevindingen duidelijk vast.     Je krijgt binnen deze functie veel vrijheid om zelf te bepalen hoe je het testproces aanpakt. Daarbij wordt ook van je verwacht dat je kritisch kijkt naar de huidige manier van werken. Zie je mogelijkheden om processen slimmer, efficiënter of betrouwbaarder in te richten? Dan krijg je de ruimte om hierin initiatief te nemen.     Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:   Opstellen, uitvoeren en onderhouden van testcases  Functioneel testen van nieuwe en bestaande softwarefunctionaliteiten  Uitvoeren van regressietesten  Signaleren, analyseren en duidelijk documenteren van bugs  Bespreken van bevindingen met software developers  Meedenken over requirements en mogelijke gebruikersscenario's  Controleren of opgeleverde functionaliteiten aansluiten bij de gestelde eisen  Bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van QA binnen de organisatie  Signaleren van risico

title: Quality Assurance Test Lead
description: Are you an experienced QA professional with strong technical skills and a passion for improving engineering practices at scale? In this role, you will help strengthen testing quality across a large international financial organisation.     Your primary focus will be contract-based testing with Specmatic. The initial rollout has already taken place; the next step is to solidify its use, establish reliable standards and help teams adopt the tool correctly and consistently.     This is not a traditional testing role. You will not own the quality of a specific application or product. Instead, you will investigate technical challenges, identify the best solutions and demonstrate their effectiveness through proofs of concept. Your recommendations must be well considered, technically sound and suitable for use across a complex organisation.      What you will do    Improve testing quality and engineering practices across the organisation.  Drive the further adoption and professionalisation of contract-based testing.  Act as a technical specialist for Specmatic, an open-source contract-testing tool.  Investigate testing challenges and evaluate potential solutions.  Design and implement proofs of concept to demonstrate that proposed solutions work.  Develop standards, guidelines and reusable approaches for multiple engineering teams.  Help teams integrate Specmatic correctly into their development and testing processes.  Advise stakeholders on technical choices and implementation approaches.  Promote reliable, scalable and maintainable testing solutions.  Build support for new standards and persuade teams to adopt the recommended approach.  Collaborate with engineers, QA professionals, architects and other stakeholders in an international environment.       What makes this role different   This position combines hands-on technical expertise with research, standardisation and organisational influence. You will explore what works, prove it in practice and enable other teams to implement it successfully.  Although a strong hands-on QA background is essential, you will not spend your time executing application-level test cases. Your impact will come from improving how teams test, providing technical direction and establishing solutions that can be applied throughout the organisation.      What you bring    A strong, hands-on background in quality assurance and software testing.  Proven technical expertise in modern software-development environments.  Solid knowledge of contract-based testing.  Experience with Specmatic, or demonstrably strong expertise that enables you to become productive with the tool quickly.  Experience investigating technical solutions and building proofs of concept.  The ability to assess whether a solution is reliable, maintainable and suitable for wider adoption.   Experience with one or more of the following technologies:   Java  TypeScript  Python  .NET  An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, APIs and automated testing practices.

Defect Management: Turn production and onboarding failures into repeatable regression test cases,

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (편의 기능)
description: About The Team & Mission   Quality Assurance Engineer (편의 기능)는 SDV 아키텍처 전환 환경에서 차량 바디/편의 소프트웨어의 통합 기능·성능 검증을 수행하며, 제어기 간 연동을 포함한 시스템 완성도를 확보합니다. 도어, HVAC, 시트 등 주요 편의 장치와 제어 소프트웨어 간 상호작용을 통합 관점에서 검증하고, 시나리오 기반 테스트 설계 및 자동화 체계를 구축하여 검증 효율성과 정확성을 향상시킵니다. 또한 Linux/RTOS 기반 환경과 차량 네트워크를 이해하고, 로그 데이터 분석 및 CI/CD 기반 검증 프로세스를 통해 양산 전·후 품질 지표를 관리하며 지속적인 품질 개선과 내재화를 리딩합니다.   Responsibilities     검증 계획 수립   SDV 통합 소프트웨어 QA 엔지니어는 새로운 설계(zonal architecture 등)와 동작 방식에 기반한 통합 소프트웨어 검증 계획을 수립합니다.   검증 설계   테스트 케이스 설계와 테스트 환경/조건을 설계하고, 단일 소프트웨어가 아닌 통합 검증 관점에서 검증 수행을 준비합니다.   검증 수행   주요 마일스톤(릴리스나 게이트 등)의 품질 목표 달성을 위한 검증을 실행합니다.   소프트웨어 통합 검증 외에 제어기와 연동되는 테스트 벤치 조건 및 실차 환경에서 검증을 수행할 수 있습니다.   검증 자동화   자동화 도구를 개발 또는 적용하여 통합 검증 활동을 효율화합니다.   결과 분석   검증 결과를 문서화하고 분석 내용을 구조화합니다.  필요에 따라 분석 내용에 대한 대시보드를 구성하여 시각화할 수 있습니다.   프로세스 구축 및 개선   통합 소프트웨어 검증의 효율성과 정확성을 높일 수 있는 프로세스와 절차를 정의하고 개선합니다.     Qualifications     7년 이상 자동차 소프트웨어 기능/성능 평가 업무 경험을 보유하신 분  Linux와 RTOS와 같은 운영체제에 대한 이해가 높으신 분  자동차 네트워크 평가 툴(CANoe, CANape 등) 사용 경험이 있으신 분  자동차 평가 로그 데이터 분석 경험이 있으신 분  Agile 프로세스와 CI/CD 환경에서 검증 활동을 진행한 경험이 있으신 분  최신 기술에 관심이 많고 변화에 유연하게 대처할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분     Preferred Qualifications     임베디드 개발환경에서의 프로그래밍 언어(C/C++, Python, Rust 등)에 대한 높은 이해도  클라우드 환경(AWS, Azure 등)에서의 소프트웨어 품질 관리 업무 경험  제어기 또는 차량 평가 자동화 구축 경험 (HIL, SIL 등)  A-SPICE 또는 ISO 26262 적용 경험  Cloud service(fleet management 등)와 실차간 연동 경험  LLM을 이용한 검증 업무 자동화 진행 경험

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description: At AROA, our people come to work every day with passion and ideas that fuel our business and go home knowing they have made a real difference in the lives of others.     AROA, which is Maori for ‘understanding’, is proudly New Zealand born and based. We develop, manufacture, and export innovative wound care products, improving the lives of millions around the world by unlocking extraordinary outcomes for our patients. Our mission is to be the global leader in regenerative healing, making our products and services accessible to everybody.      About the role:   We’re looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer  to join our Quality team. In this critical role, you’ll provide technical quality oversight across validation, equipment qualification, risk management, and continuous improvement activities ensuring our systems, products, and processes meet the highest standards of compliance and safety. Other key responsibilities include:   Provide quality oversight and approval of validation activities and documentation.  Actively engage with production floor processes, equipment, and personnel to ensure quality standards are upheld throughout design transfer and manufacturing.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams and effectively support multiple projects, balancing priorities to meet deadlines.  Serve as a point of contact for QA technical issues, drive root cause analysis, and communicate quality concerns to cross-functional teams.  Contribute to AROA’s continuous improvement efforts by identifying areas for improvement in product quality and safety       What you'll bring:     Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or equivalent.  3+ years’ experience in Quality Assurance within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.  Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and cGMP.  Working knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820.  Hands-on experience with process validation.  Strong technical writing skills, with experience reviewing documentation for compliance and clarity.  Experience with or interest in computer system/software validation is desirable. That means fast feedback loops, meaningful test coverage, and a clear-eyed view of product health at all times.  You will be working in a hybrid work setup, with a collaborative and international team. You'll join a fast-growing company at the intersection of AI, compliance, and enterprise software — where the quality of what you ship genuinely matters to the customers relying on it.   What You'll Do    Quality strategy & ownership     Define, implement, and continuously improve testing strategies in close alignment with the product and engineering teams.  Serve as the team's subject matter expert on QA processes, tooling, and best practices — raising the bar for the whole squad.  Maintain clear, accurate, and actionable test documentation and reporting for both developers and business stakeholders.     Hands-on testing     Test newly implemented features using a diverse range of testing techniques, with a focus on uncovering gaps early.  Perform exploratory testing to proactively identify regressions and edge cases before they reach production.  Provide fast, reliable feedback on product health and stability to developers and stakeholders throughout each sprint.     Automation & tooling     Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites covering E2E and API testing for both web and mobile applications.  Perform root cause analysis on failing automated tests and drive their resolution.  Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality gates are in place (Azure DevOps preferred).  Contribute to AI-assisted development efforts and explore how emerging tooling can improve the team's quality workflows.     Collaboration & communication     Report bugs clearly and follow up on their resolution, monitoring the bug backlog to keep it actionable.  Support developers in investigating and reproducing issues, acting as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper.    Your Responsibilities    Test the products applying diverse testing techniques to uncover bugs  Report bugs and follow up their resolution  Develop new and maintain the existing automated end-to-end and API tests  Contribute in the AI assisted development efforts and tooling  Setup and maintain CI/CD pipelines  Perform root cause analysis of failing automated test

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description: About the role   We're looking for a Product Quality Owner to take ownership of a question nobody at Zendr owns today: what we validate before we ship, in what order, and why. As we roll out the next generation of our B2B freight platform through late 2026 - shipping continuously behind feature flags - you'll build and defend the risk model of our product, decide where validation effort goes, and stand behind every release decision with real evidence rather than gut feel or a completed checklist.     This is a strategy and ownership role with hands-on validation at its core. It's deliberately not a test-execution role, a QA engineering role, or a team lead role - our development teams own automated unit and integration testing, written and maintained with modern AI tooling. Your time goes to the judgment work automation can't do: risk thinking, release readiness, and deep exploratory and regression testing of the flows that matter most.  You'll work closely with the Head of Product and the Head of Engineering in a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and craft matter more than buzzwords. Your recommendation is what every release decision is based on, so this role comes with real mandate - and the accountability that goes with it. This is a role for someone who reasons analytically about risk and generates structure in ambiguity - not someone who waits to be told what to test.      Key responsibilities    Own and maintain the product's risk model - what can break, what it costs the customer, and where validation effort should go  Own release readiness: your recommendation is the basis for every release decision - you define what "ready" means per release and back each ship-or-hold call with documented evidence  Drive bug refinement on a regular cadence and keep the backlog honest and prioritised against real customer and business impact  Inventory, risk-triage and validate features shipped behind feature flags before they roll out to customer segments  Run exploratory testing of new functionality and regression on critical flows - carrier integrations, rates, labels and the messy real-world edge cases of a logistics product  Drive the regression automation you need through the development teams rather than building it all yourself  Bring risk thinking into product discovery, acceptance criteria and definition of done, before development starts       About you   You came up through testing and have since moved well beyond manual test execution into analytical, risk-based quality work, with genuine product sense. You reason about risk, impact and probability, and you can justify what deserves testing effort and what doesn't. You're comfortable owning decisions, setting your own testing agenda, and turning ambiguity into structure. You communicate clearly - making risk tangible for both technical and non-technical people - and you build trust across product and engineering as a force multiplier, never a bottleneck. title: Chief Architect
description: CatalystOne is building the next generation of HCM products for the Nordic and Northern European market. Our platform is built by 15 product teams across Scandinavia and India, and we are scaling on several fronts at once: product complexity, AI adoption, platform modernisation, and the integration work that follows growth.     Each of those is manageable on its own. Together, they need a single architectural owner who can see the whole picture and set the direction. That is why we are hiring a Chief Architect.      As a Chief Architect in CatalystOne, some of your day-to-day tasks will be:    Owning and evolving the overall product architecture and target state across our HCM platform, including platform direction, domain boundaries, integration patterns and long-term modernisation priorities.  Owning, maintaining and evolving our architectural north star, balancing long-term sustainability with near-term delivery needs.  Curating our Technology Radar, providing transparency and guidance on technology choices.  Taking ownership of our architecture toolset (principles, patterns, reference architectures, ADR practices and decision records) that gives product teams practical guardrails and decision support as they move toward the target architecture.  Enabling autonomous, agile teams by setting constraints that increase flow, predictability and compliance.  Stepping in where local choices carry system-wide consequences, such as shared platform services, data ownership, identity, security, AI infrastructure or the integration of acquired systems.  Acting as a strategic partner for the product trios, collaborating closely with Product and Engineering leadership.  Supporting architectural decision-making across teams by enabling fast, well-documented decisions close to where the work happens, and by building architectural capacity within the teams themselves.  Representing architectural perspectives in strategic discussions within the CTO leadership group and Executive Management Team.       What this role focuses on:   You own the long-term, product-wide architecture. Implementation stays with the teams, and your job is to give them the tools and guardrails that make their decisions easier and safer.     In practice, that means working across 15 small teams of four to six people, each with a PM, a UX designer and a Tech Lead. You'll spend your time with the Tech Leads on technology choices and trade-offs, and just as much with the Product Owners, because what we build matters a great deal for how it should be built. You lead through principles, clarity and trust rather than approval queues.     AI is changing how our software is built and operated, and you help us adopt it in ways that make us more effective without loosening our grip on quality, security and compliance.     This is an individual contributor role reporting to the CTO and part of the CTO leadership team, with no direct personnel responsibility for now. Broad impact, close collabora

title: Software Test Manager
description: Job Summary  We are seeking an experienced  Software Test Manager  with strong expertise in the  Telecom domain  to lead and manage end-to-end testing activities for telecom applications and platforms. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in test management, QA strategy, automation, and telecom systems such as OSS/BSS, CRM, Billing, Order Management, Provisioning, and Network Operations.  Key Responsibilities   Define and implement test strategies, plans, and methodologies for telecom projects.  Lead and manage QA teams, including manual and automation testers.  Oversee all testing phases including SIT, System Testing, Regression Testing, UAT, and End-to-End Testing.  Ensure testing coverage for telecom applications across OSS/BSS ecosystems.  Coordinate with business stakeholders, project managers, developers, and vendors to ensure quality deliverables.  Manage defect lifecycle, risk assessment, and mitigation plans.  Drive test automation initiatives and continuous testing practices.  Establish and monitor QA metrics, KPIs, and quality benchmarks. Expertise with test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/QC, or TestRail.  Strong knowledge of API, Database, and Integration Testing.  Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Tosca.  Hands-on experience in performance and non-functional testing.  Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills.

title: Test Engineer
description: AutoStore’s R&D Test department plays a key role in ensuring the quality, functionality, and safety of our products by thoroughly testing hardware and software components—including firmware, mechanical systems, electrical and radio interfaces. As a Test Engineer, you’ll be responsible for running tests and verifications across the full hardware product portfolio, identifying issues and ensuring top-tier performance before release.  In this hands-on role, you’ll work with both early-stage prototypes and finalized modules, contributing to new development and sustaining projects. As a test engineer, you will take a leading role in cross functional teams, taking ownership of the testing, and being responsible for ensuring progress and high standards. Success in this role requires curiosity, attention to detail, and a deep interest in understanding how AutoStore’s systems operate. You’ll collaborate closely with colleagues across departments, combining desk-based analysis with active testing in our facilities to help deliver high-quality products to market.   Tasks And Responsibilities     Testing of AutoStore modules: robots, ports, adjacent technologies, their firmware and sub-components.   Preparation of formal test specifications and the set-up of test plans in cooperation with product developers.   Execution and automation of tests  Issue reporting, including route cause analysis and follow-up as part of the development process. title: Senior AI Engineer
location: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
description: Job Description    Aarhus, Denmark   Are you an experienced AI/ML engineer who wants to help us shape how we build, test and operate AI? We're a strong software organization looking for someone to mature our AI practice across our products, while a talented team grows around you.  Stakeholder Intelligence is a unit within Rambøll, with SaaS products including SurveyXact, PeopleXact and Heart&Mind. These products help organizations across the Nordics and Europe understand and improve the lives of the people who matter most to them, whether customers, patients, citizens, employees or children. For some, that means listening to stakeholders and turning their feedback into insight they can act on. For others, it means giving managers what they need to improve the working lives of their teams, or supporting practitioners in daycare and schools in their work on quality and children's development.  We work with sensitive data, and keeping it safe shapes how we build: we primarily run models on our own GPU servers, on-prem. We're expanding our SaaS portfolio with AI-driven value creation, and we're looking for a senior engineer to help us do it responsibly and at scale.   Where you fit in   We're early in our AI journey. We have a mature software organization (50 developers and designers) with deep strength in traditional software engineering, and a Platform Engineering team that builds the shared platform our product teams build and run on. But ML and LLM work is new to us, and our practices for evaluating, testing and operating these systems are still forming. We've recently begun building a dedicated AI Engineering function; it's still small, and much of its work happens alongside Platform Engineering.  AI Engineering at Stakeholder Intelligence is a shared craft. Our AI Engineers are talented but early in their careers. Each is primarily attached to a product team and works closely with that team, while spending a significant portion of their time on shared methods and tooling across products. As our senior engineer, you'll spend even more of your time working broadly across products, and your job is to shape that craft.  You won't own product direction; that stays with the product teams and their Tech Leads. What you'll shape is how we do ML/LLM engineering: the methods, standards and practices for how we develop, test, evaluate, deploy and operate the AI parts of our products. You'll provide direction, bring proven experience, and represent AI engineering in cross-functional discussions with Product Managers, Tech Leads and other senior voices.  This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with real influence, scoped to the experience you bring.   What You'll Do      Define our evaluation practice: how we determine whether one model, prompt or system genuinely outperforms another, drawing on methods such as golden datasets, deterministic checks, reference-based metrics, LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation. This is central to the role.  Es

title: AI SPECIALIST
description: WE'RE HIRING: AI SPECIALIST   📍 Abha, Saudi Arabia · On-site · Full-time     Since 2019, we've been building PVP from Abha: 10,000+ custom PC builds sold, 90,000+ registered users. title: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:

      URL:   http://one.pet

 We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains.

 
 This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction.

 
 Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy. 
  What You'll Do  
 Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic. 
 
 Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet. 
 Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions. 
 Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics. 
 Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost.

 Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results. 
 
 Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does. 
   
  How You'll Operate  
 You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute. 
 Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results. 
 You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes. 
 If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving. 
   
  How We'll Measure Success

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Als Customer Success Manager bij Trustoo ben jij de strategische partner die lokale ondernemers helpt hun business écht naar een hoger niveau te tillen., Als Customer Success Manager bij Trustoo ben jij de strategische partner die lokale ondernemers helpt hun business écht naar een hoger niveau te tillen.,   Bouw jij mee aan de groei van onze partners? Als Customer Success Manager bij Trustoo ben jij meer dan een aanspreekpunt; je bent de strategische partner die lokale ondernemers helpt hun business écht naar een hoger niveau te tillen.    Wie zijn wij?   Heb je ooit ervaren hoe uitdagend het kan zijn om snel en betrouwbaar een lokale dienstverlener te vinden zoals een schilder of boekhouder? Precies om deze uitdaging aan te pakken hebben wij in 2019 Trustoo opgericht. Trustoo is een online platform voor lokale ondernemers waar bezoekers heel gemakkelijk de beste bedrijven kunnen vinden. Denk aan een marktplaats voor hotels zoals Booking of een vergelijkingssite als Tripadvisor, maar dan voor lokale bedrijven.  Trustoo biedt in Nederland, Duitsland, België en Spanje aan zo’n 300.000 lokale bedrijven een podium om goed online vindbaar te zijn voor hun klanten. Dit kunnen wij uiteraard niet alleen: ons team bestaat uit meer dan 85 gedreven mensen die ervoor zorgen dat je elke dag met plezier naar je werk gaat. Al is het alleen maar om het potje tafeltennis of de vrijmibo.   Over de functie   Als Customer Success Manager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze partners. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor een portfolio van ondernemers en je bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. In deze rol zorg je ervoor dat partners het maximale uit ons platform halen. Je zorgt voor een succesvolle onboarding, geeft pro-actief advies over hun prestaties op ons platform, spot commerciële (cross- & upsell) kansen en denkt mee om processen te verbeteren om ons platform nog waardevoller te maken.   Wat ga je doen?     Je begeleidt onze nieuwe klanten in het systeem, van onboarding tot retentie, en zorgt ervoor dat zij vanaf dag 1 de waarde van het platform inzien.  Je pakt escalaties en complexe situaties op. Slimme AI agents worden ingezet voor het beantwoorden van eenvoudige ticket aanvragen.  Proactief contact onderhouden met partners: gesprekken, reviews, feedback ophalen.  Analyseren van data en KPI’s op klant niveau: waar lopen partners tegenaan, wat zijn kansen?  Je signaleert en springt in op commerciële kansen (Up- & cross sell) en herkent risico's en churn signalen waar je pro-actief actie op onderneemt.   Je werkt nauw samen met andere afdelingen zoals Sales, Product en Marketing om product- en partner ervaringen te verbeteren.   Je denkt mee in het verbeteren en automatiseren van interne processen met behulp van AI en automation tools.      Wie zoeken we?     Ervaring als Customer Success Manager, Account Management of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een B2B SaaS omgeving.  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands

Be seen, be understood, be you.    ' Role Overview   A Digital Customer Success Manager (Digital CSM) manages a pooled portfolio of accounts, focusing on scalable engagement and servicing rather than dedicated, one-to-one account management. Their primary goal is to drive adoption, retention, and satisfaction using centralised digital platforms such as the Brandwatch Success Hub, Customer Success Platforms, and Intercom.   Key Responsibilities     Customer Onboarding: Digital CSMs guide customers through a self-service onboarding experience using resources provided in the Success Hub. For eligible accounts, onboarding may involve automated communications (such as a welcome email from success@brandwatch.com), a lightly structured welcome call, and tailored resources via the Success Hub.  Portfolio Management: Digital CSMs manage a pool of accounts, optimising their capacity and engagement across a wide customer base rather than serving dedicated clients.  Customer Support & Inquiries: All customer questions and support tickets are submitted via the Success Hub or email and managed with Intercom. Digital CSMs monitor these tickets, triage inquiries, and provide resolutions, escalating product-related issues to the Support team as needed. Communication is always team-based and conducted via the central inbox (success@brandwatch.com), not personal emails.  Lifecycle Management & Success: CSMs ensure customers have the tools, resources, and guidance they need throughout the lifecycle — from onboarding through renewal. They provide usage insights, business reviews (often automated within the Success Hub), and recommendations tailored to each customer segment.  Collaboration With Internal Teams: Digital CSMs collaborate closely with Support, Sales, MDR, and Account Management to ensure smooth processes for lead transition, escalation, and upsell/cross-sell opportunities. Lead passing and ownership transitions are well-documented and tracked using Salesforce and collaborative tools.  Process Improvement & Scalability: As Brandwatch/Cision pivots to a digital-first CS model for certain segments, Digital CSMs help build, iterate, and scale internal processes. They often participate in pilot programs and provide feedback on platform improvements and workflow changes.     Scope & Coverage

title: Customer Service Manager
description: 🚀 Join the Wowcher Team - We're Hiring a Customer Service Manager 🚀       Location:  Derby (Embrace the office vibes – 4 days a week!)      Salary:  Up to £33,000 + Benefits     Are you a ready to dive into the world of WOW? Established in 2011, Wowcher is the ultimate destination for unbeatable deals and unforgettable experiences in the UK.     We’ve helped thousands of people learn dog grooming, steam clean their front rooms, obtain the latest gadgets, whiten their teeth, decorate their houses, eat more healthily and even be more experimental in the bedroom…! On top of this we’ve also partnered with some of the UK’s leading brands including Graze, Build-a-Bear Workshop, Odeon, Fitness First, Diet Chef, Very.co.uk, PrettyLittleThing, Random House, EasyJet and Ocado... to name just a few!     We’re entrepreneurs at heart and love to spot a great deal! If you’re interested in being able to have a major impact on a successful, fast growing company from day 1, then read on!      Your Mission:   This manager will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of our merchant services department. You will take ownership of all escalated queries and complaints into the department and will be responsible for handling the more complex tasks sent through the team, along with team reporting across a variety of channels. In this position, you will lead a small team and ensure that all departments are working together to achieve our goals. In addition to this you will help assist with the day-to-day team tasks across both teams, providing support to other team members, and assisting them with the day-to-day volume and queries. You’ll also be responsible for reviewing practices, identifying potential risks, maintaining team knowledge and reporting.      Your Tasks Include:    Conduct thorough analysis of refund data, leading meetings to address discrepancies and drive resolution.  Make strategic decisions to optimise customer satisfaction and service quality based on insights gained from data analysis.  Ensure strict adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) within both merchant and customer services, ensuring timely and efficient issue resolution.  Develop and elevate Net Promoter Scores (NPS) for merchants, fostering strong relationships and loyalty.  Lead and manage a team of employees, providing guidance and support as needed.  Proactively identify and address potential gaps in service delivery through forward planning.  Analyse data and make recommendations for improvements to processes, procedures, and systems mainly including an overview of results within customer service.  Handle customer complaints promptly and professionally, aiming for swift resolution and customer satisfaction.  Collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to ensure that business needs are being met.  Assist sales teams during merchant meetings by addressing service-related inquiries or concerns, ensuring seamless support and alignment with business goals.

Le Théâtre de la Ville est à la recherche d'un(e)** Responsable de la billetterie et de l'expérience client** afin de diriger les opérations de son service de billetterie et de contribuer à offrir une expérience client exemplaire à chaque étape du parcours de nos spectateurs.      Votre rôle   Vous assurez le bon fonctionnement de la billetterie, supervisez une équipe de préposé(e)s et veillez à offrir un service à la clientèle de grande qualité. Vous vous démarquez par :   • votre leadership mobilisateur;  • votre excellent sens de l'organisation;  • votre capacité d'analyse et votre aisance avec les données;  • votre approche orientée vers les solutions et l'amélioration continue;  • votre intérêt marqué pour les arts de la scène et le service au public.  Une bonne connaissance des outils Microsoft Office est requise. L'expérience avec un logiciel de billetterie (notamment Tuxedo) constitue un atout, tout comme une connaissance du milieu culturel.      Conditions   • Poste permanent à temps plein (35 heures/semaine);  • Horaire principalement de jour, du lundi au vendredi;  • Présence occasionnelle requise en soirée et les fins de semaine selon les activités.  • Avantages sociaux distinctifs (dont des assurances et une généreuse politique de vacances)      Qui sommes-nous   Depuis 36 ans, le Théâtre de la Ville participe activement à la vie culturelle de Longueuil et de la Rive-Sud en proposant à la population une grande variété de spectacles. description: Om jobbet   Er du struktureret, serviceminded og god til at få kunder og processer til at spille sammen?  Hos Hudevad Radiator Design søger vi en Customer Service Manager til vores nye kontor og showroom i København.  Du bliver et centralt bindeled mellem vores kunder, salg og resten af organisationen og får ansvar for, at kundehenvendelser og ordrer håndteres professionelt og effektivt fra første kontakt til endelig levering.  Størstedelen af din hverdag vil være centreret omkring vores danske kunder, men da Hudevad også opererer internationalt, vil du desuden få kontakt med udenlandske kunder og håndtere eksportordrer.  Vores gode og faste kollega gennem mange år har søgt nye græsgange, og vi leder derfor efter dig, der har lyst til at tage over og samtidig være med til at forme og udvikle rollen.      Din rolle   Som Customer Service Manager er du en vigtig del af den daglige kundekontakt og det kommercielle team. Du trives med at have mange bolde i luften og kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når telefonen ringer, ordren skal følges op, og en kunde har brug for et hurtigt svar.  Du har stærke kommunikationsevner og naturlig flair for at skabe gode relationer. Du kan sætte dig i kundens sted og finde løsninger, men kan også stå fast og kommunikere professionelt, når situationen kræver det.  Samtidig er du IT-stærk og har nemt ved at sætte dig ind i nye programmer og systemer.      Dine primære arbejdsopgaver er at   • håndtere kundehenvendelser professionelt og personligt via telefon og e-mail  • koordinere og følge op på ordrer fra bestilling til levering  • hjælpe kunder med information om produkter, priser og leverancer  • håndtere internationale kunder og eksportordrer  • samarbejde tæt med salg og øvrige kolleger om kunder og projekter  • følge op på leverancer og løse eventuelle udfordringer undervejs  • bidrage til at optimere arbejdsgange og processer inden for kundeservice og ordrehåndtering.     Vi er en mindre organisation, så der vil også opstå opgaver, som ikke nødvendigvis står i jobbeskrivelsen. Det ser vi som en naturlig og spændende del af jobbet.      Hvem er du?   Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre afgørende end din erfaring og måde at arbejde på.  Du har sandsynligvis erfaring fra kundeservice, salgsadministration, ordrebehandling, intern salgssupport eller en lignende B2B-funktion.  Det vigtigste er, at du brænder for god kundeservice, arbejder struktureret og trives som det bindeled, der får kunder, administration, logistik og salg til at hænge sammen. title: Customer Success Manager (H/F)
description: À propos d'Avest      Avest est une solution SaaS dopée à l'IA alliant CRM et génération de leads.     En quelques années, notre produit a conquis  plus de 400 agences immobilières , en France, en Suisse, au Luxembourg et en Belgique, et  plus de 3 500 professionnels de l'immobilier  l'utilisent aujourd'hui au quotidien. Nous poursuivons une forte croissance pour consolider notre position de référence des solutions digitales des agences immobilières.     Nos fondateurs (Centrale Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, Berkeley) ont plus de 15 ans d'expérience, passés par des cabinets de conseil de premier plan (McKinsey, Roland Berger), par des startups à succès et par l'entrepreneuriat.     Nous sommes une vingtaine dans l'équipe, avec de nombreux profils expérimentés du secteur de la tech (ex-Doctolib, ex-Auto1, ex-Groupon) et de l'immobilier (anciens agents et directeurs d'agence).     Notre ambition ? Transformer (véritablement) l'immobilier grâce à la data et à l'IA.      🌟 Ton rôle      Tu rejoins l'équipe Success, au contact quotidien des agences qui utilisent Avest.     Tu prends la responsabilité d'un portefeuille de clients, aux côtés de 3 autres Customer Success Managers et  en lien direct avec Louis, cofondateur  : dans une équipe de cette taille, tu as un fondateur à portée de main.      L'enjeu du poste  : notre solution est au cœur de l'activité des agences qui l'utilisent. La façon dont elles s'en servent pèse directement sur leurs résultats, et c'est là que tu interviens. Tu as un rôle essentiel dans la réussite de nos clients.     C'est un poste de  relation dans la durée , pas de support : tu n'attends pas qu'on te sollicite, tu prends des nouvelles.      📋 Tes missions     Connaître tes clients pour de vrai  : leur marché, leurs équipes, leurs objectifs et leurs résultats.   Repérer l'agence qui n'obtient pas les résultats qu'elle mérite , comprendre ce qui coince, et l'accompagner jusqu'à ce qu'elle reparte.   Faire monter les équipes des clients en compétence  sur l'outil, par téléphone et en visio.   T'assurer que leur paramétrage sert leur réussite , et l'ajuster quand ce n'est pas le cas.   Porter la voix de nos clients  auprès des équipes produit et marketing, et contribuer à ce qu'on construit pour eux.       🔎 Le profil     Une première expérience réussie en Customer Success , en relation client B2B ou en gestion de portefeuille.   De l'aisance au téléphone face à des dirigeants de TPE et de PME.  C'est le cœur du quotidien, pas une compétence secondaire.   De l'autonomie et de la régularité  : en télétravail, un poste se juge autant sur la constance que sur les coups d'éclat.   De la pédagogie  : savoir expliquer un outil à quelqu'un qui n'est pas technicien, sans le perdre.   De la curiosité pour l'immobilier et pour la tech.  Avoir travaillé dans l'immobilier est un vrai plus, pas un prérequis.       🚫 Ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi si     Tu cherches un poste de support  où l'on traite des tickets entrants. title: 상담팀 리드 (토스플랫폼 전담팀)
description: 합류하게 될 포지션에 대해 알려드려요    토스씨엑스는 '토스'를 운영하는 비바리퍼블리카의 금융 상담 전문 계열사예요. 금융 상담부터 지식서비스 기반의 운영성 업무까지, 500명 이상의 동료가 함께 만들어가고 있어요.  코어CX팀은 토스 앱의 핵심 서비스 전반에 대한 상담을 전담하는 팀이에요. 스쿼드 단위로 상담 조직을 운영하고 있고, 새로운 동료가 빠르게 적응하고 성장할 수 있도록 촘촘한 온보딩과 피플매니징 체계를 갖추고 있어요.  이탈 발생 시 즉각적으로 대체 인력을 배치하는 신속 대응 프로세스를 운영하며, 변화가 잦은 환경에서도 안정적인 상담 품질을 유지하는 데 강점이 있는 팀이에요.    합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요    스쿼드 운영 및 인력 관리  스쿼드 단위 Action Plan을 수립하고, 업무 분장과 진행 상황을 관리해요.  적정 인원을 산정해 스케줄링·스태핑을 운영하고, 충원 및 인원 변동사항을 관리해요.  지표 관리 및 실시간 이슈 대응  인입호·응답률·생산성 등 실시간 지표를 확인하고 성과 추이를 분석해요.  실시간 발생하는 이슈를 파악해 대응 방향을 고안하고, 유의미한 이슈는 VOC로 전달 및 후속 조치를 취해요.  피플 매니징  스쿼드에 배치된 신규 입사자/전환자의 온보딩을 리딩해요.  1:1 코칭, 동기부여, 갈등 해결 등 정서관리를 수행해요.  상담 품질 관리 (모니터링)  1차 응대에서 해결되지 않은 민원을 이관받아 원인을 파악하고 해결 방향을 제시해요.  상담원의 응대 품질을 모니터링하고 구체적인 피드백으로 코칭해요.    이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요    인하우스 혹은 BPO 상담/CX 조직에서 팀원 관리(피플매니징) 경험이 2년 이상인 분을 찾고 있어요.  지표 기반으로 팀을 운영해본 경험(KPI 모니터링, 스케줄링 등)이 있는 분을 찾고 있어요.  신규 입사자 온보딩 또는 1:1 코칭을 직접 리딩해본 경험이 필요해요.  2차 민원(에스컬레이션) 대응 경험이 있다면 좋아요.  QA·모니터링 기반 상담 코칭 경험이 있다면 좋아요.    이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요    피플매니징 경험을 구체적으로 작성해 주세요. 관리했던 인원 규모, 온보딩·코칭 방식 등을 함께 적어주시면 좋아요.  지표를 개선한 경험이 있다면, 어떤 지표를 어떻게 개선했는지 수치로 보여주세요.  2차 민원이나 이슈를 직접 해결한 사례가 있다면 꼭 포함해 주세요.  유사 도메인 경험이 없다면, 팀/조직을 운영하며 발휘한 문제 해결 방식 위주로 서술해 주세요.    꼭 확인해 주세요    신도림 본사에서 근무하는 포지션이에요. (신도림역 디큐브시티)  이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.  토스씨엑스 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소 될 수 있어요.    토스씨엑스로의 합류 여정    서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종합격 및 입사    함께할 동료를 위한 한 마디   "팀원들의 성장, 그리고 조직의 생산성을 함께 고민해요."   팀원의 성장과 고객의 만족, 그 사이에서 균형을 잡는 일. 토스씨엑스에서 상담 조직의 새로운 기준을 함께 세워갈 코어CX팀의 리드를 기다립니다.

Du skaper trivsel gjennom involvering og tydelig ansvarsfordeling.     Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter deg som er klar for å ta ansvar for at butikken skaper fantastiske kundeopplevelser! Fullført videregående utdanning.  Du er trygg på bruk av digitale verktøy.  Du behersker norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skrift.     Velkommen hjem!   Clas Ohlson tilbyr et inkluderende og oppmuntrende arbeidsmiljø der alle forventes å ta initiativ og tore å prøve nye ting. Din drivkraft og lyst til å utvikle Clas Ohlson sammen med oss er det som holder oss ett skritt foran. Vi tror på mangfold og mener at våre ansattes ulike bakgrunner, personligheter, erfaringer og ferdigheter er viktige for vår suksess.  I tillegg til å kunne vokse med oss, tilbyr vi også markedsbasert lønn, personalrabatt og variabel godtgjørelse. title: E-commerce Operations Manager
description: Om rollen      Vi söker en person med god analytisk förmåga, stark drivkraft och rätt potential att på sikt växa in i en E-commerce Manager-roll.     Som E-commerce Operations Manager blir du en nyckelperson i vår snabbväxande e-handel. Du ansvarar för att den operativa verksamheten fungerar effektivt från order till levererad produkt, samtidigt som du driver utveckling, förbättringar och nya initiativ som gör att verksamheten kan växa.     Rollen kombinerar daglig operativ problemlösning med långsiktigt utvecklingsarbete. Ena dagen löser du ett logistikproblem tillsammans med vårt lager eller en leverantör, nästa dag leder du ett projekt för att förbättra våra processer, utvärdera nya partners eller analysera hur vi kan arbeta smartare och mer kostnadseffektivt.     Du kommer att samarbeta nära flera delar av FirstVet – bland annat finans, produkt, marknadsföring, kundservice och tech – och blir en viktig länk mellan e-handeln och resten av organisationen.  Vi söker dig som trivs i en snabbt föränderlig miljö där du får stort eget ansvar, hög frihet och möjlighet att påverka hur verksamheten utvecklas.      Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter       Säkerställa att vår e-handelsoperation fungerar effektivt genom hela värdekedjan – från inköp och lager till logistik, plattform och kundservice.  Identifiera, prioritera och lösa operativa problem samt arbeta proaktivt för att förebygga framtida flaskhalsar.  Driva utvecklingen av vår operationsfunktion så att den kan växa i takt med verksamheten, bland annat genom förbättrade processer, kostnadseffektiviseringar och nya samarbeten.  Ansvara för utvecklingen av vårt produktsortiment tillsammans med relevanta intressenter, utifrån FirstVet’s positionering och kommersiell gångbarhet.  Bygga ett nära och effektivt samarbete med andra funktioner inom FirstVet, såsom finans, legal, marknadsföring, produkt och tech.  Delta i det strategiska arbetet kring e-handeln och omsätta den kommersiella strategin till konkreta förbättringar inom operations.  Ansvara för samarbetet med viktiga kommersiella partners, framför allt leverantörer, inklusive prisförhandlingar, avtal, kampanjer och gemensamma utvecklingsinitiativ.  Driva egna projekt och förbättringsinitiativ inom e-handeln utifrån verksamhetens behov.       Vi tror att du       Har en relevant universitetsutbildning om minst tre år.  Har cirka tre års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom e-handel eller närliggande verksamhet.  Är van att ta egna initiativ och driva arbete från idé till genomförande.  Har ett analytiskt arbetssätt och är bekväm med att fatta beslut baserade på data.  Är kommunikativ och tycker om att samarbeta med många olika funktioner.  Är prestigelös och trivs med att växla mellan strategiska frågor och operativt arbete.  Är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och trivs i ett högt tempo. description: About Sayari:    Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce.
