title: Head of Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM)
description: Do you want to lead how we in If define and develop customer relationships across the full customer lifecycle in the Nordics?   We are establishing a new strategic capability area within Digital Sales & Customer Experience - Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM). With this new leader role, we aim to create clearer accountability, stronger Nordic alignment, and continued development of a key strategic capability area which drives both business growth and customer satisfaction.  As  Head of Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM)  at If, you will be responsible for setting the direction for the strategic management and optimization of the end-to-end customer lifecycle, defining what customer outcomes and lifecycle experiences we aim to create, and how customer relationships are developed holistically across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and win-back.   About The Role   This is a senior leadership role with a broad strategic mandate. You will lead and evolve the Customer Lifecycle Management capability area, ensuring a clear direction for lifecycle strategies, customer engagement principles and concepts, and omnichannel customer experience models. You will lead a team of 3 leaders for Customer Engagement Chapters, consisting of approximately 20 specialists.  In addition, you will play a central role in shaping the new Capability Area setup in Customer Engagement & Analytics. The role combines people leadership and capability development with strategic coordination across related chapters and markets. In this role you will report to the Head of Customer Engagement & Analytics.   In this role you will     Lead, develop, and evolve the Customer Lifecycle Management capability area across the Nordics in Business Area Private.  Own the strategic direction and key concepts for end-to-end customer lifecycle management across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and win-back.  Contribute to marketing, sales, service, and loyalty frameworks that drive growth, support business priorities and customer needs.  Partner closely with Tribes and key business stakeholders (e.g., from Sales, Product and Partnership teams) to identify new opportunities while measuring customer and business impact. Collaborate closely with Customer Analytics, CRM and other relevant Capability Areas to ensure we can translate lifecycle strategies and engagement principles into executable customer engagement and automation requirements. As a person you are open minded and patient which also reflects in the way you communicate. We are a small team who cares about our customers and importantly for each other    Handling requests from Sales Colleagues and Customers for support for all aspects after placing the order. title: Quality Manager
description: Job Summary   The  Quality Manager  is responsible for developing, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the organization’s healthcare quality and patient safety systems. The role ensures compliance with applicable  healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, clinical policies, quality indicators, patient safety requirements, and internal procedures . The Quality Manager works closely with clinical and non-clinical departments to identify risks, monitor performance, conduct audits, investigate incidents, implement corrective and preventive actions, and promote a culture of continuous quality improvement. Should be familiar with  DHA requirements  as well as relevant international accreditation standards. DHA maintains healthcare standards, inspection checklists, performance measures, and regulatory requirements for licensed facilities.  Key Responsibilities     Quality Management System  Develop, implement, and maintain the healthcare facility’s Quality Management System (QMS).  Develop annual quality and patient safety plans aligned with organizational objectives.  Establish quality objectives, indicators, targets, and improvement priorities.  Maintain quality policies, procedures, guidelines, forms, and controlled documents.  Ensure effective document control and version management.  Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement across all departments.   Patient Safety & Risk Management  Lead patient safety initiatives and risk-reduction programs.  Monitor and analyze patient safety incidents, adverse events, near misses, medication errors, falls, complaints, and clinical risks.  Coordinate incident investigation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).  Develop and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).  Conduct risk assessments and maintain risk registers.  Escalate serious incidents and high-risk findings to appropriate management.   Clinical & Quality Audits  Develop and execute annual clinical and operational audit plans.  Conduct medical record/documentation audits.  Monitor compliance with clinical policies, procedures, and approved guidelines.  Audit infection prevention and control, medication management, patient identification, consent, documentation, emergency preparedness, and other quality-sensitive processes.  Prepare audit reports and follow up on action plans.  Track closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.   Quality Indicators & Performance Monitoring  Develop and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and quality indicators.  Prepare monthly and quarterly quality dashboards.  Analyze trends, variances, and performance gaps.  Present quality performance to senior management and relevant committees.  Use data to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes.   Accreditation & Regulatory Compliance  Coordinate organizational readiness for DHA inspections and other regulatory assessments.  Support preparation for accreditation surveys such as JCI, CBAHI, ISO 9001,

Keine endlosen Strategierunden ohne Ergebnis, sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge wirklich voranbringen. Das Team ist klein, agil, mit Büro in München – und sucht jetzt jemanden, der KI-Trainings selbstständig übernimmt und gleichzeitig in Kundenprojekten mitwächst.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du begleitest 20 Stunden pro Woche KI-Projekte – die ersten 3 Monate im Hintergrund zur Einarbeitung, danach mit wachsender Verantwortung
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam und erfahrenen AI Engineers zusammen

title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code wit

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python/Django + Vue.js)
description:
Important: You must be based in Berlin for this role. We offer flexibility to work from home, but this is not a remote-from-anywhere position.

Hivebuy is a Berlin-based B2B procurement SaaS transforming how companies manage purchasing, approvals, orders, invoices, budgets and suppliers.

We’re building much more than a CRUD application. Our platform combines complex procurement workflows, multi-tenant architecture, ERP and accounting integrations, real-time functionality and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to help us build and evolve this platform.

We’re looking for a T-shaped engineer: someone with deep backend expertise who is also comfortable following a feature across the entire stack. You don’t need to be equally strong in Django and Vue, but you should be willing and able to understand, change and ship both.

Our core stack includes Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Elasticsearch, Vue 3, TypeScript and AWS. We run our services on ECS Fargate, manage infrastructure with Terraform, and use Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry and CloudWatch to understand what’s happening in production.

AI coding agents are a normal part of how we develop software. We believe they make strong engineers significantly more effective, but they also make judgment, verification and ownership more important, not less.

Tasks

  • Own features end-to-end. Understand the problem, challenge requirements when necessary, design the solution, implement it, test it, deploy it and verify that it actually works in production.
  • Design and build backend services and APIs using Python, Django and Django REST Framework.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Elasticsearch to build reliable, scalable application and background-processing workflows

We're deepening our billing capabilities to support new sales models, market expansions, and financial integrations that directly shape how small businesses experience SumUp — and this role is central to making that happen.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain backend services and frontend interfaces across our billing, contracts, and merchant wallet products

  • Support the expansion of our billing and wallet capabilities into new markets, helping ensure localisation requirements are met
  • Take part in our weekly support rotation, handling incoming customer queries and helping maintain platform stability
  • Work closely with senior engineers and product managers to deliver features end-to-end, from implementation through to production

You'll be great for this role if

  • Solid experience building full stack applications, with a backend focus. Ideally comfortable with Node.js or Go, though we're open to other backend languages.
  • Comfortable working with both relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and non-relational databases (such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, or Redis).
  • Practical frontend experience working with React and Next.js, with the ability to write clean, typed code in TypeScript or JavaScript.

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description: Duetto's quality engineering function is being built from the ground up — and this is the role that defines what it becomes. As Lead Quality Engineer, you'll architect the test automation infrastructure, quality gate logic, and shared tooling that make high-quality testing the path of least resistance for every engineering team. You'll be operating in a system actively in transformation: a live monolith-to-microservices migration, a consolidation to Playwright, and a codebase where 50–70% of code is AI-generated at scale. If you're a senior quality engineer who leads with coaching rather than gatekeeping and thrives on building things that last, this is your role.   What Makes Us Different?   Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.   What You'll Be Doing    You'll architect quality gate logic within GitHub Actions CI pipelines — defining coverage thresholds, mutation score gates, contract test enforcement, flaky test quarantine rules, and automated result reporting — and build DataDog quality dashboards tracking test health, coverage trends, and flaky test rates across the engineering organisation.  You'll spearhead the migration from Selenium and Cypress to a consolidated Playwright framework — owning the shared configuration, CI sharding strategy, and page object library design — while driving PR pipeline test execution toward the P90 target of under 15 minutes through systematic flakiness reduction and pipeline optimisation.  You'll design and implement Pact contract testing for service boundaries created during the monolith-to-microservices extraction — managing the Pact broker, establishing consumer-driven contract testing as standard practice, and owning API contract testing across service boundaries.  You'll design and maintain Testcontainers configurations for MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, LocalStack, and RabbitMQ to support reliable, reproducible integration test environments across the engineering organisation.  You'll champion AI-augmented testing practices using Claude Code, CodeRabbit, and Augment — accelerating test generation, migration, and review at scale, and evaluating AI-generated test code for correctness, coverage gap

title: Partner Success Manager
description: The Role & It's Impact   As a Partner Success Manager, you will play a vital part in accelerating the growth of our accounting and bookkeeping partners across New Zealand. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, helping firms realise the full value of the Xero ecosystem by providing the strategy and education they need to increase their revenue and better support their small business clients.  By combatting churn and identifying opportunities for plan upgrades, you will ensure that our partners and their clients have the best technology at their fingertips to make running a beautiful business possible.   This Team & How They Connect   In this full time, permanent role you will join a high-performing team reporting to our Manager of Partner Success, where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with our Partner Consulting teams to deliver a seamless service, sharing insights and feedback to ensure our partners' voices are heard.   Initially, You Will Focus On     Developing and executing territory plans to increase the adoption of Business Edition plans and connected payment services.  Planning and hosting events designed to educate partners on the mechanics and benefits of the Xero Partner programme.  Deepening online strategies within practices to increase active users and influence the adoption of adjacent products.  Using Salesforce to manage relationship health and identify potential risk areas for early mitigation.     Where And How You Can Work   This is a permanent, full-time role based in Auckland. We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the flexibility of remote work with purposeful "boost days" in the office to connect and collaborate with the wider team.   Here are some of the things we are looking for:     You bring a proven track record in sales performance, specifically within financial technology or accounting software environments.  Your ability to create quick rapport and manage long-term relationships with senior stakeholders helps you become a go-to advisor.  You possess the public speaking skills and enthusiasm required to present effectively at partner events and webinars.  You demonstrate plenty of initiative and the ability to work autonomously to meet and exceed expectations.  A genuine passion for making a difference and an intrigue for the emerging online accounting market drives your work.    At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team so we encourage you to apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match!

title: Customer Solutions Manager - Protected Categories (L.68/99 Art.1)
description: Description   “This position is preferably intended for candidates belonging to Protected Categories with certification as beneficiary law 68/99 Art.1 (employment of people with disability) “.  As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) you will be responsible for helping guide the largest and most complex Italian customers along their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this highly visible position you will ensure that all AWS teams are working together effectively and efficiently to deliver outcomes for the customer.  In the role, you will be a critical partner to our AWS customers, leveraging your delivery experience with large scale transformations to help shepherd the customer through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.  You will interface with AWS customers and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.  At AWS, you are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/ Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.  Successful candidates will have a strong delivery and change management background, be detail oriented, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.  You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers in adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and inspiring innovation. You will be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of your customers successful adoption of AWS.  Do you look around corners for ways to engage and service customers? Are you passionate about using technology to solve business problems that have big customer impact?  Come build the future with us.  The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Som leder tror jeg på frihet under ansvar og gir mine medarbeidere stor tillit og fleksibilitet til å lykkes på sin egen måte. Samtidig er jeg tydelig på mål og forventninger, og jeg er opptatt av tett dialog, god oppfølging og å skape et inkluderende miljø hvor vi utfordrer hverandre, har det gøy sammen og feirer suksessene våre som et team. I rollen samarbeider du tett med kolleger i eget team, samt med Solution Sales, Customer Success og andre fagmiljøer på tvers av Dustin. Ved å kombinere kompetanse og innsikt på tvers av organisasjonen sikrer vi at kundene våre får den beste opplevelsen og de riktige løsningene for sine behov. Vi går for en rettferdig

title: Customer Success Manager - Aarhus
description: Bliv Customer Success Manager for vores storkunder og partnere hos Telavox 💼   Hos Telavox tror vi på, at de bedste kundeoplevelser skabes gennem stærke relationer og stærke tekniske løsninger. Du bliver deres faste kontaktperson og følger dem hele vejen – fra den kommercielle overdragelse og implementering til den daglige sparring, udvikling af samarbejdet og løbende optimering. Samtidig arbejder du proaktivt med at skabe værdi, styrke relationerne og identificere nye muligheder for at udvikle samarbejdet.  Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i Sales, Support, Product og Engineering for at sikre, at kunder og partnere får en sammenhængende oplevelse – hver gang.   Dine Arbejdsopgaver   Du kommer blandt andet til at:    Onboarde nye kunder og partnere – fra overdragelse til Go Live.  Konfigurere og implementere Telavox-løsninger, så de matcher kundens behov og forretningsprocesser.  Planlægge og afholde onboarding-møder, tekniske workshops og uddannelsesforløb.  Rådgive kunder og partnere om den optimale opsætning af deres Telavox-løsning.  Fejlsøge tekniske udfordringer og koordinere løsninger i samarbejde med interne specialister.  Være teknisk sparringspartner for både IT-afdelinger og forretningsansvarlige.  Understøtte integrationer og tekniske implementeringer samt koordinere komplekse leverancer.  Drive kontraktfornyelser samt identificere muligheder for mersalg og udvikling af samarbejdet.  Opbygge og udvikle stærke, langvarige relationer med både kunder og partnere.  Koordinere leverancer og sikre fremdrift på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter.  Følge op på kundetilfredshed og sikre, at kunder og partnere får maksimal værdi af Telavox. Du motiveres af at hjælpe kunder med at lykkes og trives i en rolle, hvor du kombinerer teknologi, projektledelse og kommerciel rådgivning.  Du tager naturligt ejerskab, er nysge

Dr.Dropin Bedrift søker en Customer Success Manager til kundene av vårt nye digitale verktøy   Vil du være med å løse sykefraværsutfordringen i Norge sammen med noen av landets dyktigste gründere?   Dr.Dropin Bedrift søker en Customer Success Manager som vil være med å bygge opp hvordan vi skal ivareta kundene av Sykefraværshjelpen, vårt nye SaaS-produkt som veileder ledere og ansatte gjennom sykefraværsoppfølgingen, steg for steg.  Om Dr.Dropin Bedrift    Startet i august 2022 som Dr.Dropins satsning på bedriftskunder, med ambisjon om å skape et friskere norsk arbeidsliv  Gjeng på 80 ildsjeler som brenner for å gi kundene våre det de ønsker, med moderne digitale løsninger, høy kvalitet og gode priser. Kraftig vekst siden lansering har gitt oss 3,000 bedriftskunder i hele Norge  Kontor midt i Oslo sentrum sammen med resten av Dr.Dropin-gruppen (flytter fra Majorstuen til Posthuset i desember), med tette bånd til gründermiljøet i Askeladden & Co    Vi er et scaleup i høyt tempo, uformelt og med stor drivkraft. Her får du prege kultur og utvikling i en virksomhet med store vekstambisjoner. Vi bryr oss mer om hva du oppnår enn hvordan du kommer dit, gir deg stor frihet i arbeidsmetode og heier på deg hele veien.  Om Sykefraværshjelpen  Sykefravær er en av Norges største samfunnsutfordringer. Problemet ligger ofte i mangelfullt samspill mellom leder og ansatt: ansatte kjenner ikke sine plikter, og ledere unngår vanskelige spørsmål i frykt for å trå feil. Resultatet er lengre og hyppigere sykefravær enn nødvendig.  Sykefraværshjelpen er et digitalt, interaktivt verktøy som gjør oppfølgingen enkel for ledere og ansatte, med bistand fra sykefraværsspesialister rett rundt hjørnet.  Verktøyet er live, med flere store bedrifter som står på vent for onboarding.  Du blir primær kundekontakt for konseptet, og den som har stålkontroll på kundebehov og customer-facing rutiner. I tillegg vil du samarbeide tett med kommersiell leder, strategileder, utviklerne og salgsteamet. Rollen innebærer ikke personalansvar i dag.  Dine arbeidsoppgaver  Dette er et nytt konsept og en ny rolle - så her får du være med å forme begge deler og veien blir til mens vi går! Her får du eie en funksjon i en satsning fra dag én - om 2 år kommer mye av måten Customer Success fungerer på til å være bygget av deg. Du blir personen som eier kundeopplevelsen og den operative riggen av et helt nytt produkt - fra onboarding av de de største selskapene i Norge, til CRM, AI-automatisering og utvikling av måten vi jobber på. Er du lei av en irriterende rutine, forventer vi ikke at du lærer deg å leve med den - vi forventer at du forbedrer den. Du blir kontaktpersonen som ivaretar og følger opp daglig leder eller HR-ansvarlig hos store bedriftskunder, og får fullt ansva

title: Eftermarkedschef

description: Bring dit gode lederskab i spil og vær med til at sikre videre udvikling af vores eftermarkedsaktiviteter, høj kundetilfredshed og stærkt samarbejde.         ANSVAR FOR EFTERMARKEDET    Hos Bayern Autogroup i Kolding søger vi en Eftermarkedschef, hvor du får til ansvar at lede den daglige drift af en organisation med dedikerede medarbejdere på tværs af indskrivning, mekanisk værksted, reservedelslager og service satellit i Sønderborg. Gennem professionel rådgivning og service vil I sammen sikre høj effektivitet, kvalitet og kundetilfredshed.   Som budgetansvarlig for eftermarkedet vil du i tæt samarbejde med vores erfarne værkstedschef på værkstedet og reservedelschef, stå for at kvalitetssikre de interne processer og det udførte arbejde. Du vil således blive ansvarlig for ikke blot at sikre opnåelsen af de fastsatte budgetmål, men også for at motivere teamet og bidrage til et stærkt samarbejde på tværs af afdelingerne.   Med reference til Eftermarkedsdirektøren for Bayern Autogroup, vil du ligeledes sammen med den lokale Salgschef, være ansvarlig for at drive lokationen og sikre stærkt samarbejde mellem salg og eftermarked.       TEKNISK STÆRK MED ET SKARPT OVERBLIK    Vi forestiller os du kommer fra en lignende stilling i autobranchen, hvor du har været vandt til at arbejde med planlægning og drift af en eftermarkedsafdeling. Alternativt kommer du fra en stilling som værkstedschef og er klar til det næste skridt i din karriere. Personligt besidder du et naturligt ledertalent og formår at samle og motivere et team til at præstere det ypperste for således at sikre høj effektivitet og god kundetilfredshed. Du er en synlig leder, og du forstår at udvikle både forretningen og medarbejdere.       HVAD KAN VI TILBYDE DIG?   Vores forhandlerkæde Bayern AutoGroup A/S har seks forretninger i Danmark, hvor målsætningen er at være de danske BMW & MINI entusiasters foretrukne bilforhandler. Din arbejdsplads vil blive i Kolding, hvor du vil blive en del af et bilhus med et godt internt samarbejde, og hvor dygtige og engagerede kolleger, ser frem til at tage godt imod dig.  Som medarbejder hos Bayern AutoGroup bliver du desuden en del af Nic. Christiansen Gruppen, en koncern i en rivende udvikling, hvor det daglige arbejde kredser rundt om biler og mobilitetsløsninger.   Sammen med dine cirka 1.600 kolleger i Danmark og Tyskland får du blandt andet adgang til:    Gode medarbejdervilkår med pension, sundhedsforsikring, flere årlige udviklingssamtaler og et arbejdsmiljø i topklasse   Uddannelse og træning - Vi investerer i vores medarbejderes fremtid med træningsprogrammer og mulighed for efteruddannelse  Teamkultur - Vi har en stærk teamånd, hvor samarbejde og kollegial støtte er i fokus og hvor vores værdier ordentlighed, ambition, sammenhold og passion skinner igennem, både i vores nærvær med kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere  Firmature og sociale arrangementer - Deltag i vores mange arrangementer, der styrker fællesskabet  Attraktive medarbejd

title: Customer Succes Manager Cashless
description: Ben jij klaar om je bureaustoel in te ruilen voor de mainstage?   De poorten gaan open. Tienduizenden bezoekers stromen binnen. Iedereen wil tegelijk naar binnen én een biertje halen. Het netwerk piept en kraakt, de spanning stijgt. Dit is het moment waar jij voor leeft.  Bij Weeztix zoeken we geen manager die vanaf de zijlijn toekijkt. Wij zoeken een Cashless Koning(in). Iemand die durft te pionieren met onze nieuwste features (Cashless, Access & Accreditatie) en zorgt dat onze klanten, van grote festivals en stadions tot intieme poppodia, vlekkeloos draaien.   Jouw Rol in de Spotlight   Dit is geen standaard kantoorbaan; dit is topsport. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het onboarden, trainen en ondersteunen van onze klanten in het midden- en grootsegment. Jij bent de reden dat organisatoren 's nachts rustig slapen.  Jij bent het gezicht van Weezpay op de vloer. In de zomermaanden is jouw kantoor daar waar het feest is. Je werkt in de weekenden, je lost problemen op on the spot en je viert het succes met de klant als de laatste bezoeker tevreden naar huis gaat. In de winter? Dan pak je je rust, geniet je van je opgebouwde uren en werk je aan strategieën voor het volgende seizoen.   Dit ga je doen:     The Pioneer: Weeztix breidt uit met Cashless en Access. Jij bent degene die deze nieuwe innovaties uitrolt bij onze klanten. Jij zet de standaard.  The Fixer: Jij bent op locatie aanwezig. Loopt er iets vast? Jij bent de go-to person. Jij blijft koel als anderen stressen en hebt affiniteit en kennis van de techniek.  The Builder: Je bouwt ijzersterke relaties op. Je snapt wat de klant nodig heeft nog voordat ze het zelf weten.  The Bridge: Jij vertaalt de feedback van het festivalterrein naar onze teams op kantoor. Samen maken we van Weeztix een geoliede machine.      Jij bent de Headliner als...   Jij energie krijgt van actie. Je bent ambitieus, ondernemend en niet te stoppen. Je snapt dat de evenementenindustrie een lifestyle is, geen 9 tot 5 baan.    Mindset: Je bent communicatief ijzersterk, gastvrij, maar durft ook risico's te nemen.  Drive: Je wilt bouwen aan iets nieuws. Je wacht niet af, je pakt aan.  Flexibiliteit: Weekenden werken op een festivalterrein klinkt voor jou als een droom, niet als een straf.  Skills: Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring in een rol waar klantcontact centraal staat. Daarnaast is technische kennis of affiniteit met de techniek een must in deze rol.      Welkom bij de Weeztix Family   Wij zijn Weeztix. Sinds 2015 de uitdager in de ticketingmarkt en sinds 2025 de game changer in cashless en access. Ons systeem draait in 102 landen en verwerkt miljoenen tickets. Dat doen we met 70 collega's.  We zijn jong, snelgroeiend en houden van gezelligheid. We werken hard voor onze successen, maar vieren ze nog harder.   Wat krijg je van ons     Een brand new office in Amsterdam in een jong en gedreven team  In de zomer vlammen op de vetste festivals (gratis toegang!), in de winter meer vrij

description: PCT Client Service Team 6, PCT Operations Service 1, PCT Operations Division, PCT Services Department, Patents and Technology Sector     Contract Duration - 2 years (maximum cumulative length of 5 years) *  Duty Station: CH-Geneva     Application Deadline: 17-Sep-2026, 11:59:00 PM CET        This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.         1. Organizational Context      a.  Organizational Setting      The post is located in the PCT Operation Team 6, PCT Operations Service 1, PCT Operations Division, PCT Services Department, Patents and Technology Sector. The PCT Operations Division is responsible for the receipt, formalities examination, publication and communication of applications and related documents filed under the PCT and delivering high-quality customer services to PCT users in all 10 official PCT publication languages.     b.  Purpose Statement   The main role of the incumbent is a focal point for big clients and IT related issues and acts as customer services and formalities examination expert.     c.  Reporting Lines      The incumbent works under the supervision of the Team Head, PCT Operations Team 6.     d. Duties and Responsibilities      The incumbent will perform the following principal duties:      a.  Serve as focal point for a number of "key accounts" (major applicants and their agents), analyzing the situation of each, setting up regular contacts, providing guidance and dedicated trainings to ensure a high level of customer service.      b.  Provide expert PCT Business input to development activities relating to the PCT system including IT tools and PCT rule changes.      c.  Compile and analyze workload and productivity statistics and make proposals to Operations Team Head on how to increase efficiency and timeliness of work outputs.      d.  Based on survey results, feedback from users, and issues raised by formalities examiners, draft inputs for the update and continuous development of the knowledge base; ensure knowledge sharing within the team.      e. title: Customer Operations Manager
description: Customer Operations Manager | Atención al Cliente | Industria y Fabricación  ¿Te gusta ser la pieza que conecta comercial y producción?  ¿Disfrutas liderando equipos y resolviendo antes de que el problema llegue al cliente?  Entonces este reto es para ti.   Sobre la empresa   Te incorporarás a una empresa industrial con producción propia y una red comercial activa a nivel nacional e internacional, que trabaja bajo pedido para clientes exigentes y con procesos técnicos de diseño y fabricación de piezas.  Es una organización donde el servicio al cliente marca la diferencia: cada oferta, cada plazo y cada incidencia se gestionan con el mismo rigor con el que se fabrica.  Tu base estará en el departamento de atención al cliente, en contacto directo con dirección comercial, producción y departamento técnico.   Tu reto     Liderar y motivar a un equipo de entre 6 y 8 personas de atención al cliente, nacional e internacional, marcando el ritmo y el criterio del departamento.  Ser el nexo real entre comercial y fábrica: recoger la información técnica de cada nuevo proyecto y trasladarla con precisión al departamento técnico y de producción.  Calcular costes de fabricación junto al equipo técnico y dar seguimiento a las ofertas en curso hasta su cierre.  Supervisar el plan de entregas y anticiparte a incidencias de producción, transporte o plazo, manteniendo siempre informado al cliente.  Dar soporte directo a los comerciales en la gestión de presupuestos, apertura de nuevos clientes y seguimiento mensual de cuentas activas.    Aquí no se trata solo de atender. Se trata de sostener, con criterio propio, el punto donde comercial y fábrica se encuentran.   Lo que buscamos     Experiencia gestionando equipos de atención al cliente en entornos industriales o de fabricación.  Una persona activa, atenta y con actitud proactiva, que se anticipe en lugar de esperar instrucciones.  Firmeza y autocontrol para liderar un equipo de tamaño medio, combinados con cercanía real.  Visión de negocio: entender que cada decisión en el día a día tiene impacto directo en el cliente y en el resultado.  Valorable nivel de francés e inglés.     Lo que ofrecemos     Un puesto con impacto real y visibilidad directa ante Dirección General.  Una posición que no es administrativa: es la que sostiene la relación entre comercial, fábrica y cliente.     Por qué este proyecto es diferente   No es un puesto de soporte. Es el engranaje que hace que comercial y fábrica funcionen como una sola pieza, y que el cliente lo note.

description: 직무 설명    Department Manager로서, 고객 경험을 향상시키고 매출을 증대시키는 것은 물론, 영감을 주고 초대하는 분위기를 조성하는 중요한 역할을 하게 됩니다. 헌신적인 팀과 함께, 탁월한 서비스와 운영의 우수성을 제공하는 데 앞장서게 될 것입니다. 팀을 통해 진정성 있고 개인화된, 언제나 환영 받는 쇼핑 경험을 만들어 나가게 됩니다. H&M 그룹은 채용 전 과정에서 다양성을 중요하게 생각하며, 우리가 속한 지역 사회의 가치를 반영하는 인재들과 함께 성장하고자 합니다.

title: Asiakasvastaava
description: Haemme uutta tiimiläistä asiakaspidon pariin!      Kasvamme kovaa vauhtia, ja se tarkoittaa yhä enemmän asiakkaita, joista pitää pitää huolta. Etsimme nyt uutta osaajaa varmistamaan, että jokainen asiakkaamme on tyytyväinen ja viihtyy meidän kanssamme pitkään.     Onko tavoitteesi ura, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan asiakkaiden tyytyväisyyteen?     Etsimme innostunutta ja huolellista henkilöä, joka kuuntelee asiakasta herkällä korvalla, osaa asettua asiakkaan asemaan ja haluaa varmistaa, että jo ostaneet asiakkaat saavat parhaan mahdollisen kokemuksen. Voit olla alalle pyrkivä ja innokas oppimaan, tai kokenut konkari, joka tuo mukanaan vahvan osaamisen, tärkeintä on asenne. Jos haluat olla osa nuorekasta työympäristöä, nauttia joustavista työmahdollisuuksista ja päästä mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuden huipputiimiä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö!      Mitä odotamme sinulta?       Tiimipelaajan asennetta: Osaat työskennellä saumattomasti myyjien rinnalla ja varmistaa yhdessä sujuvan asiakaspolun.   Asiakaslähtöisyyttä: Osaat asettua asiakkaan asemaan ja huomaat, kun jotain on hoidettava ennakoivasti.   Kuuntelutaitoja: Tunnistat asiakkaan tarpeet ja osaat kysyä, mikä olisi voitu tehdä paremmin.  Rehellisyyttä: Uskot avoimeen ja rehelliseen kommunikointiin asiakkaiden ja tiimin kanssa.  Pilkettä silmäkulmassa: Positiivinen asenteesi ja huumorintajusi tekevät sinusta arvokkaan tiimikaverin.       Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?       Nuorekas työympäristö: Energinen ja avoin tiimi, joka haastaa perinteiset näkemykset.  Joustavat työmahdollisuudet: Mahdollisuus etätyöhön ja joustaviin työaikoihin.  Reilu ja selkeä palkkaus  Työsuhdeauto: Koeajan jälkeen mahdollisuus työsuhdeautoon.  Mahdollisuus kasvaa mukana: Olemme kasvaneet kovaa vauhtia, ja sinulla on mahdollisuus hypätä mukaan matkalle, joka vie meidät huipulle.       Työnkuva       Työskentely tiiminä rinnakkain jokaisen myyjän kanssa, jotta asiakaskokemus pysyy saumattomana koko matkan ajan.  Jo ostaneiden asiakkaiden (autot, koneet ja laitteet) tyytyväisyyden varmistaminen.  Säännöllinen yhteydenpito asiakkaisiin ja palautteen kerääminen. description: Moonlight makes performance headlamps built to last. We design them to be repaired rather than replaced, and we build and service them at our own factory and repair center in Åndalsnes. Dalux er allerede godt etablert i Norge og Oslo-området.  私たちは今、5年後の再上場を目指し、非連続的成長を遂げる最もエキサイティングな変革期（第二創業期）にいます。この挑戦は変化、激動、カオスを伴います。しかし、これを困難な逆境と捉えるのか、あるいは未来を切り拓く最高の舞台と捉えるのか。私たちは迷わず後者を選びます。だからこそ、この挑戦を一緒に楽しみに変えられる仲間、「ゲームチェンジャー」を求めています。ゲームチェンジャーの役割を果たすうえで当社が重要視するのは、自己の能力を磨き続け、自律的に働き方を選択することで、他にはない成果を発揮する人材、「ユニーク・パフォーマー」です。その活躍を支える環境として、自律的なキャリア形成をサポートする制度はもちろん、成果を最大化できるよう、働く場所と時間を選択できる制度も導入しています。 持続的な企業成長には生産性向上が不可欠であり、「人的資本経営」の重要性がかつてないほど高まっています。その中核を担うのが「タレントマネジメント」です。本音の人材情報を活用し、個人と組織の潜在能力を最大限に引き出すことで、企業はさらなる高みを目指せます。  カオナビは、個の力を最大化し、組織をより強くするためのタレントマネジメントシステムです。人事業務の効率化から戦略人事の実現まで、幅広い目的に対応。人材データプラットフォームに蓄積された個のデータをAIと掛け合わせることで、「個の力の最大化」による盤石な組織を築き、企業の成長を力強く後押しします。   募集背景   タレントマネジメントシステム「カオナビ」は、2025年9月末時点で4,500社を超える企業様に導入いただいています。昨今、人的資本経営への関心の高まりからお問合せが急増しており、さらなる事業拡大に向けてセールス部門の強化が急務となっています。  労働生産性の向上や、個々の才能を活かすマネジメントの実現など、正解のない人事課題に共に向き合い、解決へと導いていただけるアカウントコンサルティング職を募集します。   業務内容   【顧客】  従業員数1,000名～10,000名規模までのエンタープライズ領域において、  継続的に「カオナビ」を通じた人事・経営課題の解決を行っていただけるよう、  能動的にお客様のご利用状況・課題・実現したいことをヒアリングし、提案を行っていただきます。  【業務内容】  担当するエンタープライズ企業群の「事業伴走者」として、  プロダクト活用を通じた経営・組織課題の解決を牽引していただきます。  【具体的には】    「カオナビ」導入プロジェクトの推進  人事・経営課題の解決に向けたカオナビ活用提案  アップセル・クロスセル機会の創出  顧客データをもとにした傾向分析  開発やマーケティング部門へのフィードバック     ポジションの魅力      急成長中のHRテック・人材管理市場で、社会問題の解決に携われる 労働人口減少が避けられない日本において、労働生産性の低さは喫緊の課題です。 働き方改革やDX化の影響に加え、他SaaSと比較しても未導入の企業が多く非常に伸びしろが多い市場です。   正解がないからこそ、面白い タレントマネジメントに正解がないのと同じようにカスタマーサクセスにも正解はないと考えています。 だからこそ経験の有無に関わらず「お客様の課題解決に向けて伴走したい」、「お客様と一緒にサービスをよりよくしたい」と考える方がやりがいを持って働けるポジションです。   お客様のためになるサービス改善に取り組める Style制度」を通じて、時間や場所にとらわれず、自ら成果を出しにいく働き方を実現。 全社平均残業時間は49分／日（2025年3月期）、兼業比率は20.3％（2025年3月末時点）。制度は挑戦を支える手段であり、主体的に成果を追求するカルチャーが根付いています。    【メンバー紹介記事】     BPOキャリアを武器に、市場の「次」を創り出す──カオナビで見出した「プロとしての真価」 title: CLM Manager (H/F)
description: Role Purpose   The CLM Manager is responsible for managing all stages of the client lifecycle, from onboarding to periodic reviews. The role ensures that client data is accurate and complete, regulatory requirements are met (e.g. KYC/AML), and that internal stakeholders receive efficient, high‑quality support throughout the client relationship.  The position sits at the crossroads of Operations, Compliance, Bankers and assistants, Legal and IT, and is key to delivering seamless and controlled client experience.      Key Responsibilities    Client Onboarding  Coordinate and execute end‑to‑end onboarding for new clients (individuals and entities).  Verify and validate KYC /KYT documentation in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.  Perform due diligence checks (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, source of wealth/funds) using internal tools and external providers.  Assess client risk profiles and ensure appropriate risk classification and documentation.  Liaise with Front Office, Compliance and Legal to resolve onboarding issues and obtain approvals.  Periodic Reviews  Perform regular and event‑driven KYC reviews in accordance with internal policies and local regulations.  Monitor triggers that require review (change of circumstances, risk rating changes, new products, new jurisdictions, etc.).  Ensure proper documentation and archiving of all client records in line with data retention rules.  Support remediation exercises and data quality initiatives.  Regulatory & Compliance Support  Apply and interpret KYC/AML, FATCA/CRS, sanctions, and other relevant regulations  Escalate higher‑risk clients and unusual situations to Compliance in a timely manner.  Contribute to the implementation of new regulatory requirements and internal policies impacting client lifecycle processes.  Support internal and external audits, regulatory inspections and Compliance testing by providing accurate information and documentation.  Process, Quality & Risk Management  Ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with internal procedures and control frameworks.  Identify process gaps and risks and propose improvements to enhance efficiency, control and client experience.  Stakeholder Management & Service Orientation  Act as a point of contact for Bankers and assistants and other internal stakeholders on onboarding and client data topics.  Provide clear and timely guidance on documentation requirements and processes.  Support training and awareness sessions for Front Office and other teams on CLM / KYC requirements and best practices.  Promote a culture of client focus combined with strong risk and compliance awareness.  Systems & Data Management  Ensure data quality, consistency and integrity across systems; support data cleansing initiatives.  Participate in system enhancements, testing (UAT), and roll‑outs of new CLM tools  Provide feedback to IT and project teams on system usability, issues and improvement opportunities.

Established in 2021, DCM has quickly become a leader in the industry, offering exceptional services to maintain and enhance residential communities and districts across Dubai. At DCM, we believe in creating sustainable and vibrant communities that offer a sense of belonging to residents. Our team of experts provides various services, including community and district management, technical management, and financial management. Our community and district management services ensure that each community is well-maintained, secure, and operates efficiently. We manage common areas, enforce community rules and regulations, coordinate with local authorities, and respond to residents' concerns promptly and effectively We proudly manage a portfolio of prestigious communities, including Bluewaters, City Walk, Port de La Mer, Bvlgari Residences, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and Business Bay Executive Towers, among others. title: Customer Service Manager
description: Job Title: Customer Services Manager  Location: Stafford, primarily office-based  Salary: £70,000 DOE     About the role     We’re working with a growing SaaS business based in Stafford that is looking for an experienced Customer Services Manager to take ownership of its wider customer-facing function.     This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building, improving and scaling customer operations, rather than simply managing an established process.     You'll lead multiple customer-facing functions including Customer Support, Customer Success, Implementation, Training and Go-To-Market, working across a team of around 15 people and providing leadership to existing team leads and managers.     The business has grown significantly, and many of its customer processes have developed organically. Your role will be to bring greater structure, consistency and accountability across the function while ensuring customers continue to receive an excellent experience.     You'll also play an important role in connecting the customer function with the wider business, working closely with Product, Development and senior leadership to ensure customer feedback is captured, understood and translated into meaningful product and service improvements.     What you'll be doing      Lead and develop the wider customer-facing function across Support, Success, Implementation, Training and Go-To-Market.  Manage and develop existing team leads and managers, helping them get the best from their teams.  Review existing processes and introduce greater structure, consistency and accountability.  Establish and manage relevant KPIs, SLAs and service standards.  Improve the customer journey across onboarding, implementation, training and ongoing support.  Monitor customer satisfaction, engagement, adoption and retention.  Act as a senior escalation point for complex customer issues.  Develop strong relationships with customers and understand their operational challenges.  Act as the voice of the customer within the business.  Work closely with Product and Development to ensure customer feedback and recurring issues influence product improvements.  Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through better processes, systems and automation.  Help build a scalable customer operation capable of supporting the company's continued growth.      We're ideally looking for someone with:      Significant experience leading Customer Service, Customer Success, Customer Operations or Support functions.  Experience managing managers or team leads.  Previous experience within a SaaS or software business.  Experience leading multiple customer-facing teams or functions.  A track record of improving processes and bringing structure to growing organisations.  Strong experience with KPIs, SLAs and customer performance metrics.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  Experience working closely with Product, Development and senior leadership.  A strong customer-focus

title: Client Success Partner | Chicago | Remote
description: Client Success Partner      Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time (ET) Hours      Apply here:     https://operationsarmy.com/application     About The Role   As a   Client Success Partner  , you’ll serve as a trusted point of contact for clients, helping them get the most value from their partnership with us.  This is a   strategic, hands-on role  , not a traditional customer support position. You’ll need to understand what the client is trying to accomplish, recognize potential challenges early, and work with our internal teams to turn client needs into effective solutions.  The ideal candidate has experience in   technology, SaaS, AI, startups, digital services, or another environment where clients expect speed, flexibility, and proactive thinking  .   What You’ll Do     Develop a strong understanding of each client’s goals, priorities, and working style.  Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the client relationship.  Anticipate client needs instead of waiting for issues to arise.  Translate client feedback into actionable recommendations for internal teams.  Monitor the overall health of client relationships and identify areas requiring attention.  Coordinate internally to resolve challenges and keep commitments on track.  Lead client conversations around priorities, changes, and opportunities.  Identify opportunities to improve how clients work with our team.  Gather and communicate client insights that can inform company decisions.  Help create scalable approaches for managing recurring client needs.  Maintain accurate records of important client information, decisions, and follow-ups.  Partner with leadership on sensitive client situations and strategic priorities.      What We’re Looking For     3+ years in customer success, client success, account management, consulting, partnerships, or a similar client-facing role.  Experience supporting clients in a tech, SaaS, AI, startup, or digital environment is highly preferred.  Strong business judgment and the ability to understand the “why” behind a client’s request.  Comfortable using technology and learning unfamiliar platforms quickly.  Excellent communication skills, particularly in written business communication.  Able to confidently manage conversations with different levels of stakeholders.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Highly organized with excellent follow-through.  Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.  Able to balance client needs with business priorities.       The Right Person    You don’t see yourself as someone who simply   responds to clients  . You see yourself as someone who helps clients   succeed  .  You naturally ask questions, connect the dots, identify risks, and look for ways to make the relationship stronger. You’re comfortable saying, “Here’s what I recommend,” rather than simply asking, “What would you like us to do?”    Apply here:     https://operationsarmy.com/application

title: Implementation Manager
description: Role Summary    Stavtar Solutions is looking for an Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery experience for our clients. You will serve as the primary point of contact from contract signing through go-live, managing timelines, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination to ensure every implementation lands on time, within scope, and aligned to the business value the client signed up for.  This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, client discovery, and project management. It is ideal for a detail-oriented, client-facing delivery professional who can run complex SaaS implementations in fintech or enterprise environments, listening deeply, translating requirements into clear specifications, managing scope diplomatically, and keeping engineering, product, and the client moving in the same direction.  Stavtar is a SaaS company that provides business spend management and expense allocation software purpose-built for complex organizations such as alternative asset managers. Our product, StavPay, has changed the way complex businesses manage their spend and expense allocation, and Implementation Managers are how we get every new client there successfully.    Key Responsibilities     Client Onboarding & Delivery      Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer expectations and business value.   Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout onboarding, managing day-to-day communication and stakeholder relationships across technical and non-technical audiences.   Develop and maintain project plans, status reports, and implementation documentation for each engagement.   Proactively identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and scope changes early, before they turn into problems.   Run multiple concurrent implementations without letting quality or communication slip on any of them.     Client Discovery & Requirements      Lead structured discovery sessions with clients to understand workflows, goals, constraints, and pain points.   Translate ambiguous or incomplete client input into clear, actionable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering.   Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases early to avoid rework downstream, and maintain an organized, evolving requirements log aligned with what is being built.   Document business processes, data flows, and user journeys, producing diagrams (swimlanes, sequence flows) that both clients and engineers can follow.   Manage expectations and help clients prioritize needs vs. wants, pushing back diplomatically to protect scope and timeline.     Cross-Functional Coordination      Work directly with Implementation Engineers to coordinate technical delivery, serving as the bridge between the client and engineering through development and deployment.   Support QA by clarifying acceptance criteria

Dine arbeidsoppgaver blir å:  Videreutvikle og følge opp sentrale kvalitetsprosesser  Være superbruker i kvalitets-, avviks- og dokument styringssystemer  Lede og følge opp interne og eksterne revisjoner (ISO, Teknisk Godkjenning og PEFC)  Støtte og veilede i det daglige kvalitetsarbeidet  Følge opp relevante regelverk, standarder og forskrifter  Jobbe med forbedring, digitalisering og aktiv bruk av kvalitetsdata     Ønskede kvalifikasjoner   Utdanning som sivilingeniør/ingeniør. title: Vi vokser og trenger flere dyktige testledere og strategiske testrådgivere
description: Bouvet opplever økt etterspørsel etter testledere og strategiske testrådgivere i markedet. Derfor vil vi styrke laget med flere medarbeidere som har kompetanse på disse områdene.   Dette ser vi etter hos deg:   Du har erfaring over tid som gjør deg til en god testleder eller strategisk testrådgiver for kvalitetssikring av IT-løsninger. Du liker å se helheten i løsningene og har forståelse for hva som gir kvalitet og gode brukeropplevelser. Som tverrfaglig lagspiller er du god i relasjon med andre og trives som konsulent ute hos kunder.  Med dette som utgangspunkt tar vi gjerne en prat med deg, og vi ser spesielt etter deg som har:    Høyere utdannelse (mastergrad, cand.scient, bachelor e.l.)  Dokumentert testkunnskap, gjerne i form av ISTQB-sertifisering  Erfaring som testleder eller i en annen rolle med ansvar for kvalitet i IT-prosjekter  Kjennskap til moderne testmetodikk og rammeverk, gjerne smidig og i skyen  Evnen til å se overordnet og strategisk på kvalitet i leveransene  Strukturert tilnærming til arbeidsoppgavene  Svært gode kommunikasjonsevner og flytende norsk muntlig og skriftlig (B2 eller høyere)  Erfaring med bruk av AI-verktøy     Vi kan tilby:   Som konsulent i vår QA-avdeling vil du få mange spennende muligheter.  Oppdrag:    Du får muligheten til å påvirke hvilket oppdrag og hvilken kunde du ønsker å jobbe for.  Oppdragene er gjerne samfunnskritiske, og du vil være med på å forme den digitale utviklingen i Norge samtidig som du bygger din egen karriere.  Du får jobbe med fremtidsrettede teknologier, metodikker og verktøy.    Fagutvikling:    Du blir del av et sterkt fagmiljø innen QA og et større tverrfaglig miljø med mange dyktige kollegaer.  Du vil få tilgang til kurs og sertifiseringer, blant annet i vår egen kursavdeling.  Bouvet har en god delingskultur med fagsamlinger og arrangementer for deling mellom kollegaer og med kunder.    Felleskap og tilhørighet:    Du vil møte engasjerte, jordnære og hyggelige medarbeidere og ha tilhørighet til vår QA-avdeling i området Teknologiledelse og rådgivning.  Du vil kontinuerlig få oppfølging av din avdelingsleder som legger til rette for at du skal trives og utvikle deg.  Vi har en egen sosialkomité som jevnlig arrangerer fysiske og digitale sosiale aktiviteter som du kan delta på om du ønsker.     Gode grunner til å velge Bouvet:     Vi er et selskap som setter kulturen og den ansattes trivsel høyt.  Arbeidsmiljøet er preget av mangfold, hyggelige kollegaer og en uformell tone. Vi har nyoppussede kontorlokaler på Majorstua i Oslo.  Bouvet satser på deg og du kan utvikle deg i spennende oppdrag, gjennom kurs og konferanser, og på tvers av fagområder. Sertifiseringer belønnes.  Trygghet – Bouvet er et stabilt selskap med langvarige oppdrag.    Markedsdyktige betingelser – vi tilbyr fastlønn og overskuddsdeling, aksjeprogram, betalt overtid og avspasering.    Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

title: Staff QA Engineer (EE Excellence)
description: 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      Staff QA Engineer - [EE Excellence / eCommerce Platform]    직무 요약:   이 포지션은 이커머스 플랫폼의 Staff QA Engineer 역할로서,  다중 도메인 테스트, End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 포함하며, 통합된 도메인 전반에 테스트 자동화를 적용하고 Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment(CI/CD) 파이프라인과의 연계를 수행합니다.  또한 글로벌라이제이션, 국제화(Internationalization), 로컬라이제이션(Localization) 테스트 경험은 우대 사항입니다.      직무 소개:   이커머스 플랫폼의 Staff QA Engineer로서, 통합된 도메인의 품질을 보장하기 위해 종합적인 테스트 계획을 설계, 구현 및 실행하는 역할을 담당합니다.  엔지니어링, 프로덕트 매니지먼트, 디자인 등 다양한 조직과 긴밀하게 협업하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 우선순위를 설정합니다.  테스트 방법론에 대한 전문성, 애자일 환경에서의 업무 경험, CI/CD 파이프라인에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 다양한 도메인에 걸쳐 매끄러운 쇼핑 경험을 제공하는 데 중요한 역할을 하게 됩니다.      주요 업무:    Design and Execute Test Plans - 이커머스 플랫폼의 모든 영역(프론트엔드, 백엔드, API 연동, 시스템 성능, E2E 테스트 포함)을 포괄하는 종합적인 테스트 계획을 수립하고 실행합니다.  Collaborate with Cross-functional Teams - 엔지니어링 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 테스트의 우선순위를 설정하며, 각 스프린트에 품질이 내재화될 수 있도록 보장합니다.  Test Automation - Selenium, Appium, TestNG 등의 도구를 활용하여 자동화 테스트 스크립트를 설계 및 구현함으로써 수작업 테스트를 줄이고, 다양한 도메인(예: 결제 게이트웨이, 배송 API, 재고 관리)의 테스트 커버리지를 확대합니다.  Manual Testing - 자동화 테스트에서 놓칠 수 있는 버그 및 결함을 식별하기 위해 이커머스 플랫폼에 대한 수동 테스트를 수행합니다.  Report Defects - 테스트 과정에서 발견된 결함을 문서화하고 보고하며, 개발자가 이슈를 재현할 수 있도록 명확한 재현 절차를 제공합니다.  Test Data Management - 여러 도메인에 걸친 이커머스 플랫폼 테스트에 적합하도록 테스트 데이터의 정확성, 최신성 및 적합성을 유지하며 관리합니다.  Quality Assurance - 모든 테스트 활동이 회사의 품질 기준 및 규제 요구사항에 부합하도록 보장합니다.  Integrate Test Automation with CI/CD Pipeline - 자동화 테스트를 CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하여 고품질 소프트웨어 제품이 원활하게 배포될 수 있도록 합니다.  E2E Testing - 실제 사용자 시나리오를 기반으로 End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 수행하여 로그인부터 결제까지 이커머스 플랫폼이 정상적으로 작동하는지 확인합니다.  Multiple Domain Testing - 결제 게이트웨이, 배송 API, 재고 관리 등 이커머스 플랫폼에 통합된 다양한 도메인을 테스트합니다.       자격 요건:    컴퓨터공학, 정보기술 또는 관련 분야 학사 학위 이상 (석사 또는 박사 우대)  QA 엔지니어링 분야에서 8년 이상의 경력, 이 중 이커머스 플랫폼에서의 경력 3년 이상  Selenium, Appium, TestNG 또는 Pytest와 같은 테스트 자동화 프레임워크에 대한 검증된 전문성  Agile, Scrum, Test-Driven Development(TDD)와 같은 테스트 방법론에 대한 높은 이해도  다양한 협업 조직과 원활하게 일할 수 있는 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력  Scrum 또는 Kanban과 같은 애자일 개발 방법론 환경에서의 업무 경험  주니어 QA 엔지니어를 관리 및 멘토링한 경험은 우대       우대 사항:    업무상 영어 또는 중국어 가능자  품질 엔지니어링 관련 자격증 (예: ISTQB)  클라우드 플랫폼(AWS, Azure, GCP), 컨테이너(Docker), 또는 마이크로서비스 아키텍처에 대한 경험  Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD 또는 CircleCI와 같은 DevOps 도구에 대한 이해 및 사용 경험  Globalization testing - 언어 번역 및 문화적 적응을 포함한 글로벌 이커머스 플랫폼 테스트에 대한 전문성  Internatio

title: Quality Manager
description: To lead and manage quality assurance across the Aftersales operation, ensuring that service, repair, warranty, and customer-handling processes consistently meet company and manufacturer/OEM standards. The role will focus on reducing repeat repairs, improving customer satisfaction, driving continuous improvement, and maintaining strong quality performance across the workshop and Aftersales functions.    Key Responsibilities     Develop and implement quality standards, procedures, and control processes for Aftersales operations.  Ensure all service and repair activities comply with manufacturer/OEM standards, technical procedures, and company policies.  Conduct regular quality audits and inspections across workshop, service, warranty, and related Aftersales operations.  Monitor vehicle repair quality and ensure vehicles are properly inspected before delivery to customers.  Identify quality issues, repeat repairs, technical defects, and process gaps and ensure timely corrective action.  Lead root-cause analysis using structured problem-solving methods and implement preventive measures.  Monitor customer complaints, feedback, CSI/NPS results, and quality-related concerns to identify improvement opportunities.  Work closely with Service, Technical, Parts, Warranty, and CRM teams to resolve quality issues.  Establish and monitor quality-related KPIs and provide regular performance reports to management.  Track repeat repair rates, first-time-fix performance, warranty issues, customer complaints, and service quality indicators.  Coordinate with OEM/Principal representatives regarding quality audits, technical concerns, campaigns, and corrective actions.  Ensure compliance with manufacturer audit requirements and prepare departments for periodic quality assessments.  Develop and maintain quality documentation, checklists, inspection reports, and standard operating procedures.  Conduct process reviews to identify inefficiencies and implement continuous improvement initiatives.  Monitor workshop housekeeping, safety, equipment condition, and adherence to required operating standards.  Train and coach Aftersales staff on quality standards, processes, customer satisfaction, and quality awareness.  Ensure lessons learned from quality issues are communicated across relevant teams to prevent recurrence.  Act as the escalation point for major quality-related customer complaints and operational issues.  Prepare management reports highlighting quality performance, trends, risks, and recommended corrective actions.

title: Technical Lead – Microsoft Dynamics 365
description: Role Overview   We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead to provide technical leadership, solution architecture, and development oversight for a complex Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementation.   Key Responsibilities     Lead the end-to-end technical architecture for Dynamics 365, integrations, portals, business rules, and supporting technologies.  Lead and mentor multidisciplinary development teams.  Design and oversee Dynamics 365/Dataverse, workflows, security, integrations, and customizations.  Oversee APIs, system integrations, digital portals, and business rules/decision engines.  Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with technical standards.  Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, testing, releases, and production readiness.  Establish and oversee CI/CD, DevOps, documentation, and technical governance.  Identify technical risks, dependencies, and issues and drive timely resolution.  10+ years of experience building production distributed systems.  Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot.  Extensive experience with REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.  Strong AWS experience across compute, storage, networking, and IAM.  Hands-on experience with edge computing, CDN execution environments, edge workers, Lambda@Edge, or similar technologies.  Experience building data platforms or systems supporting ML inference and model serving.  Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, observability, and security.  Proven experience taking systems from 0 to 1 in an environment with evolving requirements.  Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.  Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools and LLM-powered engineering workflows.      Nice to Have     JavaScript / TypeScript experience.  Python experience for data engineering or scripting.  Databricks or similar data/AI platforms.  Experience with ML model registries and feature platforms.  Knowledge of JWT/JWS, PKI, OAuth 2.0, identity, or token verification.  Experience with distributed tracing, structured logging, and observability platforms.  Experience building multi-party integrations or network/platform services.  Open-source contributions.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.   Din roll  Som Quality Assurance Manager har du ett övergripande och strategiskt ansvar för att leda, utveckla och stärka kvalitetsarbetet i vår organisation Business Unit (BU) Digital Battlespace Solutions (DBS) inom Business Area (BA) Surveillance. Du ansvarar för ett team av Project Quality Managers (på två olika orter) och driver utvecklingen av både människor, arbetssätt och strukturer inom kvalitet.  Rollen är i första hand strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, där ditt fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för ett effektivt och enhetligt kvalitetsarbete. Samtidigt förväntas du kunna gå in operativt vid behov, exempelvis i kritiska projektfaser eller vid särskilda kvalitetsutmaningar, kund, - eller interna revisioner.  Du spelar en nyckelroll i att säkerställa att kvalitetsarbetet möter högt ställda krav i en mjukvarutung och tekniskt avancerad miljö, där arbetssätt kontinuerligt anpassas och vidareutvecklas med stöd av agnostisk AI och LLM.  I ett nära samarbete med chef, projektkontor och andra funktioner är du en viktig drivkraft i att forma vår kvalitetsstrategi och säkerställa långsiktig efterlevnad, effektivitet och ständiga förbättringar.  Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:    Leda, coacha och utveckla ett team av Project/Product Quality Managers med fokus på kompetens, prestation och engagemang.  Säkerställa en kontinuerlig och hållbar bemanning av kvalitetsresurser i verksamhetens projekt genom nära samarbete med projektkontor och beställare.   Sätta riktning för och vidareutveckla vårt kvalitetsarbete, processer och metoder genom nära samarbete med andra kvalitetsfunktioner och stödfunktioner på BA och Group nivå.  Säkerställa efterlevnad av relevanta standarder, regelverk och interna krav som ställs på oss.  Driva förbättringsinitiativ med hjälp av AI och utveckla skalbara arbetssätt anpassade för en mjukvaruintensiv verksamhet och dess kundkrav.  Ansvara för övergripande revisioner, uppföljning och kvalitetsmätningar med regelbunden rapportering både på Business Unit (BU) och Business Area (BA) nivå, samt representera BUt i kvalitetsforum på BA nivå.  Fungera som ett strategiskt stöd till alla funktioner inom BUt i kvalitetsrelaterade frågor från tidigt offertarbete mot kund till domänspecifika frågor.  Vid behov gå in operativt för att säkerställa kvalitet i kritiska projekt leveranser.     Tjänsten är baserad i Solna. Resor inrikes och utrikes kan förekomma.  Din profil  För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en erfaren kvalitetsledare med tidigare personalansvar och med ett starkt driv att utveckla både organisationer och människor. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt tänkande med ett nära och engagerat ledarskap.  Du har god förståelse för kvalitetsarbete i komplexa, gärna mjukvaruintensiva miljöer, och du är van att utveckla strukturer och processer som fungerar i praktiken.  So

title: QA Manager
location: Søborg, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Does it excite you to work with Complaint Management, and do you have experience within cross-functional CMC collaboration and CMO and Partner communication? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.   Your new position   As our QA Manager for complaint management, you will play a crucial role in building and strengthening our complaint management systems, and handling complaint processes regarding both clinical products as well as marketed products. You will work closely with Manufacturing QA, the CMC organization internally, CMOs and Partners to ensure that the process supports both compliance and the needs of the business. The role combines hands-on complaint management with process ownership and continuous improvement of the quality systems supporting complaint handling processes for both clinical products and marketed products. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of an important quality process and contribute to how we develop efficient, compliant, and scalable ways of working across the organization.   We Offer Exciting Responsibilities     Building and strengthening our complaint competencies internally  Complaint management, incl. support, coordination and contact with stakeholders  Collaborate with Manufacturing QA, CMOs, Partners and cross-functional stakeholders on complaint-related matters  Maintain and continuously improve complaint and recall processes, including procedures, templates, training, and ways of working  Manage recall (and mock recalls) related activities  Contribute to the development and optimization of Veeva Quality Vault and related complaint management processes. Die myStromer AG entwickelt seit 2009 unter der Marke Stromer international ausgezeichnete Speed Pedelecs, die mit herausragender Leistung, Konnektivität und Design neue Massstäbe für die tägliche Mobilität setzen. Unser Ziel ist es, die besten S-Pedelecs zu entwickeln und Menschen dafür zu begeistern, sie täglich zu nutzen. Dafür bündeln wir an unserem Campus in Oberwangen alle Kompetenzen unter einem Dach – von der Entwicklung über die Montage und das Marketing bis zum Vertrieb. Seit 2022 gehört auch die Marke Desiknio zum Portfolio der myStromer AG und ergänzt das Angebot mit Premium-E-Bikes bis 25 km/h.     Premium ist für uns kein erreichter Zustand, sondern ein Anspruch, an dem wir jeden Tag arbeiten. Deshalb entwickeln wir Qualität im gesamten Unternehmen zu einer strategischen Priorität. Unser Ziel ist es, die Qualität unserer Produkte, Prozesse und Services kontinuierlich zu verbessern und eine unternehmensweite Qualitätskultur zu etablieren, in der Qualität von allen Bereichen gemeinsam getragen wird. Der Head of Quality übernimmt dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: Er schafft Transparenz, setzt Standards und befähigt die Organisation dazu, Qualität nachhaltig als gemeinsamen Erfolgsfaktor zu verankern.     Für unseren Hauptsitz in Oberwangen suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine erfahrene und umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit als      Head of Quality (m/w/d), 100%      Als Head of Quality berichtest Du direkt an den CEO und entwickelst die Qualitätsfunktion bei myStromer strategisch weiter. Du verantwortest die Governance der Produkt- und Servicequalität entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus: von der Entwicklung über Einkauf, Logistik, Produktion bis zu Verkauf und Marketing. Dabei etablierst Du Transparenz über Qualitätsperformance und -risiken, schaffst eine datenbasierte Qualitätssteuerung und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Qualitätsmanagements gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung voran. Qualität verstehen wir dabei nicht primär als Audit-, Dokumentations- oder Kontrollfunktion, sondern als zentralen Erfolgsfaktor für Produktqualität, Kundenzufriedenheit, die langfristige Stärke unserer Premiummarken und eine nachhaltig gelebte Qualitätskultur über alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg.      Deine Aufgaben    Du entwickelst und etablierst eine unternehmensweite Quality Governance und förderst gemeinsam mit den Führungskräften eine Qualitätskultur, in der Qualität als gemeinsame Verantwortung gelebt wird.  Du berätst den CEO und die Geschäftsleitung in qualitätsrelevanten Fragestellungen und schaffst mit einem aussagekräftigen KPI- und Reporting-System Transparenz über die Qualitätsperformance des Unternehmens.  Als erste Ansprechperson für Qualitätsthemen arbeitest Du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen und sorgst für die nachhaltige und effiziente Lösung qualitätsrelevanter Herausforderungen.  Du begleitest die Produktentstehung von der Entwicklung über Einkauf und Produk

 About the Company  Zenara Health is a mental healthcare organization driven by technology, aiming to improve the accessibility and quality of mental wellness services. By integrating AI-driven platforms with professional clinical care, we deliver personalized and effective mental health solutions, creating a smooth digital experience for both patients and providers. We operate as a startup, distinct from a mere department.  Why This Role Exists   This position serves as the company's foremost line of defense. You will be the most risk-aware individual in the startup — and that’s exactly what we require. Our team is in the process of developing a platform that manages clinical data, operates AI workflows, and processes insurance billing — all within a HIPAA-regulated environment catering to real psychiatric practices. Our infrastructure is operational; however, we lack an individual who will take ownership with a security-first perspective. We currently do not have a dedicated CI/CD owner, a comprehensive security posture, or monitoring that extends beyond simple uptime checks. If HIPAA auditors were to arrive tomorrow, we could withstand the scrutiny — but it wouldn’t be a pleasant experience.  You will be responsible for Zenara’s infrastructure, security posture, and compliance engineering — everything from the ground up. This includes CI/CD pipelines, HIPAA-compliant deployment automation, monitoring and alerting systems, cybersecurity measures and threat defense, access controls, and audit logging — the complete spectrum of "essential elements that ensure the safe operation of a healthcare company."  However, your role will go beyond mere maintenance. You will also develop infrastructure for our AI platform, encompassing model serving, scaling AI workloads, and supporting production AI pipelines. You will have a dual mandate: ensure the stability and security of the platform while also building the necessary infrastructure for AI at scale.   This represents a unique opportunity for greenfield infrastructure engineering within a healthcare AI company with genuine compliance obligations and real users.  You will devise systems from fundamental principles, make architectural choices, establish best practices to guide us through growth and compliance

title: Werkstudent (all genders) – Robuste Feed-Forward-3D-Rekonstruktion für dynamische Szenen
description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Feed-Forward-Modelle zur 3D-Rekonstruktion können Szenengeometrie direkt aus Bildern oder Videos vorhersagen, ohne eine aufwendige szenenspezifische Optimierung zu benötigen. Durch die Kombination von großskaligem Pre-Training, Multi-View-Reasoning und starken geometrischen Priors stellen sie eine effiziente Alternative zu klassischen Rekonstruktionsverfahren wie Structure-from-Motion, NeRF und optimierungsbasiertem 3D Gaussian Splatting dar.

Trotz aktueller Fortschritte reagieren bestehende Modelle weiterhin empfindlich auf anspruchsvolle reale Bedingungen. Verdeckungen, bewegte Objekte, wechselnde Beleuchtung, Nachtaufnahmen, Reflexionen, Regen, Nebel und Schnee können zu unvollständiger Geometrie, unzuverlässigen Korrespondenzen und zeitlich inkonsistenten Vorhersagen führen. Eine höhere Robustheit unter solchen Bedingungen ist daher insbesondere für autonomes Fahren und robotische Wahrnehmung von großer Bedeutung.

Als Werkstudent*in unterstützt du die Entwicklung robuster Feed-Forward-Rekonstruktionsmodelle für dynamische Szenen. Du untersuchst Methoden zur Behandlung von Verdeckungen, Beleuchtungsänderungen und widrigen Wetterbedingungen. Darüber hinaus erforschst du, wie große Rekonstruktionsmodelle als universelle geometrische Backbones für nachgelagerte Aufgaben des 3D-Szenenverständnisses eingesetzt werden können, insbesondere für Semantic Occupancy Prediction und 4D Occupancy Forecasting.

We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As Senior AI/ML Engineer at RedMimicry, you will lead the applied AI/ML work behind new analysis capabilities for our breach and attack emulation platform. The core challenge is extracting useful structure from heterogeneous, partially unstructured security telemetry and relating it to known attacker activity.

The problem is broader than prompt engineering. You will determine where LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, learned ranking, and deterministic heuristics are justified. The standard is measurable improvement against reproducible baselines, not architectural fashion. Everything you build must operate under realistic latency, reliability, and deployment constraints.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Develop Security-Log Parsing Methods: Design and implement methods for extracting typed events from heterogeneous SIEM, EDR, NDR, operating-system, and network telemetry.
  • Design Embeddings and Retrieval: Select, evaluate, and tune representations and retrieval methods for security events.
  • Handle Ambiguity Explicitly: Implement confidence scoring, calibration, and controlled treatment of ambiguous evidence.
  • Ground Results in Evidence: Ensure that results are supported by traceable evidence from the original telemetry.
  • Build Rigorous Evaluations: Define datasets, baselines, ablations, and metrics, and analyse failure modes systematically.
  • Optimise Inference: Make the pipeline practical for cloud operation and on-premises deployment.

title: Junior AI/ML Engineer, Data and Evaluation
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As an AI/ML Engineer at RedMimicry, you will build the datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation infrastructure behind our applied AI/ML work on security telemetry.

The quality of this work depends on accurate ground truth, disciplined data handling, reproducible experiments, and systematic error analysis. Your work will determine whether reported improvements are real and whether regressions are caught before deployment.

You will work closely with the Senior AI/ML Engineer and Offensive Security Engineer. This role is suitable for an early-career or intermediate engineer with strong programming and data skills who wants to work on applied AI in a technically demanding cybersecurity environment.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Curate Security Datasets: Prepare telemetry from controlled engagements and test environments.
  • Build Ground Truth: Create and maintain labelled examples, annotation guidelines, and consistency checks.
  • Maintain Evaluation Partitions: Separate training, validation, and test data along relevant dimensions.
  • Automate Benchmarks: Implement metrics and maintain reproducible benchmark and regression pipelines that run locally and in CI.
